Morrisons is printed on the promotional card. For more infomation see Free card games at Morrisons (UK) thread. Also sold through "Sue Ryder" (UK) charity shops (2015). Also sold through "REWE" (GER) supermarkets (2018).

name: Monopoly Deal Wizarding World/Harry Potter Card Game
description: Similar to Monopoly Deal Card Game, but comes with unique character cards with special abilities.

name: Monopoly Deal: Disney Stitch
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Science Fiction
description: Similar to Monopoly Deal Card Game, but comes with unique character cards with special abilities.

name: Monopoly Deal: KPop Demon Hunters
description: Similar to Monopoly Deal Card Game, but comes with character cards. Each player receives one at the start of the game. They all have an ongoing, different ability (either "On your turn" or "during your turn").

name: Monopoly Deal: NFL Edition
description: In Monopoly Deal: NFL Edition, you want to be the first to collect three sets of NFL teams from the 32 available. Action cards let players swipe teams, sack and intercept opponents, recover fumbles, and pull off key plays, so you'll need to keep your options open as you head for the end zone to score.

name: Monopoly Deal: No Mercy
description: Object of the Game: Collect property cards, and try to complete sets. Use action cards to collect rent, steal properties, and more. Be sure to stash money in your personal Bank for when players go after you! The first player to have three different complete property sets wins! What’s different about Monopoly Deal No Mercy? You can do into debt. When you owe another player money and can’t pay, give them a debt chip. On your next turn, must pay them back by giving them a card. That counts as one of the three cards you may play on your turn! Nothing is safe. From complete property sets to the cards in your hand, everything can be stolen in the blink of an eye. Action Cards are more ruthless! They got a mean makeover-charge double rent and even force someone to give away all the cards in their Bank!

name: Monopoly: Flemish Edition
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: This is a Flemish version of the Monopoly Game. The game was published bij deSka from Brussels. Gameplay is the same as the original Monopoly. Places on the board: Go: Start Free Parking: Vrij Parkeren Gaol: Gevangenis Go To Gaol: Naar De Gevangenis Income Tax: Inkomsten Belasting Luxury Tax: Extra Belasting Chance: Kans Community Chest: Algemeen Fonds Indigo: Leuven, Dieststraat / Mechelen, Bruul Gray: Leuven, Bondgenotenlaan / Turnhout, Gasthuisstraat / Turnhout, Leopoldstraat Purple: Aalst, Lange Zoutstraat / Brugge, Vlamingenstraat / Knokke, Kustlaan Orange: Brugge, Steenstraat / Oostende, Kapellestraat / Kortrijk, Rijselstraat Red: Tienen, Leuvensestraat / Gent, Kortrijksestraat / Hasselt, Grote Markt Yellow: Antwerpen, Groenplaats / Brussel, Lakenstraat / Gent, Veldstraat Green: Antwerpen, Huidevettersstraat / Gent, Vlaanderenstraat, Hasselt, Demersstraat Blue: Antwerpen Meir, Brussel Nieuwstraat Railway Stations (Stations): Noordstation, Centraal Station, Buurtspoorwegen, Zuidstation Utilities: Electriciteitscentraal, Waterdienst

name: Monopoly: Tropical Tycoon DVD Game
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Tropical Tycoon is a modified version of Monopoly that incorporates new rules, new pieces, and new winning conditions. It uses a DVD (required) to generate random events. New additions include: Players have Jobs that give individual advantages. In addition to beach houses (houses) and resorts (hotels), properties can be developed with Casinos, Parks, Restaurants, and Piers. The rent for the Casino is pure luck, but sometimes the owner has to pay out to the visitor. Parks don't garner much rent, and what rent they gather is based on the weather, which can change with every Chance or Community Chest event (the Park's main benefit is its worth in Fortune Tokens at game end: A Park on Gentle Sands is the equivalent of four million dollars cash at the end of the game). Piers' rent depends not only on the weather, but also the presence or absence of a cruise ship, which is also affected by the card events. Finally, Restaurants' rent is dependent upon the neighboring property improvements. There are very few of these developments, though, so the competition for them can be fierce! Although the basic board layout is the same as a standard Monopoly board, there are no Chance and Community Chest cards; when a player lands on one of those two spots, the DVD determines what happens. One of the dice has a TV symbol in place of the 1-pip; when the TV is rolled, a News Broadcast is played on the DVD, which triggers a random event (much like Chance or Community Chest). Players collect Fortune Tokens (and earn them at the end of the game through their cash and property holdings). Play ends when one player goes bankrupt (or, alternately, whenever the players decide to stop). The player with the most Fortune Tokens at the end of the game wins.

name: Monopoly Empire
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Take That
description: With Monopoly Empire, you can own some of the biggest brands in the world as every space on the game board is an iconic brand, including Xbox, Coca-Cola, McDonald's and Samsung. As in the original Monopoly game, players start with cash in hand, roll dice, and move a token around the game board while hoping to purchase properties. Each property is represented by one or more billboards, with the more valuable properties having larger billboards. When you purchase a property, you place a billboard into your personal plastic tower; when you pass "Go!" on the game board, you earn income based on the height of your tower. Reach a value of $800 on your tower, and you win. When you land on an opponent's property, you pay rent to that player based on the height of her tower. If you don't have enough cash on hand, hand over the top billboard in your tower instead but keep the cash you do have. This mechanism means there is no player elimination. While players don't trade properties, you can effectively steal them through the use of Empire cards and the "swap" face on one die, which allows you to swap the top billboards on two towers. To date, two editions have been released in the U.S.: The Second "Silver" Edition has some updated properties & movers from the First "Gold" Edition, but gameplay is the same for both editions. This game and Monopoly: Here & Now World Edition share many similarities.

name: Monopoly Empire Card Game
description: Trade fast to build your empire first. Chose which empire you want to build. Shout out your trades to collect a complete color set! The Empire wild card earns a mega bonus! But beware the Go To Jail card! To win, get 9 matching color cards and shout "Empire!" The highest score wins! Think fast and yell faster to make trades and win! —description from the back of the box

name: Monopoly Express
description: Don't Go to Jail is a dice game derived from Monopoly. The game board depicts the monopolies found in the original game, with the property groups color-coded as in Monopoly. Each property group has a given dollar value, which you can collect by rolling the dice and collecting that group. On a turn, you roll ten dice, set aside any die reading "Go," "to" or "jail", then set aside any color group dice that you wish. If the "Go," "to" and "jail" dice are set aside, your turn ends immediately, and you score nothing. Otherwise you can choose to either (1) stop and score for what you've rolled or (2) roll again with any dice not set aside, once again setting aside the "Go," "to" or "jail" dice, etc. The dice have a couple of "Wild" faces, and you can use at most one Wild in a color group. (If you roll the proper color, you can replace a Wild die in a group and roll that die again on a later turn.) If you stop, you score for all completed color groups and one incomplete color group. Your goal is to be the first player to reach a predetermined dollar amount or to have the most money at the end of a pre-set number of turns. Monopoly Express – an updated version of this game that was first released in the UK and Europe, then later in the U.S. – alters the gameplay as follows: The policeman from the "Go To Jail" corner of the board game replaces the words "Go," "to" and "jail". One blank face on one of the policeman dice depicts a green "GO" arrow. A player earns $200 each time they roll GO, but they lose this money if they bust due to policemen. The game includes an eleventh "House/Hotel" die that can earn (or lose) a player Houses (worth $1,000 each), earn Hotels (worth $5,000, but only if a player has already earned four houses) and a "Get Out Of Jail Free" side that negates a policeman (including a policeman that would bust a player). This die cannot be rolled until a player completes a property group (i.e., neither railroads nor utilities). The Wild faces are replaced by the Chance "?" logo; the ? act as a Wild, but unlike a Wild it cannot be replaced. The first player to have at least $15,000 wins immediately; players don't complete the round. In 2021, this game was re-released in the US as Monopoly DICED! with square packaging rather than the round used for Express.

name: Monopoly Express
mechanics: Dice Rolling;Roll / Spin and Move;Tile Placement
description: Quick-play introduction to the classic game Monopoly. Be the player with the most money at the end of the game! It’s all about raking in the rent by putting your tokens on as many properties as you can. But beware, any property you own can be snatched by the next player who lands there. On your turn roll, move your token, and then pay rent, buy, build or auction. When you land on any colored property space, you can build on it – even if someone else owns it. The building tokens have a number on them and they can only be played if they are the next highest token. Look out for the special die that helps build or demolish properties. Properties and utilities cannot be mortgaged in Monopoly Express. If you run out of money, the game is over. The player with the most money wins Gameboard, 32 colored property tokens (8 per player), 8 Chance cards, 8 Community Chest cards, 2 Utility cards, 4 movers, a money pack, and a die.

name: Monopoly for Millennials
description: Money doesn't always buy a great time, but experiences, whether they're good -- or weird -- last forever. The Monopoly for Millennials game celebrates just that. Instead of collecting as much cash as possible, players are challenged to rack up the most Experiences to win. Travel around the gameboard discovering and visiting cool places to eat, shop, and relax. Interact with other players via Chance and Community Chest cards, (which are super relatable). And players don't pay rent -- they visit one another, earning more Experience points. This board game is a great way to bring a fun and relaxed vibe to a party or casual get-together. MONOPOLY FOR MILLENNIALS GAME: Adulting is hard; take a break from the rat race with this edition of the Monopoly game PARTY BOARD GAME: This Monopoly game is a great choice for Millennials who need a break from the life of adulting; great for parties and get-togethers CHOOSE COOL PLACES AND DESTINATIONS: Collect Experience points by visiting the hottest Destinations -- from your Friend's Couch, to the Vegan Bistro, to a Week-Long Meditation Retreat SET THE TREND: Collect money from players who visit the Destinations you discovered first IT'S ABOUT THE EXPERIENCE: In this version of the Monopoly game, the player who collects the most Experience -- not the most money -- wins the game Gameboard, 6 Tokens, 16 Destination Cards, 16 Chance Cards, 16 Community Chest Cards, 64 Experience Chips, Money Pack, 2 Dice, and Game Guide. —description from the publisher

name: Monopoly for Sore Losers
description: Don't get sad…get even! Say goodbye to the frustration of losing while playing Monopoly, and say hello to the Monopoly for Sore Losers board game. This hilarious twist on the Monopoly game turns losing on its head and celebrates it instead. Players earn cash by doing the typically frustrating things in the game such as going to Jail, paying rent on a property, or going bankrupt. And those who really start sinking can make a comeback using the large Mr. Monopoly token that gives players advantages over everyone else. So get playing, get the revenge you've been craving, and feel good about losing! —description from the publisher

name: Monopoly Free Parking Mini Game
description: Contents: Wobbly board 20 taxis 8 sided die 20 taxis are divided equally among players. In turn, each player rolls the die and either places one of their taxis on the indicated color (or any color if the "?" is rolled) or takes a taxi from each of the other players (if the police officer is rolled). First player to get rid of all their taxis wins. This game can be played as a stand-alone game or can be used in conjunction with any monopoly game. Special rules for playing with classic Monopoly are included.

name: Monopoly Gamer
mechanics: Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Stock Holding;Take That;Variable Player Powers
description: Description from the publisher: It's the Monopoly game with a Nintendo twist as it joins forces with beloved Nintendo video game characters. Instead of standard Monopoly tokens, the game features Super Mario characters, each with their own special powers within gameplay. Play as Mario, Princess Peach, Yoshi, or Donkey Kong. Finish the game by defeating Bowser at the end! It's not just about money in this game; players earn points by buying Properties, collecting Coins, and beating Bosses. The player with the highest score wins the game. Features Nintendo's Super Mario characters Coins replace Monopoly money Power-up die activates special abilities Battle legendary Bosses

name: Monopoly Gamer: Mario Kart
mechanics: Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Stock Holding;Take That;Variable Player Powers
description: Monopoly Gamer: Mario Kart takes the property-trading game Monopoly in a new direction thanks to the introduction of characters from Nintendo's Mario Kart games! Move around the game board as Mario, Princess Peach, Luigi, or Toad; buy iconic Mario Kart properties such as Bowser's Castle and Rainbow Road. Pass Go to trigger a race from Mario Kart Cup, dodge banana peel tokens, toss shells, and collect coins. A super star space activates special abilities and rolling the power-up die adds a special boost. Winning in this game is all about winning races! Who will end up with the coveted Grand Prix card? When the final race is over, the player with the highest score wins. —description from the publisher

name: Monopoly Gamer: Overwatch Collector's Edition
description: It's the Monopoly game for fans of Blizzard’s Overwatch! In the board game, each player drafts a team of 3, including a group leader, and then everyone battles for the high score to win! Players earn points by moving around the board capturing objectives and collecting Loot Boxes. The Monopoly Overwatch Collector's Edition includes a game board, 6 character tokens, 6 group leader cards, 16 objective cards, 9 Loot Box cards, 4 reminder cards, 1 numbered die, 1 ability die, 90 plastic HP chips (50 fives and 40 ones), a premium box, and a Game Guide. —description from the publisher

name: Monopoly Gamer: Sonic The Hedgehog
mechanics: Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Stock Holding;Take That;Variable Player Powers
description: Monopoly Gamer: Sonic The Hedgehog takes the property-trading game Monopoly in a new direction thanks to the introduction of characters from Sega's Sonic The Hedgehog games! Move around the game board as Sonic, Tails, Amy or Knuckles; buy iconic Sonic locations such as Planet Wisp and Rooftop Run while dropping and collecting rings on board spaces, earning Chaos Emeralds and Chao tokens. Each Sonic game token has special powers and abilities to use during the gameplay. Pass Go to trigger a boss fight in which players compete for Chaos Emeralds — and having more Emeralds means it will be easier to beat Dr. Eggman! —description from the publisher

name: Monopoly Gamer: Super Mario
description: This edition of the Monopoly game joins forces with Super Mario video game characters for a super fun experience. Instead of the classic Monopoly tokens, players can choose to move around the board as Mario, Luigi, Princess Peach, Yoshi, Toad, or Bowser. Landing on the Super Star board space will activate a character’s unique Super Star Ability. Players earn points by collecting coins, buying property, and beating legendary Bosses. When the final Boss Fight is over, the player with the highest score wins.

name: Monopoly Get Out of Jail Mini Game
description: Contents: Jail base and 4 jail walls 24 prisoners (3 of each in 8 different colors) 6 prison guards 1 spade Prisoners and guards are placed in the jail cell and in turn, each player manipulates the spade underneath the cell and through slats in the floor of the cell in an attempt to flick out prisoners of different colors. Don't free a prison guard, or you're busted! This game has a push-your luck component (players may stop flicking at any time and keep their freed prisoners, but if a prison guard is flicked out, all freed prisoners are returned and that player's turn is over) and a set collection mechanic (collect 3 prisoners of any individual color for double points). This game can be played as a stand-alone game, or can be combined with any Monopoly game as an alternative to rolling doubles to get out of jail.

name: Monopoly GO!
description: Note: There is a separate page for the 2008 Monopoly: Go game which was based on the traditional Monopoly board game, with a single shared gameboard. Inspired by the number-one mobile game, the Monopoly GO! board game sees players racing to build the first landmark. The game is played in fast-paced rounds, and in each round, dice are rolled in the game tray and everyone moves their token at the same time around their own mini gameboard according to the number shown on their die. Place a landmark block on your board when you land on a color space. Pull off Bank Heists, Shut Downs, and even Mega Shut Downs, to sabotage your rivals. Stack four matching-colored landmark blocks on your board first to win! —description from the publisher

name: Monopoly Grab and Go
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Auction: English;Income;Loans;Lose a Turn;Ownership;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Track Movement;Trading
description: Cha-ching! This Monopoly Grab and Go game is a compact version of the Monopoly game, featuring the same classic Monopoly gameplay in a travel-size format! Like the classic Monopoly game, it’s all about buying, selling, and trading properties to win. Chance or Community cards can be a game changer. Will they make a player richer—or send someone to Jail? This portable travel game for 2 to 4 players is a great family game for adults, teens, and kids ages 8 and up. Plus, the mobile size is just right taking nearly anywhere for on-the-run fun! —description from the publisher

name: Monopoly: Here & Now Electronic Banking
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: From the back of the box: "A modern Monopoly for modern people! Now you can wheel and deal without the hassle of carrying loads of cash on you - especially if it's in millions of pounds! Things have moved on and, just like in the real world, all you need to do is swipe your bank card to transfer your money - it couldn't be easier! The places have also changed to reflect the real London of today that we all know and love - from Bishopsgate to Kensington Palace Gardens!" The game is exactly the same as all the other versions of Monopoly, but has an electronic banking system and "Special Edition themed tokens".

name: Monopoly Hotels
description: Go head-to-head in the Monopoly Hotels game, the 2-player race to build the hottest place in town! It’s all about stacking your floors with the coolest rooms to soar high above your rival’s hotel. Will you build a beach room or an aquarium room? You’ll need to stay sharp and make tough decisions in this game of fast, action-packed fun. Players draw cards to in order to: 1. Build their hotel floors 2. Collect rent 3. Sabotage their opponent's efforts 4. Protect themselves from their opponent Players will have to use their money to buy the hotel floors. The first to 5 wins. Some floors are more expensive than others but will give more money when rent is collected. Get celebrities to stay, collect big rent, and build, build, build to beat your rival to the top! First to 5 floors wins! Sabotage your rival to reach the top first! Rats, floods and dirty laundry! In the roller-coaster game of Monopoly Hotels, everyone’s out to build the best hotel and stop you from getting there first. Your rival will play every card they can to sabotage your hotel, and you’ll need to be just as sneaky! So get ready to bust out the demolition ball, steal your rival’s cash, and cut the power to their hotel. It’s all part of the fun in the race to reach the top first! Features Go head-to-head to build your hotel first First to 5 floors wins Fast, action-packed fun Fortunes change in an instant in this roller-coaster game Stack your hotel with cool rooms Build a beach room to get big rent Sabotage your rival to reach the top first Get celebrity guests and dodge rats, floods and laundry

name: Monopoly Jackpot
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: This is not to be confused with Monopoly Handheld Jackpot which is a handheld battery-operated slot machine. The twist on the venerable property game is that players get to activate a spinner if they land on a Chance space or roll the Chance icon on the dice. The spinner could reward the player with money or bankrupt the player or send the player to jail.

name: Monopoly Jenga
description: When Monopoly meets Jenga... collect the most property and railroad blocks before the tower falls! This game plays similarly to the classic block balancing dexterity game Jenga, but the blocks are painted and some represent different properties you can collect, and you win points for complete sets. Other blocks, such as Chance and Community Chest, have abilities such as letting you steal blocks from opponents. The game even allows players to trade properties, just like the classic Monopoly. When the tower crashes the winner is the player with the most points.

name: Monopoly Junior
mechanics: Dice Rolling;Ownership;Point to Point Movement;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection
description: Join Rich Uncle Pennybags and his nieces and nephews for a thrill-filled day at the Amusements along the Boardwalk - the Roller Coaster, the Magic Show, the Water Slide, the Video Arcade and more. Of course the kids want to get into the act, so they set up Ticket Booths on the Amusements and collect fees from other players who land on them! Set up a Ticket Booth on two Amusements of the same color, and you can collect double the fee! Draw a Chance card and you may take a ride on a Miniature Railroad, win a free Ticket Booth...or pay $3 to visit the Rest Room! With all this money changing hands, sooner or later one of the players runs out - and the player with the most cash on hand wins...

name: Monopoly: Crazy Cash
mechanics: Dice Rolling;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: From the box: The money is “flying” in MONOPOLY Crazy Cash – and the better you play, the zanier the game! Move fast to grab airborne cash as it spits out of the electronic cash machine. Did you just grab a Chance card? Super silly instructions will have you trumpeting like an elephant or swinging imaginary golf clubs. Construct crazy hotels, trade properties and collect rent to keep the cash flowing. Real estate’s never been so much fun! Gameplay is like standard Monopoly, buy properties and collect rent. The main difference is this board has cash machine spaces. Land on this space and the machine shoots out cash and chance cards. When someone runs out of money, or the cash machine runs out, the game is over and the player with the most money wins.

name: Monopoly Junior Game: Disney/Pixar Incredibles 2 Edition
description: Suit up with the Parr family, because it's showtime! Kids can imagine embarking on a super-adventure and explore the locations inspired by the world of the Disney/Pixar Incredibles 2 with this edition of the Monopoly Junior game. The hero who earns the most Monopoly money saves the day. In this easy and fast-playing game, kids travel around the board as Mr. Incredible, Mrs. Incredible, Violet and Dash. Players explore the city, buy unowned properties, collect rent, and pick up Chance cards. The cards feature events from the movie and kids can have a blast imagining being part of the action. —description from the publisher

name: Monopoly Junior KOSMOS
description: Monopoly Junior KOSMOS board game is a fascinating journey into the unknown, taking young players straight into outer space. Rockets, shimmering asteroids, mysterious planets, and orbital stations await to be discovered. This cosmic edition of the classic game stimulates imagination, teaches strategic thinking, and guarantees great fun for the whole family. Key features of the game: Adventurous journey between planets – traverse galaxies, collect minerals, and visit distant corners of space. New challenges and cosmic events – space storms, rocket malfunctions, and unpredictable occurrences add excitement to every game. Kid-friendly rules – simplified mechanics allow children to quickly grasp the rules and start playing. Interactive, educational fun – children learn planning, counting, and decision-making while exploring space-related topics. Attractive design and colorful board – futuristic spaces, shiny graphics, and a unique atmosphere encourage long gameplay sessions. For 2–4 players – an ideal family game that engages both children and adults. Rules of the KOSMOS edition: Choose an astronaut or helper robot token, take MONOPOLY money, and prepare for launch. A dice roll decides the first player. Landing on planet and space station spaces allows you to purchase them, and if they belong to another player, you pay a fee for stopping there. Acquire all spaces of one color, place a token, and increase your cosmic earnings. The winner is the player who gains dominance on the board and drives opponents to bankruptcy. Once you've mastered the basics, try additional rules to create even more exciting gameplay!

name: Monopoly: My Little Pony
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Monopoly: My Little Pony features the familiar Monopoly gameplay, with players rolling dice and moving their tokens around the game board while trying to buy or trade for sets of property in order to bankrupt everyone else and win the game. The figure tokens in Monopoly: My Little Pony are miniatures of the ponies in the television show – Rarity, Fluttershy, Rainbow Dash, Twilight Sparkle, Pinkie Pie and Applejack – while the property locations include Cutie Mark Clubhouse, Everfree Forest, Sweet Apple Acres, Manehattan, and the Crystal Empire.

name: Monopoly Junior: Bakugan Battle Brawlers
mechanics: Point to Point Movement;Roll / Spin and Move
description: This appears to be one of several unlicensed themed versions of Monopoly Junior originating in China. Although Uncle Pennybags appears on the Monopoly Junior logo and (incongruously) on some game spaces and cards, there are no publisher logos or other crediting. It seems there exist at least five cover variations: two with the Bakugan logo under the Monopoly logo ringed by characters, one of them with a flat Monopoly logo and one with a more elaborate fake-3D one; one with the Bakugan logo in the bottom left and three foreground characters; and two with the Bakugan logo at the bottom flanked by two foreground characters, one with English text and one with a Romanian flag and text. The gameplay is identical to regular Monopoly Junior, with a nearly complete lack of player decisions. Players roll and move along the board, automatically purchasing visited properties, drawing chance cards, and performing monetary transactions until someone runs out of money. Properties are a selection of characters and other features from the Bakugan franchise.

name: Monopoly Junior: Benjamin Blümchen
description: In this elephantastic Monopoly Junior game, join Benjamin Blümchen for an exciting stroll through Neustadt Zoo! Meet him, explore his world, and get to know all the adorable zoo babies. Buy the spaces where they play - or pay rent if someone got there first. Play with Benjamin Blümchen and discover the Neustadt Zoo and its charming residents! Includes 4 Benjamin playing pieces. —description from the publisher (translated)

name: Monopoly Junior: Bluey
description: The classic junior version of Monopoly but featuring Bluey and her family. Play all over town with Bluey and her family! Collect dollarbucks and win! Includes Mum, Dad, Bingo, and Bluey tokens!

name: Monopoly Junior: Deep Sea Adventure
description: Join Mr. Monopoly in his submarine as he introduces kids to the exciting world of Monopoly and the fascinating creatures in the ocean. Players buy different marine animals for their aquariums (like the Great White Shark, Sea Otter and Octopus) and charge other players to see them. The diver with the most money and the most aquariums wins the game in this Deep Sea Adventure.

name: Monopoly Junior: Dig 'n Dinos
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Move your paleontologist token from one dig to another on the game board. As you trek around, you'll land on dinosaurs and claim their fossils. Charge other paleontologists to see them as they land on your claims. Collect the most fossils, and the most money to win. --- Publicity blurb: Five- to eight-year-olds will dig this prehistoric edition of Monopoly! They get to play a fun, simplified version of an age-old game, plus they'll love dinosaur "biographies" that teach them all about Jurassic giants! To begin an adventure, roll then die, then move your paleontologist tokens from one dig to another on the game board! As you trek around, you'll land on dinosaurs and claim their fossils. Charge other paleontologists to see them as they come by on the game board. Claim the most fossils-and the most money-and you win! Oppenheim Best Toy Award. Includes game board, money, 24 Chance cards, 4 tokens, die, 48 plastic fossils, and 16 dino "bio" cards.

name: Monopoly Junior: Disney Channel
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Dice Rolling;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Monopoly Junior, Disney Channel Edition is a remake of the original Monopoly game with a new, fun theme. Choose your favorite Disney Channel character and race around the gameboard buying properties as you go. Did you buy The Suite Life with Zack and Cody or Kim Possible? Maybe you bought Jump In! or The Cheetah Girls. If someone lands on a property you own, they'll have to pay you! But watch out for Ms. Darbus and Dr. Drakken. Land on them and you'll have to pay. Collect the most money by the end of the game and you win! This game is designed for children ages 5-8 and comes with the gameboard, 48 plastic televisions, 24 chance cards, 1 pack of play money, 8 character pawns, 4 stands, 1 Die and instructions.

name: Monopoly Junior: Disney Frozen
description: Thaw your frozen friends in this Disney-themed Monopoly game for kids! The fast-trading property game meets the power of snow and ice in this Monopoly Junior game. Kids will join Anna, Elsa and Olaf as they travel through Arendelle and buy its most magical locations. Whoever collects the most cash will thaw their freezing heart and win! Start the Frozen fun with this super-fun version of Monopoly Junior! Includes gameboard, 3 character movers, 24 Chance cards, 36 Character markers, 90 x M1 banknotes, 1 die and instructions. Features: Fast-trading Monopoly Junior game features characters from Frozen Game is like the classic Monopoly game but easier for kids Exclusive Frozen movers Properties are fun places in Arendelle Single banknotes keep the transactions quick and easy

name: Monopoly Junior: Disney Pixar Cars 3 Edition
description: It's the Fast-Dealing Property Trading Game with a Disney Pixar Cars 3 theme! The Monopoly Junior: Cars 3 Edition game is a simple introduction to the iconic Monopoly game. With easy, familiar gameplay and favorite Cars 3 characters, kids can have a fun, fast time as they race around the gameboard. Players move as Lightning McQueen, Cruz Ramirez, Smokey, and Jackson Storm characters as they buy speedways and other memorable Cars 3 locations, collect rent, and discover a fortune in the Chance cards. The player with the most money takes the glory! Includes gameboard, 4 character tokens, 24 Chance cards, 48 character markers, 90 Monopoly banknotes, die, and instructions.

name: Monopoly Junior: Disney Princess
description: In this version of Monopoly Junior players assume the roles of Disney princesses. Choose from Ariel, Pocahontas, Snow White, Belle, Cinderella, Jasmine, Sleeping Beauty, and Mulan. Buy a home, build a castle on it and charge the other players rent to land there. Be be careful not to run into Maleficent or Ursula, or you'll have to pay! Collect the most money by the end of the game to win.

name: Monopoly Junior: Dragons
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Dice Rolling;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Trading
description: Join Hiccup and his friends on a new journey with Monopoly Junior to become the best Dragon Trainer in Berk! Collect dragons using sheep and build your Dragon Training Arenas as you go. Don't forget to look out for the Dragon Training Tips on the way!

name: Monopoly Junior: Eloise's Rawther Exciting Globetrotting Adventure
mechanics: Dice Rolling;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Description from the back of the box: Join Eloise, Weenie, and Skipperdee on a globetrotting adventure around the world. You'll visit Eloise's favorite cities - Paris, Moscow, and of course New York, and learn lots of interesting facts about landmarks and famous places. Along the way you can buy famous properties, put up penthouses and of course say "Charge It Please" when someone comes to visit. The player who collects the most money at the end of the trip wins.

name: Monopoly Junior: Finding Dory edition
description: An edition of Monopoly Junior, with Disney/Pixar Finding Dory theme, that features exclusive Finding Dory tokens. The game is like the classic Monopoly game but easier for kids. And it features properties from Disney/Pixar Finding Dory Movie.

name: Monopoly Junior: Gabby's Dollhouse
description: Looking for Gabby's Dollhouse toys? In this a-meow-zing edition of MONOPOLY Junior, you can play by Gabby's Dollhouse figures! Jump around the game board visiting the Gabby Cats and exploring their rooms, from Cakey’s Kitchen to DJ Catnip's Music Room. Key Features: - PERFECT FOR Gabby's Dollhouse FANS: This new Junior edition of Hasbro's classic board game Monopoly is perfect for younger fans aged 5 and up! - INCLUDES 4 PAPER TOKENS: choose from tokens including Gabby, Pandy Paws or Mercat! and tour recognisable spaces, like Bathroom, Music Room and The Fairy Tail Garden! - UNIQUE GABBY'S DOLLHOUSE GAME BOARD featuring Gabby, Mercat, Pandy Paws, Dj Catnip, Catrat, Cakey, Pillowcat and Baby Box! Who do you like the most? - BUILD YOUR GABBY'S DOLLHOUSE EMPIRE: Buy up pink sets and use your Gabby's themed Monopoly money and Pandy Paws, Mercat, Cakey or Gabby to expand your empire. - WILL YOU OUTSMART YOUR OPPONENTS? Watch out for Kitty Cat Surprise cards, which could help or hinder your chances of success! -description from publisher's website

name: Monopoly Junior: Kung Fu Panda 3
description: The Dragon Warrior of ancient China needs your help! You must travel with Po and take on the great responsibility of training a village of clumsy Pandas to help him defeat the evil Kai... are your kung fu skills sharp enough to fight with Po to victory? Travel around the Valley of Peace, buy Po's journey cards, build Jade Palaces, complete Fortune cookie Mysteries and try to get your hands on as many Chopsticks as possible from Mr Ping's Noodle Box! Belly Gong into this awesome kung fu adventure and give your opponents a heaping dose of justice in this Kung Fu Panda 3 Monopoly Junior! Time for some Skadooshing! —description from the publisher

name: Monopoly Junior: Lemonade
mechanics: Dice Rolling;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection
description: A newer version of Monopoly Junior which has revised gameplay. Gone is the spinner & the dials of the original edition - instead, players work placing lemonade stands onto streets. There are two streets in each color, which form an unbreakable monopoly. Gone as well is the "Loose Change" space from the amusement park version of Monopoly Junior. This version plays quicker & cleaner.

name: Monopoly Junior: Party
description: Monopoly game for kids. Start your kids on a lifelong journey of Monopoly fun with this fast, exciting and easy to learn game. Kids buy properties, get Chance cards and earn cash for passing GO. It's the grown-up game made simple for kids. Perfect little game to get kids used to the classic Monopoly theme of games. They will learn how to count and manage money. They will also have fun collecting their favorite party cards, moveing the cupcake markers and opening the surprise party box. On their turn, they roll and move accordingly. If they land on a party card, they have to pay the value of it and place a gift token of their color on that space. When another player lands on an opponents space, they have to pay the party fee for have landing on that space. This goes on and on until there is a player that runs out of money. At that point the money is counted and the player with the most wins the game.

name: Monopoly Junior: Peppa Pig
description: Play with family Wutz and Peppa Pig. Move around the playground and buy places from Peppa's world! As soon as one player runs out of money, the others count their banknotes. The player with the most money wins. —user summary

name: Monopoly Junior: Planes
categories: Aviation / Flight;Children's Game;Economic;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: A version of Monopoly Junior based on the Disney movie Planes. Collect the most and best characters (properties), and earn the most fuel (money) to win. The board is 7 x 7, with 4 characters (properties) per side, two per color, plus the standard Go, Free Parking, Go to Jail and Jail corners, and finally 2 "Race Challenges" and 2 "Prize Fund" locations (where the railroads would be, but correspond to the Community Chest or Chance cards in the original game). Race Challenges will often have you contribute money to the Prize Fund, which then goes to the next person who lands on those locations. When the game begins, each location has a corresponding card placed on it. As each player lands on those locations and "buys" them, they take the card and mark the location on the board with one of their 10 hangars (houses/hotels, sort of, but that simply mark ownership of locations on the board). Then like in classic Monopoly, other players must pay the fuel cost for that location if they land there. Variants on the basic game allow for monopoly pricing, scoring per the fuel cost on each card (property) instead of simply 1 point per card, and card (property) swaps.

name: Monopoly Junior: Shopkins
description: Description from the publisher: Welcome to Shopville, home to all shopkins. Spend a day in the life of Shopkins, hanging out in the fruit and veg aisle or chatting away in the pantry! Collect as many characters as you can, and use Shopkins money to keep everyone on the go! Pick up shopville challeges and don’t forget to add your money to the Shopkins purse! Go around the board until you are out of money and try to avoid being sent to the frozen aisle! Hang out with all your Shopkins bffs in this special edition of monopoly junior!

name: Monopoly Junior: Shrek 2
description: Travel around the board buying your favorite landmarks from the movie Shrek 2. The game is over when one player runs out of money. For 2 - 4 players Ages 5 and up

name: Monopoly Junior: Sofia the first
description: Trade your lesson books to learn royal lessons in this magical edition of the Monopoly Junior game! Collect and connect the 5 pieces of your royal tiara puzzle to WIN!

name: Monopoly Junior: Super Mario
description: In this Monopoly Junior board game kids can imagine exploring the Mushroom Kingdom with Super Mario artwork, themes, and gameplay. Players move around the gameboard as Mario, Peach, Yoshi, or Luigi buying up properties and collecting coins. The player with the most coins wins. Players roll the power-up die to find out if they can press the Coin Sound Unit featuring the iconic coin sound from Super Mario, and collect coins. Board spaces feature scenes and themes Super Mario fans will recognize including Yoshi's Hill, Cooligan Fields, and Rock-Candy Mines. Monopoly Junior is a good introduction to the Monopoly game. It's designed to be fast, fun, and exciting for younger players.

name: Monopoly Junior: Super Zings
description: Other version of Monopoly Junior now with Super Zings. Choose four different Super Zing exclusive models. Visit and buy your favourite Kaboom City places. Collect the most money by the end of the game to win.

name: Monopoly Junior: Toy Story
description: Simplified game play featuring lots of fun toys makes this game a great introduction to the family favorite. Travel around the game board as Woody, Buzz, Mr. Potato Head or Jessie. You’ll be buying toys like Sarge, Bo Peep, Hamm and more, to find them a good home. When the first player runs out of money, everyone else counts their cash. The player with the most money wins! Comes with a game board, 24 Chance cards, 48 plastic houses, Monopoly Junior money, a die, four cardboard movers and plastic mover stands.

name: Monopoly Junior: Travel Edition
description: Instead of actually collecting sets of properties in this travel edition of Monopoly Junior, players trade ownership of single properties. (Each color group has only one property in it.) Using their tokens as cranks, players update the cleverly-designed inboard displays to indicate ownership and number of ticket booths on the property. The die is replaced by a spinner, as is the deck of chance cards. The only parts left somewhat loose are the dollar bills, for which there are clips for each player, the bank's denominations, and even Loose Change.

name: Monopoly Junior: Trek Alaska
description: Alaskan explorers circle the board buying properties and erecting igloos on them to charge "visitors" rent. There are no deeds to the properties, the color of the igloo denotes ownership. When the first player runs out of money, everyone else counts their cash. The player with the most money wins! Comes with a game board, 24 Chance cards, 48 plastic igloos, Monopoly Junior money, a die, and four colored explorers. There's also a "Trekker's Guide" which is a National Geographic-type folio with information about Alaska. It's not integral to playing the game.

name: Monopoly Junior: Unicorn Edition
description: Collect the most cash while taking an imaginary journey through the colorful world of unicorns! Players move their adorable unicorn token around the board buying and selling properties such as sprinkles, glitter, party hats, and other things unicorns love. It's so much fun for kids to place a "sold" sign on their very own property. And if a player owns both properties in the same color, they can charge double the rent! The Monopoly Junior: Unicorn Edition game is a quick-playing board game designed for kids ages 5 and up, as an introduction to classic Monopoly gameplay.

name: Monopoly Junior: Yo-kai Watch Edition
description: Description from the publisher: With lots of surprises from their favorite Yo-kai characters, kids can have fun playing the Monopoly Junior: Yo-kai Watch edition game. In this simple and fast version of the Monopoly game, players move around the Jibanyan-shaped board and buy up Yo-kai game medals. Throughout the game players collect rent to buy even more Yo-kai game medals, competing to become the first player to fill their Yo-kai game watch with 5 medals and win! The game features 16 Yo-kai game medals and includes 1 exclusive Yo-kai Medal. For 2 to 4 players. Includes gameboard, 4 character tokens, 4 Yo-kai board game watches, 16 Yo-kai board game medals, 1 exclusive Yo-kai Medal (not part of gameplay), 24 Chance cards, money pack, 2 dice, and game guide. Yoi-kai Watch theme Capture the Yo-kai Includes 16 Yo-kai board game medals and one exclusive Yo-kai Medal (not part of gameplay) Quick gameplay Ages 5 and up For 2 to 4 players

name: Monopoly KHL
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection
description: Feel like a high-flying trader in the fast-growing world of professional hockey. Play Monopoly KHL to get new property - teams and conferences. Invest in stands and stadiums and get rents! Make deals with players, follow deals at auction - there are many ways to get what you want. Be creative because there is not enough room at the top for everyone. Bankruptcy Trade is your way to success - you can get it all! It's time to put on your skates and grab your hockey stick on your way to the world's most exciting and prestigious game! The Kontinental Hockey League, formed in 2008, is one of the elite hockey leagues in Europe. The KHL consists of 24 teams, divided into two conferences: East and West, and consists of 4 divisions, which are named after legendary players and coaches: Arkady Chernyshev, Anatoly Tarasov, Valery Kharlamov and Vsevolod Bobrov. The teams compete for the highest award - the Gagarin Cup. Do you want to follow the path of champions? It's time for you ! Become a professional in the Monopoly KHL ! —description from the publisher (translated)

name: Monopoly Knockout
description: In Monopoly Knockout, you compete individually or in teams, taking turns sliding your four tokens down the long three-foot-long game board and trying to land them on properties. At the end of each round, you collect or pay cash based on where your tokens ended up, whether through good aim or an opponent trying to knock you out. Will you land on the best properties or get knocked into jail? Whoever ends up with the most cash wins!

name: Monopoly: The Card Game
description: Rummy for Monopoly fans! Every property on the board has a card for you to collect to form at least one complete set. There are also house, hotel and token cards to multiply the value of your sets. Mr. Monopoly and GO! Cards provide quick points and help fill out the 10-card hand in a 4-player game. Instead of a discard pile, each player has his own trade pile. Players can draw from the deck or exchange their trade piles with other players (whether they like it or not). A stack of money is included but is unnecessary since cash is only used to keep score and cannot be spent or exchanged.

name: Monopoly L.O.L. Surprise!
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Income;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Monopoly, but there are fewer spaces: The board is only eight spaces per side, and each group only consists of two properties. The theme is dolls and pets, and instead of upgrading with houses and hotels, you upgrade with stars and emojis. Finally, Chance and Community Chest have been merged to one stack. —user summary

name: Monopoly La casa de Papel
description: Monopoly: La Casa de Papel (Money Heist Edition) Join the iconic heist! In this thrilling edition of Monopoly, players take on the roles of the Professor’s crew, each with a unique ability. Instead of properties, you compete to control locations like the Royal Mint and the Bank, collecting Gold Bullion and Bags of Cash. Navigate themed event cards, negotiate with other players, evade the Police, and attempt to outsmart opponents—all to build the largest fortune and win. Designed for 2–6 players (ages 12+), with playtimes ranging from 1 to 2 hours. This variant merges classic Monopoly mechanics with the tension and excitement of Money Heist.

name: Monopoly Live
description: Hasbro describes it as: "Go live! In this fun version of the classic MONOPOLY game, the electronic talking tower calls the plays! With motion sensing, sound effects and even surprise mini games, the tower guides the game from start to finish while you wheel, deal and call the shots! Slide the cab around the track to take a shortcut, play a quick game and then manage your cash at the ATM. With so many things to do, the “real estate market” is more thrilling than ever! Includes electronic talking tower, gameboard, 4 game pieces, 4 bank cards, 4 card slots, cab and track, title deed cards, 32 houses, 12 hotels, 2 “green” pieces and startup guide." Played with an IR tower containing a camera and reflective pieces and option spaces it seem to remove the need for book keeping, dice rolling, cards. And there's no money either. Kinda like a video game version just in real life.

name: Monopoly Millionaire
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: It's Monopoly, but it's not! Here are some ways that it is different: 1) You win when you have $1 million in cash. 2) You can upgrade your playing piece to have a better chance of winning. (Your salary for passing Go is bumped up, and you can potentially make more money from the Chance/Millionaire Lifestyle cards.) 3) Property spaces start with Fortune cards on them. (These allow you to build houses for free, force you to auction a property, or even allow you to steal properties from other players.) 4) No paper money. All the money is on little tiles. 4) No banker necessary because the money tiles are placed in the middle of the board. 5) No taxes, no railroads, no utilities. The board only has 8 spaces per side instead of the usual 10. Otherwise most of this game is stuff you will recognize from the original. Many gamers will be pleased to hear that this game puts a stronger focus on auctioning unpurchased properties, instead of the classic house rule of leaving it unowned. Also the $1-million victory reduces the odds of player elimination and multi-hour games.

name: Monopoly Millionaire Deal Card Game
description: From Hasbro website: "It's a brand new way to play the classic property trading game! Be the first in this card game to get a million dollars in your bank pile and win MONOPOLY Millionaire Deal! Pick up cards when it's your turn and play any combination of Money, Action and Property cards. Don't hesitate to steal a property or set of properties from another player if you get the right action cards, but hang on to the Just Say No card in case someone tries to do the same to you! Build up property sets, gather piles of money and keep wheeling and dealing to make that million! Win the MONOPOLY Millionaire Deal card game by making a million dollars! Earn and swap properties and charge other players rent! Steal properties or sets of properties from other players when you get the right Action card! Just Say No card protects you from other players' thefts!"

name: Monopoly Movers
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: A collectable version of the classic game Monopoly. This edition comes in the form of a die-cast semi-tractor trailer truck. The trailer opens to reveal a miniature version of the standard game.

name: Monopoly of Three Kingdoms
description: This is a monopoly-like game with three kingdom's theme.Roll your dice,buy locations,employ generals to conquer other lords and unite ancient China. Some rules differences between this and Monopoly: Each player starts with a property and their starting space is that starting property rather than the Go space (called the palace in this game). For example, Cao Cao starts the game at Chen Liu and owning that deed. In addition, the colored set corresponding to the starting property of that pawn is also free to purchase for that pawn when landing on it. For example, Cao Cao can buy any blue property (including Chen Liu if he ever lost it, Shou Chun, or Xia Pi) for free when landing on it and no one owns it. No bonus for completing a colored set. Unlike monopoly, you can start building "houses" (camps in this game) even w/o collecting a complete colored set. However, you can only build them when you land on a property and only on that property. Only 3 houses before a "hotel" (city [walls] in this game). Free parking space replaced by a Shrine space where if you land on it, any accumulated money in that space is split between the player that landed on it and the bank at around 50/50. Jail/Just visiting space replaced by maintenance space Each player pays 200 taels [aka gold] per property owned (doesn't matter about houses). Player who pays the LEAST money from this gets a free camp built on a property of their choice. Money paid for maintenance goes to the shrine space. Go to Jail space replaced by a Disaster Aid space. Each player pays 10% rounded down to the nearest 100 taels of their current cash on hand to the shrine space. The player that pays the MOST money from this gets a free camp built on a property of their choice. Community Chest cards are called Secret Pouches (ala Zhuge Liang) and are generally somewhat more powerful than in Monopoly, though some are still weak as well. Chance spaces replaced by a Tavern space where you can recruit officers to join you. Only 3 officers are displayed at a time and these 3 are replaced whether or not you recruit one after landing on a Tavern Space. Each player can recruit a total of 3 officers, which each officer having a special passive ability specific to that officer. For example, Diao Chan forces an opponent paying rent to you to pay an additional 1500. Lu Bu allows you to not pay any rent for landing on a space, but after using him, you must put him back at the bottom of the officer draw deck. There are a total of 30 officers to choose from. After a player goes bankrupt, that player actually submits to the player that caused the bankruptcy. The bankrupt player is now considered a Subordinate while his master is considered the "New Ruler". They share resources, officers, and properties. The New Ruler essentially gets to move two pawns per turn instead of one, with the Subordinate rolling his own moves but the results of the space the Subordinate's pawn landing on being resolved by the New Ruler. This keeps the subordinate tied to the game instead of being completely eliminated. When the ruler wins, the subordinate gets second place. There can be multiple levels of subordinates as a result of cascading bankruptcies etc. The game is won when only one ruler is left and the rest are his subordinates. Overall, a more complex game than monopoly, especially cause of the officer cards and the somewhat more powerful community chest. Also, the free camps from the maintenance and disaster aid spaces promote hoarding of cash while developing only a few properties normally. Easily expandable to 6, 7, or 8 players, really. Though that'll increase the game length dramatically, of course.

name: Monopoly Party
description: This new Monopoly Party Edition is a fun twist on Hasbro’s classic board game, designed for 2–6 players ages 16 and up. It features 8 collectible metal tokens shaped like animals and everyday objects, and a unique party-themed board with locations such as seats, couches, and vehicles. Players can build their own “party empire” by buying furniture and vehicle sets, using themed Monopoly money to expand with houses and hotels. As always, Chance and Community Chest cards can either boost your success or set you back, making it the perfect game for lively gatherings.

name: Monopoly Peru
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Special Monopoly edition for Peru.

name: Monopoly Pizza Game
description: In Monopoly Pizza Game, players move around the game board trying to buy as many types of pizza as they can, from pepperoni to spinach to mushroom. Instead of buying properties or collecting rent, players aim to collect a color set that corresponds to a type of pizza, such as veggie lovers, barbecue chicken, or even mac and cheese. A full set of flavors combines to make an awesome new pizza, giving those cards a higher value. At the end of the game, the player who collects the most pizza slices wins!

name: Monopoly Playmaster
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: An electronic Monopoly accessory that adds auctions and Mortgage "calls' to the game. The electronic play aid also keeps track of player token locations and rolls the dice. It knows which properties are bought and which ones are still available. The only things it can't keep track of are the Community Chest and Chance cards. Eight simple tunes indicate certain game actions and can get a little annoying at times (e.g.- "I've Been Working on the Railroad" plays every time someone lands on a railroad), but overall the presentation is well done.

name: Monopoly: Pokémon Kanto Edition
categories: Children's Game;Economic;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Negotiation;Video Game Theme
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Join Pikachu and friends on an adventure through the Kanto Region! In this special Pokémon: Kanto Edition of Monopoly you'll travel through all eight gyms and battle Gym Leader Pokémon. Trainer Battle and Professor Oak cards might reward you for Pokémon encounters, or bring an unexpected surprise. Buy, sell and trade with other Pokémon Trainers to get a powerful Pokémon team and win the game! --description from publisher Monopoly: Pokémon Kanto Edition is a special edition of the classic Monopoly game themed after Pokemon, specifically based on the Kanto region. It is the third version of Pokémon Monopoly. Pokémon themed game board features the Kanto Region and all 8 gyms Includes 6 collectible metal tokens: Pikachu, Bulbasaur, Charmander, Squirtle, Eevee, Jigglypuff Custom sculpted Poké Marts and Pokémon Centers replace traditional Houses and Hotels Professor Oak and Trainer Battle Cards replace Chance and Community Chest Cards Custom Pokémon Money replaces original Monopoly bills

name: Monopoly Polska
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Income;Lose a Turn;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Track Movement;Trading
description: Monopoly Polska is a beautiful game designed for everyone who loves to play board games. In this edition based on the original one, the places You visit was changed to the local Poland favorite places. Those were chosen in the national vote! Invest wisely, be a tough negotiator - there is only one winner. Find your own way to get a fortune!

name: Monopoly Prizm: NBA Edition
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Collect, trade, and compete in Monopoly Prizm: NBA Edition, which allows players to compete and earn points by revealing the NBA player ratings and stats on the backs of their Panini NBA trading cards. To start, you use the Panini cards to draft your own team of four NBA players, then instead of buying properties, you try to take control of NBA games and collect bonus points when opponents land on them. To earn points, you compare the stats on your Panini cards against others when competing in playmaker challenges and All-Star Contests. You can also use the Panini cards to trade NBA players or draft new ones. At the end of the game, whoever has the most points wins. The game includes one 8-card Starter Pack and two 4-card Prizm Packs featuring Stephen Curry, Luka Doncic, Ja Morant, and other players. Additional cards are sold in booster packs.

name: Monopoly: Friends – The TV Series
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Monopoly is a roll-and-move game where players move around the game board buying or trading properties, developing their properties with houses and hotels. When opponents land on players owned property, the owning player collects rent from the landing player. Owning sets of properties increases the rent paid to the player who owns them, by the player who lands on the square. The ultimate goal is to have the most money and drive opponents into bankruptcy. From the rear of the box: Whooopah! It’s time to join the legendary friends, from one of TV’s best-loved sitcoms in Friends Monopoly. Play as either Ross, Rachel, Phoebe, Monica, Joey or Chandler by choosing one of the exclusive tokens which are iconic to the gang; will it be Rachel’s handbag, Ross’ dinosaur, Chandler’s sweater vest or even Phoebe’s acoustic guitar? As you pi-VOT round the board you will discover the best Friends’ moments, from unmistakable Holiday Armadillo, to the hilarious Giant Poking Device and Monica and Chandler’s eventful, yet unforgettable wedding! Enter the world of Friends Monopoly! You’re gonna love it! PROPERTIES BROWN Monica Gets a Roommate / Rachel Finds Out LIGHT BLUE Ross Finds Out / Giant Poking Device / No One's Ready PINK At The Beach / With The Cat / All The Wedding Dresses ORANGE All The Thanksgivings / With The Cop / Ross' Teeth RED The Routine / All The Candy / Holiday Armadillo YELLOW Monica & Chandler's Wedding / The Halloween Party / Rachel Has A Baby, Part 2 GREEN The Lottery / In Barbados / Phoebe Gets Married DARK BLUE The Last One, Part 1 / The Last One, Part 2 STATIONS Relaxi Taxi / Phoebe's Grandma's Taxi / Monica's Sportscar / Joey's Boat UTILITIES Treeger's Electricity Maintenance / Treeger's Water Maintenance TAXES Central Perk Tab / Lose At American Football COMMUNITY CHEST / CHANCE APARTMENT 19 / APARTMENT 20

name: Monopoly Revolution
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Monopoly with a circular board. No paper money is used, instead it uses a credit card setup with an electronic device that also substitutes chance cards and produces sound effects and music according to the events of the game.

name: Monopoly Saalfeld: Rudolstadt – Bad Blankenburg
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: A classic Monopoly based on Saalfeld, Rudolstadt and Bad Blankenburg. The worlds first three cities edition.

name: Monopoly Scrabble
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;End Game Bonuses;Hand Management;Income;Loans;Lose a Turn;Ownership;Set Collection;Spelling;Square Grid;Tile Placement;Trading
description: Monopoly Scrabble combines elements of both Monopoly and Scrabble, with players using letter tiles to build words, then moving around the game board based on their score. Build a word on a premium space, and you immediately claim a property. Custom Community Chest and Chance cards keep things moving at a fast pace. When the final letter tile has been played, whoever has the highest total of cash and property value wins.

name: Monopoly Secret Vault
description: Guess the code and get rich! The Monopoly Secret Vault board game for kids 8+ features Mr. Monopoly's vault filled with valuable items that give players more wealth. Begin by filling the vault with riches. Each time a player unlocks it and gets what's inside, it gets refilled with more valuables. Which means there are always plenty of riches to unlock! To open the vault, players guess the code, which is a random number from 1 to 6. Be sure to pay attention to numbers already guessed! In this exciting family board game for 2-6 players, each time the vault is opened, the code randomly resets. Along with Monopoly Money, there are hotels that players can only find in the vault, plus keys to locked properties. The player with the most money at the end of the game wins! MONOPOLY GAME WITH VAULT: In the Monopoly Secret Vault board game, Mr. Monopoly gives players chances to take riches from his vault -- if they can guess the code to unlock it CRACK THE CODE AND GET RICH: Players buy properties and collect rent, but in this edition players try to guess the codes to open the vault as many times as possible FIND MONEY, HOTELS, AND KEYS TO LOCKED PROPERTIES: Inside the vault, find money, hotels, and cardboard keys that allow players to unlock properties THEMED MONOPOLY TOKENS: Features tokens including Scottie, Top Hat, T-Rex, Hazel. Racecar, and Rubber Ducky -- all designed to look like they're ready to break into the vault ENTERTAINING FAMILY GAME: The Monopoly Secret Vault board game for 2-6 players is fun for adults, teens, and kids ages 8 and up. It’s a great choice for family game nights, parties, and get-togethers —description from the publisher

name: Monopoly: Singapore
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Typical regional Monopoly game. Place names are specific to Singapore, for example: Boardwalk - Queen Astrid Park Park Place - Nassim Road Reading RR - Ang Mo Kio Station All prices and currency amounts are multiplied (inflated?) by a factor of 10, including the cash, which otherwise looks almost exactly like that in a US set, from white 10s to orange 5000s, and yes - the most numerous are green 200s. Also includes a (white metal die-cast) "Merlion" token, which is the official mascot of Singapore. The "Merlion" is a mythical creature with the head of a lion and the body of a fish. Note that earlier versions (~ before 2000s) do not include the "Merlion" token.

name: Monopoly Space
description: The Earth is so yesterday that it is time to conquer the whole universe! In this astro-themed version of Monopoly, players travel around in space to buy planets, mine resources, and build their colony. The resources are used to build the domes that make up the colony. The players have to move fast before the other players take the glory. The first player to complete their space colony and get back to GO (the Earth) wins.

name: Monopoly Speed
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Dice Rolling;Income;Player Elimination;Real-Time;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Monopoly Speed can be played in under ten minutes! Everyone rolls and buys at once, so players don't have to wait for their turn. During four rounds, players race against the timer to buy, trade, and sell properties faster than ever. The timer counts down each buying and trading stage, and there's no break between stages. The game board has two GO spaces, and players can get out of jail free every time. —description from the publisher A version of monopoly that was published for the Christmas period of 2019, designed to be finished I will be 10 minutes. The game is played with an electronic timer which keeps track of the 2 phases of the game (Buy/Trade). Each phase lasts approximately 1.5 mins. Game play differences from standard monopoly: Single monetary denomination ($1000) Timed play Simultaneous turns, all players have their own dice No rent on properties Objective cards Alternate Chance and Community Chance cards Some locations removed. 2 Pass Go spaces. Players compete to finish the game with the most value in money and assets. Objectives and property sets earn additional value at the end of the game.

name: Monopoly: Spider-Man
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading

Thwart the villains' plan to buy, rent and sell everything they can get their hands on in a race to the finish. The one with the most money in the end will control it all! You can play by classic Monopoly game rules or use Spider-Man's Optional Rule for a faster game. Contents of Monopoly - Spider-Man 3 Edition: * 1 Gameboard * Title Deed Cards * Play Money & Banker's Tray * 16 Spider-Man Cards * 16 Black-suited Spider-Man Cards * 6 Spider-Man-themed Tokens * 32 Apartments * 12 Skyscrapers * 2 Dice

Shape your destiny with the Force and Smuggler’s Cargo cards! Collect classic scenes and iconic ship from 1977 movie! Build Fleets and Bases, and side with the Rebels or the Empire! —description from the publisher

name: Monopoly: Star Wars Complete Saga Edition
description: The classic Monopoly game in a tribute to all 3 Star Wars trilogies. Instead of houses and hotels, you'll find Tie Fighters and X-Wings. Characters to choose are Darth Maul, Padme Amidala, Darth Vader, Han Solo, Leia, Luke, Kylo Ren, Chewbacca, and Rey. Currency is in the form of "credits" (cardboard chips) and are found in 10s and 50s.

name: Monopoly Technisches Hilfswerk
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Income;Loans;Lose a Turn;Ownership;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Track Movement;Trading
description: Monopoly, the world-famous game of property and real estate, takes you into the wide world of the THW with this edition. Floods, gas explosion, storm damage - The THW normally comes if there are big damage situations or special forces are needed. The playing figures are special transport vehicles and devices. The fields are related to the different fields, where THW supports. The main rules are the same as in the normal Monopoly.

name: Monopoly Town
description: This is a preschool level version of Monopoly with some effort at providing educational value. Push Mr Monopoly's head and then move forward as many spaces as he tells you. Involves the usual Monopoly gameplay of building and collecting rent. Publisher's description: " Join Mr. Monopoly as he makes his way around town! Mr. Monopoly does all the talking to guide you through town-if he tells you to move forward 2 spaces, you know what to do! If you make a mistake, he'll let you know! Play money and building blocks help make counting fun. And building is easy-just add a block when you land on a colored space. No reading required. Game board comes with Mr. Monopoly in a car, track (in 4 pieces), play money, green building blocks, 28 roofs and instructions. Adult assembly required."

name: Monopoly Travel World Tour
description: The Monopoly Travel World Tour board game is a twist on classic Monopoly board gameplay! Now, players can discover and visit exciting travel destinations. Players buy destinations, complete travel goals and stamp the dry wipe gameboard with their playing piece stamper to win.

When opponents land on players owned property, the owning player collects rent from the landing player. Owning sets of properties increases the rent paid to the player who owns them, by the player who lands on the square. The ultimate goal is to have the most money and drive opponents into bankruptcy. With this edition you get into the world of the legendary Wacken Open Air Festival. Not only for Metalheads.

mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Income;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: The most famous board game in the world - now with the 22 most popular cities in the world. Collectible figures showing Landmarks from countries all over the world. A new innovative game mechanism: The bank card reader with Deal button extends the classic Monopoly fun! Like in real life the cash is not needed any more. Bank cards are used to pay and receive money. —description from the publisher

name: Monopoly: European Edition
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: This version was released in celebration of the EU for 1992. The player tokens are beautiful monuments from major cities in Europe. There are 12 monuments (one for each country that was part of the EU in 1992). ECU's (Euros) are used for cash and the dice have EU stars on them instead of numbers or dots. Instead of stations there are airports located in the capitals of four 'smaller' member states, the streets are from the other eight member states.

name: Monopoly:  80th Anniversary Edition
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Buy, buy, buy at every location, location, location and celebrate the 80th anniversary of the classic game of Monopoly! This anniversary version of the classic fast-trading property game features tokens from the 1930s all the way to the 2000s! With a retro gameboard and cards, the game takes you back to when it all began, but you still have to build your houses and hotels and see if you can bankrupt everyone else. You better keep an eye on your money, because you never know when the dice will land you with a massive rent bill to pay. Sometimes staying In Jail can be the safest place to be, but only after your properties are primed to make you money. You've got to buy, sell and negotiate to win at this 80th anniversary version of Monopoly! Features: Monopoly game commemorates the 80th anniversary of the fast-trading property game Includes tokens from the 1930s through the 2000s You’ll buy, sell and trade to win Build houses and hotels on your properties Chance and Community Chest cards can change your fortunes Ages 8 and up For 2 to 8 players.

name: Monopoly:  Builder
description: Travel the board buying properties, collecting rent and resources, and using builder’s blocks to build your island city. The game ends when the penthouse has been built. Buildings are built on a center map using resources collected during the game. The height of each building determines it’s worth at the end of the game Score bonus points for having the most money, having the most contiguous buildings on the center map, and having sets of properties. The player with the most points at the end wins.

mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Monopoly is a roll-and-move game where players move around the game board buying or trading properties, developing their properties with houses and hotels. From the rear of the box: Accra, which elegantly stretches along the Atlantic coast of Ghana, is the country’s capital and largest city, with an estimated urbanpopulation of 2.3 million. Originally built around a port, it served the capital of the British Gold Coast between 1877 and 1957. Accra has since transitioned into a modern, growing metropolis, the city reflects a history ranging from the 19th century architecture to modern skyscrapers and apartment blocks. Accra is the home to the Kotoka International Airport and is your gateway to original Ghanaian hospitality, peace and joie de vivre! Accra is also home to many restaurants and “chop bars”, where you can sample authentic, divine-tasting Ghanaian and continental dishes. The city is vibrant and serves as Ghana’s economic, administrative, cultural and entertainment hub. The world famous Azonto dance, among several other dance genres, originated from Accra. Accra is also home to some beautiful sandy beaches. Tourism is thriving in Accra and the country as a whole. In 2010, the Globalization and World Cities Research Network designated Accra a Gamma-minus-level world city, indicating a growing level of international influence and connectedness. Its entry into the internationally acclaimed MONOPOLY family underscores its unique status as an emerging tourism and business city. The City of Accra Edition provides an exceptional city tour. It captures the rich diversity of the city’s exciting offerings and highlights the extent to which it has evolved over the past decade. You can now play this classic game with Accra’s street names and some of its most recognised landmarks. Savour a piece of the true magic that the City of Accra exudes, and experience its energy and pace. At the same time you will learn about Ghana from an architectural and historical point of view. Find your favourite Accra hotspot, roll the dice and build your property empire from Nima to Ridge via Airport City in this special edition of this most famous board game. In 2013, the New York Times, named Accra as one of its top Travel destinations and listed it 4th on their “46 places to go in 2013”. The prestigious paper described the city as “a buzzing metropolis ready for business and pleasure”. “Charley, welcome aboard!”

mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: This is a redo of the old classic, available as a limited edition only through the National World War II Museum in New Orleans, LA. There are six new tokens - B-17 Bomber, combat boots, cathedral radio, LCVP, Sherman tank and American combat helmet. Chance and Community Chest turn into Allies and Home Front. Houses turn into camps and hotels turn into headquarters.

mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading

Celebrate Discovery Channel's most watched series as you go full throttle as you buy, sell and trade the Teutul’s most outrageous custom choppers. From the Black Widow Bike and Comanche Bike to the Jet Bike and POW/MIA Bike, relive the excitement and drama created by Paul Sr., Junior, Mikey and the entire Orange County Choppers crew as they race to complete their one-of-a-kind choppers. The American Chopper edition of America’s favorite board game comes complete with 6 collectible pewter tokens including Paul Sr., Paul Jr. Mikey, the Tool Bike Tire, a welder’s mask and the Future Bike. Rules include a 60 minute speed play option for a shorter game with the same amount of fun. "Fire Her Up!"

You can play as Red, Bomb, Ice or Stella, and your goal is to buy as many Angry Birds properties as you can in this fast-trading game. You’ve got to launch your tokens to get extra money, and if you finish with the most money, you win.

mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: It’s been 10 years since the Animaccord team started the production of the Marsha and the Bear cartoon. The series, which today, without any overstatement, has been a worldwide YouTube phenomenon that has conquered the hearts of billions of kids and their parents throughout the world. This special board game is created and issued to mark the 10th anniversary of Animaccord Studio’s establishment. Step by step, you will pass through all stages of production of an animated series – starting with script writing all the way to the first episode releasing on air. Will you be able to sell the brand’s licensing for the creation of consumer products? Are you ready to be at the top of your industry and get international success? The game vividly shows all the obstacles that the Animaccord studio has handled over the last 10 years. Just like in real life, you will face the design, technical, and financial issues, as well as the legal specifics of business management – simply everything behind the scenes of the tremendously popular cartoon. Feels like a challenge? Of course! But, we believe that you will accomplish this mission and find success with your beloved heroes. Marsha and the Bear despite all obstacles you will face on your path. The Animaccord team has done it, so can you!
