description: This edition of Monopoly was produced for the Ariel Investments company. The token are a tortoise (the symbol of the firm), a sleeping hare, a bull, a bear, a dollar sign and a loving cup. The money,title deeds, Chance and Community Chest cards are customized. All the title deeds are named for Ariel properties. Stock exchanges replace the railroad spaces. The Chance and Community Chest cards are renamed Fork In The Road and Ariel Community Academy. Players roll dice to determine how far they move. Landing on a space gives the player the option of buying the property. When a player collects all the properties in one color group, the properties can be improved by building. When players land on a space owned by another player they must pay rent. Rent is determined by the location of the property and the number of improvements on the space. Some spaces instruct a player to draw a card which can be beneficial or harmful to the player. Players must avoid going bankrupt to stay in the game. The winner is the last player left in the game.

By playing, with family or friends, you will progress from town to village, from plains to valleys and discover the exceptional landscapes of the Pyrenees. An ideal setting for practicing outdoor activities, summer and winter. Let yourself be seduced by a remarkable natural heritage, browse 14,000 years of history from cro-magnon to the present day through the Cathar castles, Ariege will have no secrets for you. With the Ariège Monopoly, play to buy the properties of the department of Ariège between friends or family. Build houses and hotels will allow you to win a maximum of rents during the game to be able to win it. At auctions, negotiate with your opponents to win the bet at the best price and acquire the most goods. It will take risks and be the smartest to win the game!

mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Whereas the hat, car, iron, and other token pieces represent players in the normal version of Monopoly, Monopoly: Assassin's Creed lets you choose between the series' different protagonists. You can play as Altair, Ezio, Connor Kenway, his grandfather Edward Kenway, Aveline, or the protagonist of Assassin's Creed Unity, Arno Dorian. Other game pieces have also be changed to match the Assassin's Creed theme. Money has been replaced with Abstergo credits, and the usual real estate is swapped out for historical locations featured in the Assassin's Creed series, with Abstergo Industries and Abstergo Entertainment replacing the game's original prime properties: Boardwalk and Park Place.

name: Monopoly: Assassin's Creed Syndicate
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: The universe of Assassin's Creed puts the fan in the middle of an ancient struggle between two factions - The Assassins, who fight to protect mankind's right to freedom, and the Templars, who wish to impose a New World Order. Join the Brotherhood in Assassin's Creed Monopoly and revisit the most iconic locations of the series with breathtaking concept art. Past and present collide as you walk in the footsteps of the Assassins Altair, Ezio, Aveline, Connor, Edward, using the special Assassins playing pieces. Show off your Assassin's Creed Monopoly parkour skills and invest, negotiate, and trade your way to victory. What type of strategy will you choose? Should you try to collect as much as you can, or focus on specific targets? —description from the publisher

You bring the most important moments of the comic classic to life. Build as many huts and hostels as possible on the fields to win. The instructions on the Potions and Community Cauldron cards will get you there quickly. But beware: they also have one or two surprises in store.

mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Edition of Monopoly based on the English football team Aston Villa FC. The traditional Monopoly properties are replaced by footballers past and present. From the publisher: This new edition of Aston Villa FC Monopoly celebrates the historic figures of Villa's glorious past and the stars from Gerard Houllier’s modern-day squad. With Marc Albrighton, Stephen Ireland and James Collins taking their place alongside greats like Ron Saunders, Dwight Yorke and Tony Morley. This is a must-have for any fan of the Villans.

name: Monopoly: Astronomy
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Another Monopoly variant. Utilities are replaced by observatories, railroads by telescope manufacturers and properties by celestial bodies. The pewter pieces are: radio telescope, telescope in dome, Hubble Space Telescope, Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope, binoculars and lawn chair.

name: Monopoly: At Home Reality
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection
description: Make the most of being stuck at home with the Monopoly At Home Reality game. This family board game celebrates the new way of living. Board spaces are rooms in the house -- the bedroom is the office, the living room is the movie theater, and the kitchen is the school. The gameplay is similar to the standard Monopoly board game but with humorous differences. Tokens can't share a space because of social distancing, and players will want to watch out for the screaming child because they'll have to pay to entertain the kid. This version of the Monopoly game makes the most of life at home with social distancing and missed activities like visiting a movie theater, yoga studio, and more. HILARIOUS TOKENS: Racecar with parking boot, Rubber duck with babies, T-Rex with boxer shorts, smaller dog, penguin with coffee cup, Cat with bath cap., UPDATED UTILITIES AND HOME-THEMED BOARD SPACES: In this family board game, WiFi and video streaming are necessary utilities, and board spaces are places in the home, such as the kitchen turned school. AVOID THE SCREAMING CHILD: When a player moves their token, they also move the screaming child; if the tokens land on the same space, the player must pay to entertain the screaming child. "Community Chest" becomes the "Community Cupboard". Chance is still called Chance, but is now illustrated with boxes shipped from online orders. The money tweaks the classic design to look like a house, and each denomination features different food items inside the 'house'.

name: Monopoly: Atalanta
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Lose a Turn;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Atalanta football team themed Monopoly. Atalanta Bergamasca Calcio is the football team of the city of Bergamo in Lombardy, Italy. Named after the Greek mythology heroine, the club has a long history since its founding in 1907. Choose your token, place it on GO! and roll the dice to own it all! There can be only one winner in the Monopoly game. Will it be you? Fast-dealing property trading game. Players buy, sell and trade properties to win. Build houses and hotels on properties. Change your fortune with Chance and Community Chest cards. And bankrupt your opponents to win it all.

name: Monopoly: Ath – Cité des Géants
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Income;Lose a Turn;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Official Monopoly game for the City of Ath in Belgium. Properties include La Jardinerie de Beloeil, Chez Pauchea, Le Drink des Primeveres, La Jeune Chambre D'Ath, and Chez Loiselet. La ville d’Ath est attestée depuis le Moyen-Age. En 1166, le comte du Hainaut Baudouin IV fait construire un puissant donjon, la tour Burbant, au confluent des Dendres orientale et occidentale. Peu à peu, une cité se crée et se développe. L’église Saint-Julien avec son clocher caractéristique est édifiée au début du 15ème siècle. L’hôtel de ville baroque remonte au règne des Archiducs Albert et Isabelle. Enfin, au milieu du 17ème siècle, le maréchal Vauban fortifie la cité et en fait une des plus belles place-fortes d’Europe. Mais aujourd’hui, ce sont des personnages gigantesques qui font la renommée d’Ath. Goliath et son épouse, et tous leurs congénères, sont les emblèmes de la Ducasse, reconnue chef-d’œuvre de l’humanité par l’Unesco. Chaque année, le quatrième week-end d’Août, des milliers de visiteurs se donnent rendez-vous à Ath pour vibrer au rythme des Géants. —description from the publisher

name: Monopoly: Athletic Club Bilbao

Una edición exclusiva de Monopoly que incluye características diferenciadoras de las versiones normales del juego, como las casillas, que en vez de calles son momentos históricos y lugares emblemáticos del equipo rojiblanco como San Mamés, Lezama, la primera Liga, el equipo femenino, etc. Asímismo, las casas y hoteles se convierten ahora en gradas y estadios. Las casillas 'Paseo del Prado' y 'Paseo de la Castellana', las más caras en la versión tradicional son aquí el escudo actual (400M) y la bandera (350M), las más baratas, justamente, el primer emblema e imagen del club rojiblanco.

mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading

Braves fans now have the opportunity to buy, sell and trade Braves players, coaches, announcers and team icons. Features legendary Braves players like Hank Aaron, John Smoltz and Andruw Jones. Includes six collectible pewter tokens: Braves hat, batter, pitcher, ball in glove, Georgia dog and the Atlanta Braves tomahawk. With some of the all-time greatest Major League Baseball players and a bright future ahead, the Braves continue to make for exciting play in this timeless game of risk taking and deal making. Bankrupt your opponents in a quest to own the Braves.

Roll the dice and move around the board thanks to the pawns and travel through the best of the history of Atletico Madrid - stadiums, best players, and the great victories in team history. ¡Conviértete en un exitoso manager de uno de los clubs de fútbol más importantes de Europa! ¡Con el divertido Monopoly del Atlético de Madrid! Prepárate para un emocionante viaje por los mejores lugares y momentos del club de la capital, invierte en gradas y estadios para derrotar a tus rivales y convertirte en el dueño de todo. ¡Negocia tu camino al éxito con el juego de las propiedades más famoso y genial! ¡En esta ocasión junto al club de tus amores, el Atletico de Madrid! Descubre el resto de emocionantes versiones del clásico Monopoly, encuentra versiones clásicas, modernas, de tus series favoritas y mucho más.

mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Classic Monopoly with the properties and currency, along with some special spaces and cards, re-themed with Boston-centric details. Gameplay On his turn, a player rolls two dice and moves that number of spaces around the board. If the player lands on an as-yet-unowned property, he has the opportunity to buy it and add it to his portfolio or allow the bank to auction it to the highest bidder. If a player owns all the spaces within a color group, he may then build houses and hotels on these spaces, generating even more income from opponents who land there. If he lands on a property owned by another player, he must pay that player rent according to the value of the land and any buildings on it. There are other places on the board which can not be bought, but instead require the player to draw a card and perform the action on the card, pay taxes, collect income, or even go to jail. Goal The goal of the game is to be the last player remaining with any money.

The game is based off of Pixar 's first fairy tale film, Brave and is released by Walt Disney Pictures.

name: Monopoly: Breaking Bad

Includes: 1 Game Board 6 Collectible Tokens: Heisenberg Hat, Tio’s Bell, Money Barrel, Gas Mask, Pink Teddy Bear, RV 32 Houses renamed Tented Houses 12 Hotels renamed SuperLabs 16 Community Chest Cards renamed Heisenberg Cards 16 Chance Cards renamed Walter White Cards Custom themed money 2 Dice Rules —description from the publisher's website

mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading

With seven million visitors each year, Australia’s new World City has a reputation as a fantastic lifestyle city, which will be played out in the world’s favourite game. The spirit and shape of this customised edition will remain the same as the traditional game, but now you will be able to buy and own your favourite Brisbane suburbs and landmarks! There will also be lots of twists and changes too, including Brisbane-themed Community Chest and Chance cards

mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Auction: English;Dice Rolling;Income;Investment;Lose a Turn;Ownership;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading;Zone of Control
description: Get in the zone with the “Princess of Pop” in this chart-topping edition of the classic family game! MONOPOLY: Britney Spears takes players and fans on a musical journey through her most popular hits to buy, sell, and trade songs like “Baby One More Time”, “Toxic”, “Lucky”, and more! Tokens inspired by unforgettable music videos such as an astronaut, milkshake tray, and basketball take you around the board to rack up Gold Records and Platinum Records. Be the last one standing with hard-earned riches (until oops, you’ve bankrupted your friends again) to win! —description from the publisher

name: Monopoly: Brugge
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: The Monopoly Brugge edition of the game remains true to the original concept but was given a Bruges look in terms of content and graphics. All locations are filled in with well-known streets, squares and sights of Bruges. Not only the locations, but also the graphical design radiates Bruges. The box, the board and the properties are given a Bruges look & feel. Also, the Community Chest and Chance cards have not only been changed in terms of look and feel, but are also interspersed with numerous Bruges references. Only 4000 made.

name: Monopoly: Bundeswehr
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Trading
description: Monopoly: Bundeswehr NEW GAME FUN: For you we have linked the world-famous original Monopoly board game with the Bundeswehr life. Put together your own armed forces, buy offices, training areas and show your strategic skills. There are lots of little insiders hidden that will make you laugh. Your gaming fun gets a new fun level! LOVE OF DETAIL: Discover the world of the Bundeswehr with detailed Eurofighter, folding spades, tanks and lots of explanations and facts! Get to know everyday life and the structures in a simple and humorous way. It makes civilians smile. Soldiers will encounter funny situations from their daily work during the game! —description from the publisher(translated) NEUER SPIELSPAß: Für dich haben wir das weltberühmte Original Monopoly Brettspiel mit dem Bundeswehr Leben verknüpft. Stell dir deine eigene Bundeswehr zusammen, kaufe Dienststellen, Übungsplätze und zeige deine strategischen Fähigkeiten. Es sind viele kleine Insider versteckt, die dich zum Lachen bringen werden. Dein Spielspaß bekommt ein neues Spaß Level! LIEBE ZUM DETAIL: Entdecke die Bundeswehr-Welt mit detailgetreuen Eurofighter, Klappspaten, Panzer und vielen Erklärungen und Fakten! Lerne den Alltag und die Strukturen auf einfache und humorvolle Art kennen. Es bringt Zivilisten zum Schmunzeln. Soldaten und Soldatinnen werden während des Spiels immer wieder auf lustige Situationen aus ihrem Dienstalltag treffen! —description from the publisher

mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Auction: English;Income;Loans;Lose a Turn;Ownership;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Track Movement;Trading
description: Artist Kathleen Keifer has spun her Magic to create perhaps the most hip edition of Monopoly yet. This edition captures the essence of "California Cool" as you enjoy her colorful artwork traveling across the Pacific Coast Highway along Route 66 to Sunset Boulevard. The beautiful canvas wraps around a solid box cover, which can be lifted off to reveal custom game components designed by Keifer, including an iconic Surf Wagon token! Custom designed Chance, Tip Jar and Title Deed card; wooden Houses and Hotels; custom-designed Monopoly money; wooden banker's tray. —description from the back of the box

name: Monopoly: Call of Duty Black Ops
mechanics: Auction / Bidding;Lose a Turn;Ownership;Player Elimination;Roll / Spin and Move;Set Collection;Track Movement;Trading
description: Played like traditional Monopoly. Includes Custom COD themed gameboard, tokens, money, Chance/Community Chest cards etc. Play as Intel Case, RC-XD, Dragon Fire, Capture the Flag icon, Attack Dog, or Firebreak’s Helmet.

name: 5 Alive / Uno
description: This game primarily is a version of 5 Alive but includes the game UNO as an extra.

name: Blokus Shuffle: UNO Edition
description: Blokus Shuffle: UNO Edition is a wild take on traditional Blokus. The object of the game hasn't changed - play as many of your pieces as possible onto the board by following the one rule of Blokus: each piece you play must touch another of your pieces only at the corner. The twist? Each player has a deck of action cards at their disposal to really change up the game. On your turn you'll play an action card, then play your piece, then refill your hand. The cards are UNO-themed and let you do a variety of things. Traditional UNO standbys like Skip, Reverse, and Draw 2 are in there, but Blokus Shuffle also includes powerful new abilities like Warp, Recycle, and Edge-to-Edge. When no one can play anymore pieces, the game ends and the player with the fewest unplayed pieces wins. —description from the designer

name: Calvinball Unofficial  Mini-Game
description: Other kids' games are all such a bore! They've gotta have rules and they gotta keep score! Calvinball is better by far! It's never the same! It's always bizarre! You don't need a team or a referee! You know that it's great, 'cause it's named after me! —The Calvinball theme song Calvinball is a game played by the characters of the classic comic strip Calvin and Hobbes by Bill Watterson. The goal of Calvinball is to round the circuit of bases in sequence while in the possession of the required Calvinball for each base. One time successful around the bases wins the game. Opponents will attempt to halt other Player’s advancement while simultaneously trying to reach their own sequential base with their Calvinball (it may or may not be the same ball). Scattered around the field are trees, rocks, a stream, sports equipment and other items to hinder and assist players in their efforts to win the game

name: Campionato Mondiale Formula Uno
description: User summary: Roll and move race game of the early '70. From rules: Contestants will choose their cars and take the card boxes and card run. Will proceed in turn by moving their marker on the track, every move you will throw 2 dice and the number obtained will happen what happens on their card race (eg wildfire: stop for 2 shifts, skidding: advance 2 spaces ...). If the dice roll indicates the stop in the pits the player must stop at the next garage space on the track and throw a dice to see the consequences (eg, oil change: stop a turn; tire change: advance 2 spaces, etc..) Win the race who will cut the finish line first. It's possible can make an entire season of 15 Grand Prix.

name: Crime Zoom: A Deadly Writer
description: Crime Zoom is a series of investigation game for 1 and more players and for plays of about 1 hour. Each investigation propels you into a different universe, but almost always on a crime scene. This crime scene is spread over several cards to form a great illustration. To investigate, nothing more simple. Take a card to take a closer look. An item intrigues you ? Flip the card over and find out what is this little paper on the bedside table. An address ? You can now take the card that corresponds to this track. Unless another element on the crime scene appeals you even more ? In Crime Zoom, you will conduct your investigation freely. Discuss between players to choose the tracks to follow. And as soon as you think you have solved the case, go to the questionnaire. Who is guilty ? What is his mobile ? What is the murder weapon ? And some subsidiary questions, of course. Do not miss the culprit otherwise you will lose the game. But if you answer the questions correctly, the number of cards you will not reveal will decide you. The solution will answer each of the questions. The epilogue will come to tell all this in a story or a testimony history to understand the plot that has been played. Crime Zoom: Un écrivain mortel is the third case of the Crime Zoom family. It brings you in a British manor in 1929. —description from the publisher

name: Deckmatch: The Unofficial Quake 3 Card Game
description: This is a do-it-yourself card game based on the computer game, Quake 3 Arena. It can be played with an ordinary deck of cards, but works best if you have a way to create cards with the correct graphics (weapons) on them. To find the rules, try doing an internet search for 'quake deckmatch'. The game is a fast paced, turn-based simulation of a first person shooter, where the objective is to kill (or 'frag') your opponent, by reducing his life points to zero, as many times as possible.

name: Decktet-Uno
description: Decktet-Uno is inspired by Uno mechanics and it's a game in the family of Decktet games. Each player chooses a card and places it on top of the face-up card at the center, starting to form a pile. Each time a card is played by someone, that player gets awarded a total of points calculated as: [Number of symbols on the face-up card on the top of the pile] X [Number of matching symbols on the card the player is placing on top of it] After playing a card, the current player finishes the turn and draws a card from the deck. The game goes on until all cards have been played.

name: Who's the Ass?
description: An exciting and fun cardgame for large and small gaming groups by Wolfgang Kramer! Just as I was winning, the ass appeared! Now I am stuck with a hand full of cards again! The aim of the game is it to get rid of your cards as fast as possible. Once done, all other players score negative points. However, beware of the ass... and do not feel sorry if it sticks on you! Re-implemented by: Ochs & Esel (2008) Das GROSSE und das kleine A (1996)

name: DOS! Twice the fun of UNO
description: Components: 108 cards, a dry erase pen, and magic erasable tablet. The aim of the game is to get rid of all your 10 starting cards by forming sentences with your opponents. Players play one word card from their hand at the time, thereby adding to the sentence already on the table. When a player cannot go he picks up DOS (two) cards and either continues the sentence or starts afresh. Trump cards spice up the game with wild animal sounds, improv, laziness annoyance and full stops. When a player has two cards left anyone can call out DOS!! to enter DOS mode. In DOS Mode players are not bound to playing one card at the time but, at their turn, can add unlimited words provided it makes sense. When challenged, players get 60 seconds to draw a picture of the current sentence, to convince the other players that it makes sense. Source: the publisher Game creator is Alessandro Schueli, design credit goes to Ariel Lee, and special thanks to SCAD (Savannah College of Art and Design.

name: Dungeon Keeper Unofficial Card Game
description: From the rulebook: "So You Want to Become a Dungeon Keeper? Want to Create a Dark Underground Fortress and fill it with Wicked Minions? Want to Create an Evil Empire, bringing Chaos, Death and Destruction? Want to Bash pitiful, useless Heroes? Welcome to the Unofficial Dungeon Keeper Card Game." "You've got lands (Rooms). You've got Creatures. You've got 20 LifePoints. Just like in magic. Different Rooms are needed to Summon more Creatures, or to research Spells or to build Artifacts, and in general to be more Powerful." "But there's come the fun part. Creatures can't be anywhere: they must be In a Room. To represent this, you need to put your Creatures near the Rooms they're in. A creature in a Room can defend it, but cannot defend a different Room . . . So be wary not to expand your Dungeon too much, or you will be unable to defend it." "A Creature in a Room can also use the Room. So, for example, your Warlock in your Library will be able to research a Spell (or to defend the Library). If you want him to defend the Lair, instead, you can move him in the Lair (in the appropriate Turn Phase), but then he will be unable to research a Spell (as he need to be in the Library to do so)." "You can win in two ways: 1) Kill the Avatar when he's attacking your Dungeon (The World Will Be Mine! Victory), 2) Kill the other Dark Lord (BWHAHA ! Victory)."

name: Tierisch auf Zack
description: Game description from the publisher: Welcome to the hurly-burly of the animal world wood championships. Bright brains, body control and concentration are needed. There are many different ideas for running, jumping, and waddling games, as well as a lot of mooing and miaowing, aiming at targets, and making combinations. Above all, a lot of fun! Tierisch auf Zack, part of HABA's "Fex" line of games, includes rules that increase the level of difficulty of the exercises, for example, standing at attention in the first round, coordination training in the second, and perhaps sprinting in the third.

name: EXIT: The Game – The Forgotten Island
description: For those shipwrecked on the beach of this forgotten island, a chained boat is the only hope — but the mysterious owner has left puzzles over the whole island. Will the team solve them, free the boat, and escape? Exit: The Game – The Forgotten Island is a puzzle game modeled after escape rooms.

name: EXIT: The Game – Kidnapped in Fortune City
description: Can you solve the riddles and stop the kidnapping before it’s too late? Criminal activity is rampant in the frontier town of Fortune City, and now the sheriff has disappeared without a trace. With precious little time to find him, players need to work together to solve the crime. Over the course of the game, your investigation will lead you through Fortune City, with clues and strange items to be found throughout. You will need to search for answers in the saloon, drugstore, gunsmith, post office, prison, and bank. But in a unique twist, you will decide the order in which you will visit these locations and who you will interrogate along the way. Together with your team, you will collect clues and evaluate the townspeoples’ testimonies. But will you get the answers you need to rescue the sheriff in time? In the style of Dead Man on the Orient Express and Theft on the Mississippi, players must get to the bottom of a kidnapping in the Wild West in addition to solving all the riddles. Difficulty level: 3.5 of 5 Exit: The Game – Kidnapped in Fortune City is a puzzle game modeled after escape rooms, and it includes components meant to be folded, written upon, or torn, so it's marketed as a single-use game.

name: Giant UNO
description: The classic card game now in a giant size! Each card measures 7.4 inches x 10.1 inches! Race to get rid of all your cards and match colors or numbers. Use the action cards or house rule cards against your opponents. When you're down to one card, don't forget to yell "UNO"! Play the 'Swap Hands' card to change hands with any opponent. 3 customizable cards let you write any house rule you want and erase to make new rules!

name: Il gioco della Formula Uno
description: Yet another imitation of Formula Dé. Roll the dice, try to get the correct symbols and run!

name: GUATAFAC 'Unos Vicios'
description: THE SPICIEST VERSION OF GUATAFAC! 480 new cards and very daring tests! ⚡️ SIMPLE RULES: Discover the worst thoughts of players in 8 seconds with this hilarious board game. Win points by answering correctly before your time ends! The one who's answered more questions correctly in time wins the game :) PLAY IN 15 TO 45 MIN, from 2 to 15 players and MILLIONS of possible answers. +16 years. ♻️ CARDS PRINTED IN THE EUROPEAN UNION with paper from sustainably managed forests. 1% of the profits are donated to charities. (FEDER, 2021) —description from the publisher

name: Harry Potter Unofficial Magic Duel Card Game
categories: Card Game;Fantasy;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Novel-based;Print & Play
description: Backs are turned, paces are taken, wands are raised. The word is given and the magic duel has begun! Players take the role of a magic student and fling spells at each other with the ultimate goal of removing the opponent's wand. Each deck is identical except for one unique spell that the individual student has prepared just for the occasion. Rounds are quick. Will you be lucky enough to pick off their wand early? Or will you whittle away their stamina until they are left utterly defenseless? —description from the designer

name: Hot Death Uno
description: Hot Death UNO is an UNO add-on/variant that incorporates some House Rules with 27 (or more depending on the variant) extra cards that allow you to remove players from the game, draw up to 69 cards at once, have them display their cards for all to see, and more! Favorites include Mystery Draw, Harvester of Sorrows, and Mutual Assured Destruction. See file section for the original rules and variant with extra cards.

name: Karate Kid: All Valley Tournament Unofficial Game
mechanics: Card Play Conflict Resolution;Hand Management;Programmed Movement
description: Ladies and Gentlemen, welcome once again to the 1984 All Valley Karate tournament! We go live to the mat now, where fighters from Miyagi-Do face off against fighters from Cobra Kai. The Karate Kid: All Valley Tournament Unofficial Game is a 2-8 player card game where teams of players represent the very best of two dojos featured in the Karate Kid franchise, Miyagi-Do, and Cobra Kai. Only the strongest will survive with a mix of skill, timing, and luck to determine who is the champion! Note: This is an unofficial game, and all copyrighted materials are the property of the original holders including artwork, IP material or other design elements. —description from the designer

name: King Size UNO
description: King Size UNO is a version of UNO for young players. The object, as in the parent game, is to be the first to get rid of all one's cards. The oversized cards have animal illustrations in addition to numbers (1-6) and colors to help children make matches. The deck also contains 4 wild cards, a Draw 2 card for each suit, and a Free Turn card for each suit.

name: Liar's UNO
description: A Liar's Card is played face down, and the player must announce what it is. ​If caught in a lie, the liar must draw a card — but if the suspected liar was telling the truth, their accuser must draw a card! ​Players try to bluff their way to victory, but when they have one card left, they still must yell "UNO!"

name: Mini UNO Bullseye
description: Players try to match colors and numbers as in the classic game, but with a unique Bullseye rule that directs a player to decide who gets hit with an action card. The smaller package and cards make it easy to take the game anywhere for fun on the go. And when down to the last card, don't forget to yell "UNO!"

name: My First UNO
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: My First UNO smaller re-themed version of Uno featuring popular kids' TV characters, like Sesame Street, Rugrats, Dora the Explorer, or Thomas the Tank Engine. It includes 36 cards, 1 to 7, draw 2, all in colors of Red, Blue, Green, and Yellow, and four wild cards. Game play is similar to ordinary Uno. The deck is shuffled and each player is dealt a hand of five cards. Players take turns discarding cards by matching the most recent discard in color or number. This version includes different characters for each number so that characters could also be matched. A player with one card remaining must yell Uno or draw two cards. Players without a matching card must draw one card from the draw stack. If the drawn card matches, it may be played immediately, otherwise the player's turn ends. The two special cards are the wild which permit a player to name a color for the next card to be played and the draw two which forces the next player to pick up two cards and lose their turn. The goal is to be the first player to discard all the cards in their hand. --- All My First UNO games are grouped together in the database because there is seemingly no difference among them other than the featured characters.

name: Serenity: The Unofficial Board Game
categories: Adventure;Dice;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Print & Play;Science Fiction
mechanics: Area Movement;Dice Rolling;Pick-up and Deliver;Roll / Spin and Move
description: From the creator of the game: "I made up a game based on Firefly and Serenity, in which you fly around the 'verse looking for work and trying to put together a crew." "You try not to get pirated by other players, avoid the Reavers and Alliance, and try to earn credits. " There is a preview here: http://www.fireflyfans.net/sunroomitem.asp?i=10704 Game can be downloaded here: http://docs.google.com/leaf?id=0Bz_OJBPpg5bKNWMyOTMyMzktMmNmZi00NDNmLTg4N2YtYzgzNGE1OGQyODk1&hl=en Home Page: http://www.coroflot.com/micjwelch

name: SherBlock: Uno Scandalo in Boemia
description: A treasured photo to retrieve, two ex-lovers, two finely tuned brains battling it out! Will it be you, Sherlock Holmes, in this reimagined Sir Arthur Conan Doyle classic, who will prevail as always? Or will you, Irene Adler, inflict on the king of detectives the one, searing defeat of his career? In a SherBlock, you get to play as many as two protagonists! Choose sides, flip the block and play!

name: Shot in the Dark: The Ultimate Unorthodox Quiz Game
description: Shot in the Dark is the ultimate quiz game. 400 bizarre questions and amazing answers on small lightweight cards. Ideal for playing with friends or family. Ever wondered: how many tins of paint it takes to paint the White House, how much vodka the average Russian drinks, or what proportion of European babies are conceived in an Ikea bed? If so, then this game is for you. Recommended ages:

name: A Study in Emerald
mechanics: Area Majority / Influence;Deck, Bag, and Pool Building;Hand Management;Hidden Roles;Open Drafting;Point to Point Movement;Team-Based Game
description: A Study in Emerald is a game for two to five players based on the award-winning short story of the same name by Neil Gaiman. In this stylistic mash-up of Sherlock Holmes and H.P. Lovecraft, the worst has already happened and the world is now ruled by the Old Ones. However, a secret war is being fought to free mankind from their servitude. The game A Study in Emerald fleshes out this core idea by including historical figures from the late nineteenth century, most being persons involved in the anarchist movement of the time. Deck-building forms the core of the game. You use influence cubes to bid for the right to draft cards and take control of cities. Each player has a secret identity, either a Restorationist fighting against the creatures or a Loyalist attempting to defend the status quo. Which side you are on determines what you score points for. An additional twist is that the performance of other players on the same side as you can stop you from winning if they are doing particularly badly, so you really want to know who is on which side. More specifically, when the game ends – and this can result from multiple causes, such as a marker on the War or Revolution track hitting 15 or the assassination of a Restorationist player agent – then the sides compare their scores; which side has the lowest score automatically loses, then the player with the highest score on the remaining team wins the game. The game takes around ninety minutes to play and is more complex than most, so more suitable for the experienced gamer.

name: A Study in Emerald (Second Edition)
mechanics: Area Majority / Influence;Auction / Bidding;Deck, Bag, and Pool Building;Hand Management;Hidden Roles;Open Drafting;Point to Point Movement;Team-Based Game
description: It is 1882, and the Old Ones are already here. They arrived seven hundred years ago and have been ruling the planet ever since. The majority of people just get on with their lives, accepting their monstrous rulers. However, a growing band of revolutionaries wish to free mankind from their slavery. These freedom fighters call themselves the Restorationists. A secret war has already broken out between the Restorationists and the forces loyal to the Old Ones. The invention of dynamite has changed the balance of power, and a lone assassin now has the capacity to destroy an Old One. In this shadow world of assassins, informers, police agents and anarchists, nobody is quite sure who is who and which side they fight for. The game A Study in Emerald draws its central plot from the award-winning short story penned by Neil Gaiman, in which the worlds of Sherlock Holmes and H.P. Lovecraft are combined to telling effect. However, to create a world detailed enough for players, much has been added from real history. The nineteenth century was a time of unrest, with many colorful characters fighting both for and against the authorities. A Study in Emerald is the outcome of the merging of these three worlds. This second edition of A Study in Emerald sports new artwork by Ian O'Toole and Tatiana Kuzilova along with a streamlined set of rules that will hopefully help those folks who found the first version a tad complicated. Inconsistencies have been removed and the number of available actions has been reduced to the minimum, whilst still retaining the mood of paranoia from the first edition.

name: Loading
mechanics: Closed Drafting;Race;Simultaneous Action Selection;Speed Matching;Sudden Death Ending
description: In Loading, all the players try simultaneously to collect as many progression points as possible. Who will be the fastest...or the wisest? All players but one start with a deck of cards in hand; the final player waits, hand outstretched, for another player to hand them a deck. As soon as you have a deck, examine it as quickly or as thoroughly as you wish for a progression card to play on your stack. You must play cards in ascending order, but you need not play them sequentially. Once you've played a card, get rid of the deck by placing it in the hand of whoever waits. Once you've gathered enough progression points — or at least once you think you're in a good position — you can discard the deck instead of giving it to someone else, then take a bonus STOP card. There aren't enough STOP cards for all players, so don't delay too long. Loading includes a two-player mode, as well as an expert mode for skilled players. ••• Dans Loading, tous les joueurs essayent, en même temps, de collecter un maximum de points de progression. Qui sera le plus rapide... ou le plus malin ? Un jeu de Draft en temps réel, sans aucun tours! Tous les joueurs, sauf un, commencent avec un Deck de cartes. Le dernier attend, la main tendue, qu'un autre joueur lui donne un Deck. Dès que vous avez la main sur un Deck, fouillez (rapidement) dans le Deck pour trouver une carte de progression à jouer sur votre Pile. Les cartes doivent être jouées dans l'ordre croissant, mais pas nécessairement avec la carte juste au dessus (on peut jouer un 19 ou un 47 sur un 18, mais pas un 14). Une fois que vous avez joué une carte, débarrassez-vous (rapidement) du Deck en le donnant au joueur qui en attend un. Une fois que vous avez accumulé suffisamment de points de progression (ou du moins lorsque vous le pensez...), vous pouvez vous débarrasser du Deck au lieu de le donner et prendre une carte Stop de bonus de fin. Soyez rapide, il n'y aura pas de cartes Stop pour tout le monde... Pour les plus aguerris d'entre vous, vous trouverez également une variante pour joueurs confirmés et une variante pour 2 joueurs. -description from publisher (French)

name: Unmatched: Battle of Legends, Volume One
mechanics: Action Points;Card Play Conflict Resolution;Hand Management;Line of Sight;Player Elimination;Point to Point Movement;Team-Based Game;Variable Player Powers
description: In battle, there are no equals. Unmatched is a highly asymmetrical miniature fighting game for two or four players. Each hero is represented by a unique deck designed to evoke their style and legend. Tactical movement and no-luck combat resolution create a unique play experience that rewards expertise, but just when you've mastered one set, new heroes arrive to provide all new match-ups. Battle of Legends, Volume One features four heroes. King Arthur sacrifices cards to power up his attacks and gets some timely assistance from Merlin's magic. Alice is back from Wonderland with a giant vorpal blade and the Jabberwock by her side as she grows and shrinks to gain advantages on attack and defense. Medusa is happy to attack from range and let her harpies hound you, but just one devastating glance could end the battle quickly. Sinbad grows in power as he gains experience on each of his voyages. Combat is resolved quickly by comparing attack and defense cards. However, each card's unique effects and a simple but deep timing system lead to interesting decisions each time. The game also features an updated version of the line-of-sight system from Tannhäuser for ranged attacks and area effects. The game includes a double-sided board with two different battlefields, pre-washed miniatures for each hero, and custom life trackers that's brought to life with the stunning artwork of Oliver Barrett and the combined design teams of Restoration Games and Mondo Games.

name: UNO
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number
description: Players race to empty their hands and catch opposing players with cards left in theirs, which score points. In turns, players attempt to play a card by matching its color, number, or word to the topmost card on the discard pile. If unable to play, players draw a card from the draw pile, and if still unable to play, they pass their turn. Wild and special cards spice things up a bit. UNO is a commercial version of Crazy Eights, a public domain card game played with a standard deck of playing cards. This entry includes all themed versions of UNO that do not include new cards.

name: UNO & Skip-Bo Bonus Pak
description: UNO and Skip-Bo combined in a single box.

name: UNO 7-Eleven
description: Play the Wild Eleven Card on any "7" card - even out of turn! And when you're down to your last card, don't yell "BRAINFREEZE", yell "UNO!"

name: UNO All Wild!: My Hero Academia (McDonald's Happy Meal Edition)
description: This is a highly competitive, fast-action promotional card game released globally as part of the 2026 McDonald's "UNO x Anime" Happy Meal crossover campaign. Housed in a fierce, dark crimson box featuring Tomura Shigaraki and the League of Villains, this officially licensed mini-deck adapts Mattel's chaotic UNO All Wild! rules into a compact 43-card structure optimized for 2 to 4 players. Stripping away all standard numbers and colors, every single card in this deck functions as a Wild card. Rather than making basic color matches, players must rely purely on strategy and timing to chain together powerful Action Cards—such as Wild Skip, Wild Reverse, Wild Draw 2, and Wild Targeted Draw 2—to force their opponents into disadvantageous positions. This set features a franchise-exclusive holographic foil "Decay" Wild Card. When played, it channels Shigaraki's destructive Quirk: the active player names a target color to resume normal play, and then chooses one opponent to immediately "decay" their hand. That opponent must instantly discard half of their current cards (rounded up) straight to the bottom of the draw deck and draw that same amount of new cards from the top, completely ruining their hand management and strategic planning.

name: UNO All Wild!: SPY x FAMILY
description: This is a chaotic, fast-paced promotional variant of the card game released globally as part of the 2026 McDonald's "UNO x Anime" Happy Meal crossover campaign. Housed in a striking black and red box featuring the elegant assassin Yor Forger (Thorn Princess), this licensed mini-deck shrinks the chaotic UNO All Wild! formula down to an optimized 43-card deck designed for 2 to 4 players. True to the "All Wild" style, this deck completely removes standard numbers and colors. Every single card in the deck is a Wild card, meaning players never have to worry about matching colors or numbers. Instead, the game becomes a brutal tactical race driven entirely by special Action Cards—including Wild Skip, Wild Reverse, Wild Draw 2, and Wild Targeted Draw 2. This set features a franchise-exclusive holographic foil "Thorn Princess Strike" Wild Card. When played, it represents Yor's fierce combat prowess: the active player chooses the next color to resume normal play, and then chooses two different opponents to immediately skip, cutting down their chances to shed cards and changing the turn order completely.

name: UNO Attack!
description: UNO, America's No. 1-selling card game, has a whole new twist. You'll still encounter all the elements that make UNO so unpredictable and challenging, but add to that a motorized card launcher that shows no mercy and you've got UNO Attack. The object of the game is still to get rid of all your cards. The UNO command cards direct the game by telling players when to trade hands, discard, reverse the playing order, or skip a player. Beware the dreaded Hit command, though, as this translates into a game of Russian roulette. You never know when the card launcher is going to fire off a stream of UNO cards just for you! For 2 to 10 players. Requires three C batteries (not included). 112 cards as follows: 18 Blue cards: 2 each - 1 to 9 18 Green cards: 2 each - 1 to 9 18 Red cards: 2 each - 1 to 9 18 Yellow cards: 2 each - 1 to 9 8 Hit 2 cards: 2 each in blue, green, red and yellow 8 Reverse cards: 2 each in blue, green, red and yellow 8 Skip cards: 2 each in blue, green, red and yellow 4 Discard All cards: 1 each in blue, green, red and yellow 4 Trade Hands cards: 1 each in blue, green, red and yellow 4 Wild cards 2 Wild All-Hit cards 2 Wild Hit-Fire card 2010 Edition Changes: Trade Hand cards are replaced with another set of Discard All cards Wild All-Hit and Wild Hit-Fire cards are replaced with 4 Wild Attack-Attack cards

name: UNO Bingo
description: Bingo. With an UNO twist. Roll the dice, place the chips, and try for a BINGO.

name: UNO Blast
description: UNO Blast adds a new level of surprise and excitement to America’s #1 brand of card games! When you draw a card you can’t play, you have to put it in one of five slots in the card blaster. The cards stack up until someone randomly triggers the blast – when the blaster goes off, the player adds ALL of the blasted cards into their own hand. Unique to this UNO deck are the Wild Blast cards. When you play a Wild Blast card, the next player has to take cards from the draw pile and put them into the card blaster until he or she triggers it. Will they end up with one extra card in their hand or five? You’ll have to play it to find out!

name: UNO Blitzo
description: Uno meets Bop It. The traditional UNO rules apply but the cards are eliminated and play is enhanced by a modern console with lights and sounds. The console calls out the number, color or instruction (reverse, skip) and you have to react quickly. Press the wrong button, the button you've already eliminated, or forget to hit the Uno button when only one light is left, and the console will dole out the punishments (while mocking you with a snide laugh). The goal is to eliminate your four colored & numbered lights. A fast dexterity and memory game.

name: Boom-O
description: Boom-O is a simple elimination card game from the makers of Uno. Each player gets 7 cards in hand and three time bomb cards in front of them. Most of the cards in the deck either increase or decrease the timer total. Other cards include familiar commands such as Skip, Reverse, Draw 1 (or 2) and Trade Hands. Player discard one card per turn trying to clear their hand while keeping the timer total under 60. If a player can't play a valid card, they must flip over one of their three time bombs. If a player clears their hand, all other players flip one of their time bombs. Whoever flips all three of their bombs is out of the game. Survivor wins. Re-implements: 5 Alive

name: UNO Bundle Collector Tin
description: What a great gift for your friends who love to play games: UNO, PHASE 10, and SNAPPY DRESSERS in one premium collectible tin! Which one will they play first? UNO: Match colors and numbers to be the first to get rid of all your cards. PHASE 10: Players must complete rummy like hands to move through all 10 phases of the game. SNAPPY DRESSERS: the delightfully creative card game in which every card matches in one way with every other card in the deck. It's the ultimate game collection for super-fun nights in with family and friends. Gather your friends and play all three! Three classic games for nights in with family and friends –description from the publisher

name: UNO Choo-Choo
description: All aboard for Fast Fun for Little Ones with UNO Choo-Choo Game. Preschoolers depart on an UNO adventure featuring a train filled with adorable animals. Play by matching color or animal cards, or play a conductor card he's wild and matches anything! When you have only one card left, cheer 'UNO Choo-Choo!' to let everyone know the winning train is leaving the station! Includes 28 cards, 4 caboose partitions and train. For 2 to 4 players. Ages 3 and older.

name: 1 vs. 100 Board Game
description: From the box: It's you against the mob in the most exciting trivia game ever. Contents: 275 question cards (825 questions), card holder, wipe-off mob board with stand, 51 mob tokens, 4 cardboard shields, 5 answer photos, 3 answer cards, wipe-off money board, score pad, wipe-off pen, and instructions Gameplay: One player is the contestant. The other player(s) become the mob. The mob divides one hundred mob tokens as evenly as possible. One mob player, acting as host, reads a question and its three possible answers aloud. The mob players use their tokens to secretly choose one or more answers. When the mob players have finished distributing all of their tokens, the contestant may ask for one of three helps before giving a response to the question. The helps one response of the contestant’s choosing), Trust the Mob (the contestant is forced to choose whichever response has the most tokens on it) or Ask the Mob (this eliminates one wrong response). The contestant can use each help only once. If the contestant gives the correct response, the money is added to the bank equal to the level the player is on multiplied by the number of tokens the mob has put on the wrong responses. The levels start at $1000 and ascend to $10,000. The mob tokens that are on the incorrect responses are out of play. The game is over when the contestant gives an incorrect response. This means the money in the bank is divided among the mob players who still have tokens. The contestant wins $1,000,000 when the mob loses all its tokens. The contestant can quit the game before ascending to the next level and keep whatever money has been accumulated in the bank. Players continue the game until each player has been the contestant. A running total of the scores of each game is kept. The player with the highest score is the winner. Considering that the television series uses 101 contestants, this is reasonable faithful translation of the television series. Intended for 2 - 4 players Ages 12 and up

name: UNO Dare!
description: From the publisher's website: The familiar fun race to yell "UNO!" comes with wild, new choices! While playing the color and numbers matching game, you're faced with a decision: draw extra cards or take a dare! Dare cards come in 3 categories: Family, Show-Off and Daredevil, with 16 dares on each card. You may end up talking like a pirate until your next turn, or standing on one foot, or even showing your best dance moves! There is even a blank card to make up your own dares! What will you risk - drawing more cards or doing something wild? Find out when you play this new version of the classic UNO game - if you DARE! And don't forget to yell "UNO!", even if you have to do it like a pirate, matey! Comes with instructions and 112 playing cards. Ages 7 and older.

name: UNO Dare: Adults Only
description: Adult fans of UNO card games will love this daring take on the classic game. It plays like regular UNO matching color and number, but if a Dare Card is played, the player must decide if they are willing to risk doing the dare versus the penalty of drawing cards. There are four levels of dares: mild, medium, spicy, and fuego! A chance roll of the die determines which dare players must perform. A card with a “reverse” icon on it forces the player who played the Dare Card to perform the dare! But the party doesn't end there, these cards are durable, waterproof plastic cards to make them completely spill-proof and comes with a handy clip to keep them together! Makes a great gift for fans and game lovers ages 18 years old and up. —description from the publisher

name: UNO Dice
description: Includes three ways to play. Game 1 Each player draws four dice. Each player on their turn draws, rolls their dice, and places one of them in the dice tray. Any dice added to the tray must match by colour, number or letters. The first player to get rid of her dice is the winner. Game 2 Game 2 is a variant of Yacht where the object is to have the highest points score after 11 rounds of play. The player draws five dice out of the bag and rolls all of them. The player may then take up to two more rolls with their choice of one or more of these five dice. Simply put aside the dice you do not want to roll, and roll the rest. Any of these dice may be rolled in any of your three rolls, except that all five must be rolled on the first roll. At the end of your turn, you must score your exposed dice faces in one of the eleven spaces in your column of the scoring sheet. If you cannot or do not wish to enter a score in any of the eleven spaces, then you must score a zero in your choice of one of the eleven spaces. Game 3 All 24 spaces in the dice tray are used for Game 3. A player draws one die out of the bag, rolls it, and places it face up in any one of the 24 dice spaces in the tray. After the starting die is placed in the tray, the player to the left of the starting player draws four dice out of the bag and rolls them. The player looks at the dice to see if any of these can match the die already in the tray. The dice can match by either number, color or letter in any combination. If a match can be made, the player places the die in the tray and scores points. Dice are scored by making strings of two or more adjacent dice, all of the same color or kind. All numbered faces (0 through 9) score as their numerical value. The R, S and D2 each score as 20 points. The W and WD4 are not scored. After a player finishes their turn, the next player takes a turn using the same dice. Thus a player will usually begin her turn with one less die than the previous player. In this way, the first player will have four dice to roll, the second three, the third will have two, and so on. When a player, down to only one die, is able to play it, then the next player starts the pattern over again by drawing four fresh dice from the bag, rolls them and play proceeds from there. The game ends when the dice tray is full. The winner is the player with the highest total score.

name: UNO Dice
description: UNO Dice uses the same colours, numbers, and directions as the card game. To start, players take 5 dice to make their hand which is left visible to the other players. One die is rolled in the center. On each turn, the players examine their dice without rolling them. If a play can be made by matching the center dice in number or color, then the dice are exchanged and the center die is placed back in the bag. If a play can not be made, then the dice in the player's hand are rolled. If a play still can not be made, then a new die is added to the player's hand. The first player to get rid of all their dice wins. The winning player's score is based on the faces of the dice left in front of their opponent. Be the first player to reach 500 points.

name: UNO Dice Game
description: BASIC DESCRIPTION: The UNO Dice Game attempts to translate the original UNO card game into a two player dice game. It was released during the 2011 Christmas season and displayed along with other Mattel dice games in the same type of soda can tin packaging. COMPONENTS: The game includes 11 dice. Each die is unique and has some combination of faces in the four UNO colors (yellow, green, blue and red). The die faces include: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, draw one, draw two, and wild (in black). Note that there are no die faces that represent the Skip or Reverse cards from the original UNO card game (presumably because this is just a 2 player game). GAMEPLAY: The game mechanic is simple and mimics the original UNO card game. To begin, 5 dice are randomly given to each of the two players. These dice take the place of a players hand of cards in the original UNO card game. The 11th die is left in the middle of the play area to form the start of the dice line (think UNO discard stack from the original card game). The starting player rolls their dice and has to match either the color or value of the most recently placed die in the dice line. That player's matching die is placed in the dice line and will have to be matched by the next player. Play continues as players take turns rolling their hand of dice and adding one matching die from their hand to the dice line each turn until they only have one die left in their hand. The player must then say "UNO!" or be penalized. The penalty for not remembering to say "UNO!" is similar to the draw one and draw two die faces: the affected player must take the appropriate number of dice from the end of the dice line. The first player with no dice left wins. The winning player's score is based on the faces of the dice left in front of their opponent. Alternate rules are provided to ignore scoring and simply play the best out of 3 games. PACKAGING: This edition was packaged in a creative looking tin that was made to resemble an aluminum soda can--complete with Nutrition Facts label. The top of the can pops off (twist to open). The one sheet of rules and 11 dice fit inside the tin with a cardboard insert to help dampen the sound of the dice in the tin. The tin also has a coin slot in the top that holds the a plastic hook to allow it to be hung for selling/display purposes.

name: UNO Dice Game
description: Note: There are two other games in the database with the same name as this one: UNO Dice Game (2011) and UNO Dice (1987). All three games are entirely different. UNO Dice Game is a roll -and-write version of the UNO card game. Each player gets a marker and an individual player board. The object of the game is to be the first player to fill in all of the spaces on your board. On your turn, roll all 6 dice. You are allowed one reroll if you don't like the results. Then, arrange the dice in a chain by matching either color or number. The first die in your chain must match the number of the last number written on your board. For example, the last number on your board is a 5. Your chain could start with a red 5, then continue with a blue 5, a blue 3, and end with a blue 2. When you have finished creating your chain, write those numbers in the spaces on your player board. Finally, call out the color and number of the last die in your chain. Any player who is able to match that number to the last number written on their board may write it down. The player whose board matches the color of the number you called out can always write the number, even if it doesn't match. Use wilds, draw 1s and minus 1s to help yourself and hinder your opponents. The first player to fill in all the empty spaces on their board wins!

name: UNO Dominos
description: UNO Dominos for 2 to 6 players ages 7 and up EQUIPMENT 81 Domo playing pieces and 6 playing racks SUMMARY OF PLAY Each player draws 6 Domos. The player with the highest starting double goes first. After the starting doublet is placed on the table, each player in turn tries to match by color, number or word. The words on the Domos add excitement to the game by reversing the direction of play, skipping the next player or instruction the next player to draw a certain number of additional Domos. The first player to get rid of his Domos is the winner. MATCHING DOMOS In general, Domos are matched by UNO rules and arranged DOMINO style. Match by color, number, or word. But play is limited to the 4 directions of play from the starting doublet. When playing the MATCHING SIDE always constitutes the play. If someone puts down a draw two card and you have one you can put it down. If at any time you are unable to match color, number or word, you MUST draw ONE Domo from the remaining stock. If the drawn Domo is playable, you may play it immediately. If it is unplayable, it is added to your hand and play passes to the left to the next player.

name: UNO Elite Formula 1: 2025 Core Edition
description: This high-octane UNO Elite Formula 1 card game fuses the strategy of classic UNO with the adrenaline of Formula 1 racing! The excitement starts with a full deck of 112 UNO cards and picks up speed with 40 randomized Formula 1 Elite Action Cards (in four Game Booster Packs) and two Promo Cards. UNO Elite Formula 1 plays like classic UNO, but actions like Skip and Reverse are found on the Elite Action Cards. Each Elite Action Card comes with its own special power that activates when a game player plays a card with an Elite icon on it. And when down to the last card, don’t forget to yell “UNO!” The racing-themed game makes a thrilling gift for Formula 1 fans and card game lovers ages 7 years old and up. Colors and decorations may vary. Race into game night with the UNO Elite Formula 1 2025 Core Edition card game where Elite Action Cards add extra thrills to classic UNO game play! The set comes with 112 UNO cards, 4 Game Booster Packs (with 10 Elite Action Cards per pack) and 2 Promo Cards! Each UNO player creates their own “Lineup” from the 8 Elite Action Cards they are dealt -- Elite Action Cards feature Formula 1 drivers, cars, helmets, circuits, team principals and reserve drivers. Gameplay matches the classic card game with the action and excitement of Formula 1 racing! Players simply play a card of matching color with an Elite icon on it to unlock the power of an Elite Action Card! Unique graphic symbols on cards help identify the card color, allowing players with any form of color blindness to play! Designed for 2 to 5 players ages 7 years and older, this exciting UNO card game makes a fun, racing-themed gift for fans of Formula 1! —description from the publisher

name: UNO Elite NFL: 2024 Core Edition
description: There’s enough excitement to pack the stadium inside this Officially Licensed UNO Elite NFL 2024 Core Edition card game! The action starts with 112 UNO cards, plus 56 randomized NFL Player Cards and 4 collectible Foil Cards. UNO Elite NFL plays like Classic UNO, but actions like Skip and Reverse are found on NFL Player Cards. You use these cards when a game player plays a card with an Elite Icon on it -- there are 2,112 of these collectible UNO cards to take UNO card games to the next level. Colors and decorations may vary. Guide to Collecting Officially Licensed UNO Elite NFL Player Cards: Each NFL Player has 11 different cards to collect: four Base Player Cards and four Base Color Foil Cards (one of each in red, blue, green and yellow), two Dual Color Foil Cards and one Wild Foil Card. Player Cards come in Starter Packs and Draft Packs. Starter Packs and Draft Packs each include 60 player cards: 56 non-foil Player Cards (all unique players) and one Foil Pack containing four Foil Player Cards that include three Base Color Foil Cards (all unique players) and one Dual Color Foil Card or Wild Foil Card (1 per case pack). We may create special Promo Cards for certain events, so keep an eye out for those if you want to complete your collection! Draft NFL players into the classic UNO card game with the Officially Licensed UNO Elite NFL 2024 Core Edition! The deck comes with 112 UNO cards, 56 Player Cards and 4 collectible Foil UNO Cards! Gameplay matches the classic UNO card game with the action and excitement of NFL football! Play a card with an Elite Icon on it to unlock an NFL Player Card’s special power! Part of the UNO Elite series, this game can be expanded with cards from the Draft Pack -- 60 in total (each sold separately, subject to availability). Use your UNO Elite NFL Core Edition box to store your UNO Elite NFL collection as you add more teams – more than 2,000 Player Cards to collect! Designed for 2 to 7 players ages 7 years and older, this collectible UNO card game makes a great gift for fans of the NFL! —description from the publisher

name: UNO Elite NFL: 2025 All-Rookie Starter Pack
description: Kick off your game night with the UNO Elite NFL 2025 All-Rookie Starter Pack. It’s based on the UNO game you love, and plays the same way, until you use an Elite Action Card that allows you to draft an NFL rookie into the game. Each rookie on an Elite Action Card creates their own exciting play, and each of the four included booster packs comes with 10 of these future football stars. Hut-hut-hike! UNO Elite NFL – 2025 All-Rookie Starter Pack Comes with 112 specially designed UNO cards plus four game booster packs Each booster pack comes with 10 Elite Action Cards featuring 2025 NFL rookies Potential card types include foil cards and Special Wild Cards Keep an eye out for special Ascendant Cards in select packs —description from the publisher

name: UNO Elite NFL: 2025 Core Edition
description: There's enough excitement to pack the stadium inside this Officially Licensed UNO Elite NFL 2025 Core Edition card game! The action kicks off with the Starter Pack's 112 special UNO cards and picks up with four Game Booster Packs and two Promo Cards. Each Game Booster Pack contains 10 Elite Action Cards for a total of 40! UNO Elite NFL plays like classic UNO, but actions like Skip and Reverse are found on the Elite Action Cards that feature fan-favorite NFL players. There are more than 2,000 of these Elite Action Cards to take UNO Elite card games to the next level. And when down to the last card, don't forget to yell, 'Hut, hut, UNO!' This sport-themed card game is a high-scoring gift for NFL fans and card game lovers ages 7 years old and up. Colors and decorations may vary. Draft NFL players into the classic UNO card game with the Officially Licensed UNO Elite NFL 2025 Core Edition Starter Pack! The set comes with a 112-card special UNO deck and 4 Game Booster Packs with 10 Elite Action Cards each, plus 2 Promo Elite Action Cards! Gameplay matches the classic UNO card game with the action and excitement of NFL football! Players simply play a card of matching color with an Elite icon on it to unlock the power of an Elite Action Card within their lineup -- special Wild Viper Cards up the game even more! Unique graphic symbols on cards help identify the card color, allowing players with any form of color blindness to play! Part of the UNO Elite series, this game can be expanded with Elite Action Cards from the Booster Sets (each sold separately, subject to availability). The UNO Elite NFL Core Edition box comes with ample space to store additional cards -- there are more than 2,000 Elite Action Cards in the Core Set! Designed for 2 to 5 players ages 7 years and older, this exciting UNO card game makes a fun, sport-themed gift for fans of the NFL! —description from the publisher

name: One In the Middle
description: Game for 2 players on a 3x3 board, each player has 2 pieces that are located in the corners of the board, the player moves one of his pieces on each turn, the pieces move one square in any direction. wins the first player to get 3 pieces in a row, alternately leaving an own piece in the middle of the opponent's or vice versa. —user summary

name: UNO Express
description: UNO is the classic and beloved card game that's easy to pick up and impossible to put down. UNO Express offers all the fun of UNO but with a faster gameplay, allowing players to finish rounds more quickly! The smaller deck makes this version of UNO portable and easy to bring along while on-the-go. Players take turns matching a card in their hand with the current card shown on top of the deck either by color or number. Special action cards deliver game-changing moments, and each perform a function to help you defeat your opponents. And when you're down to one card, don't forget to shout "UNO!" The first player to get rid of all the cards in their hand before their opponents wins. —description from the publisher

name: UNO Fandom Harry Potter Gryffindor Game Deck
description: Bring out your obsession for game night. UNO Fandom has partnered with Warner Bros. to create a whole new twist on the classic party game. With cards featuring the Gryffindor crest and special Wizarding rules, this deck is sure to make anyone who’s dreamed of getting sorted into Gryffindor go absolutely WILD. UNO Fandom Harry Potter Gryffindor An entire UNO deck dedicated to House Gryffindor Includes 112 premium-quality cards and special instructions Exclusive alt-art foil card included Packaged in specially decorated box featuring the Gryffindor lion

name: UNO Fandom Harry Potter Hufflepuff Game Deck
description: Bring out your obsession for game night. UNO Fandom has partnered with Warner Bros. to create a whole new twist on the classic party game. With cards featuring the Hufflepuff crest and special Wizarding rules, this deck is sure to make anyone who’s dreamed of getting sorted into Hufflepuff go absolutely WILD. UNO Fandom Harry Potter Hufflepuff An entire UNO deck dedicated to House Hufflepuff Includes 112 premium-quality cards and special instructions Exclusive alt-art foil card included Packaged in specially decorated box featuring the Hufflepuff badger

description: Bring out your obsession for game night. UNO Fandom has partnered with Warner Bros. to create a whole new twist on the classic party game.
