name: UNO Fandom Harry Potter Slytherin Game Deck
description: Bring out your obsession for game night. UNO Fandom has partnered with Warner Bros. to create a whole new twist on the classic party game. With cards featuring the Slytherin crest and special Wizarding rules, this deck is sure to make anyone who’s dreamed of getting sorted into Slytherin go absolutely WILD. UNO Fandom Harry Potter Slytherin An entire UNO deck dedicated to House Slytherin Includes 112 premium-quality cards and special instructions Exclusive alt-art foil card included Packaged in specially decorated box featuring the Slytherin serpent

name: UNO Flash
description: Forget everything you thought you knew about UNO! Clockwise? Counterclockwise? Nope, it's totally random! This exciting electronic version selects who's next, so you have to stay alert. Did you blink? Uh-oh, you missed your turn and time ran out! It's the fast, crazy game that will keep you guessing , on your toes, and raring to go. And just when you think you can relax and take a breath, you still need to remember to yell "UNO!" Adds random turn order, timed turns, and the exclusive Slap card to the classic gameplay.

name: UNO Flex!
description: UNO Flex Card Game is based on the UNO Card Game players know and love, but with a flexible attitude. Different flexes switch up the game -- Flex Cards allows players to "flex" the color of their card (a Red 4 can become a Green 4 in one flex) while "Flex Action" Cards let players "flex" the action of the card. ​The Power card tells players if they are allowed to "flex" their card. The green Ö means "yes" -- the red X means "no". ​Flex Action cards can "flex" to a new action. For example, a "Skip" can flex to "Skip All" and a "Draw 2 Card" can flex to an "Every Player Must Draw 1 Card." The first player to play the last card from their hand wins the game. If you want to play more than one game, you can choose to use the UNO Flex! scoring variant. The game is played the same as the normal game. Cards left in opponents hands score points for the person who won the round. First to 500 points wins the game.

name: UNO Flip
description: You'll FLIP for this version of UNO, which combines the card game you know and love with ready-aim-launch action! Whenever you play a special Flip card, use the launcher to hurl your UNO Guy at an opponent's crash-pad. If he lands on it, you give that player one of your cards - decreasing your hand while sabotaging theirs! So aim to get rid of your cards first...and don't forget to yell "UNO!"

name: UNO Flip Attack
description: UNO Flip Attack combines the game-changing strategy of flipping the deck from the easier Mild Side to the tougher Wild Side with the unpredictable excitement of the attack card launcher! UNO Flip Attack plays just like UNO Attack, except now the cards are double-sided. When you play a Flip Card, watch the launcher flip the deck from Mild to Wild. Mild Side cards like Skip and Hit 2 become Skip Everyone and Hit 5 on the Wild Side. Be the first player to go out to win the game.

name: UNO Flip!
description: UNO gets a brand new twist in the new UNO Flip! card game. It essentially plays like regular UNO but with the addition of Flip cards. This UNO card deck is double-sided with a "light" side and a "dark" side. You start off playing with the light side, but if someone plays a Flip card, you have to switch to playing the dark side. And on the dark side, there are different action cards with stiffer penalties. Instead of a Draw One card, the dark side has a Draw Five card. Instead of a Skip Card, the dark side has a Skip Everyone card. You have to continue playing with the dark side until another Flip card is played. If you don't know how to play UNO, each player takes a turn matching a card from their hand to the card on the top of the discard pile, either by number, color, or symbol. If you don't have a match, you must draw a card from the draw pile. The symbols represent the action cards, such as Wild, Skip, Wild Draw 2, Draw One, and Reverse. This version also includes a Flip card that turns the cards to the dark side, which has the following actions: Draw Five, Reverse, Skip Everyone, Wild, Wild Draw Color, and Flip. When you play your next-to-last card, you must yell "UNO!" to indicate you only have one card left. If you don't yell "UNO" and someone catches you, you must draw two cards. Once a player runs out of cards, the round is over, and that player receives points for all of the cards left in their opponents' hands. Play until one player reaches 500 points.

name: UNO Flip!: Boruto – Naruto Next Generations (McDonald's Happy Meal Edition)
description: This is a fast-paced, double-sided promotional variant of the tactical card game, released globally as part of the 2026 McDonald's "UNO x Anime" Happy Meal crossover. Sporting an orange box design featuring Sarada Uchiha, this licensed travel-sized mini-deck shifts the standard formula by integrating double-sided cards consisting of a "Light Side" (white borders) and a punishing "Dark Side" (black borders). The game shrinks the deck architecture down to an optimized 43 cards for 2 to 4 players. Players start matching anime character artwork on the Light Side until someone plays a dedicated "Flip" card, forcing everyone to instantly turn their hands, the draw pile, and the discard pile over to the Dark Side. The Dark Side features significantly stiffer penalization, including severe variations like "Draw 5" and "Skip Everyone" cards. This set features a franchise-exclusive holographic foil "Sarada Chidori" Wild Card. When this card is played, it triggers an immediate physical reaction mechanic: all players must race to slap the card on the table. The last player to slap the pile fails the check and must immediately draw 4 cards as a penalty, while the active player chooses the next color to resume play.

name: UNO Flip!: Marvel Super Heroes or Villains
description: UNO Flip! card game adds an exciting twist to the classic UNO matching card action that everyone loves, and now the action includes heroes and villains from the Marvel universe! Play a Flip card and the deck FLIPS from the Heroes' side to the Villains' side which has penalties that are extra tough. A 'Draw 1' card on the Heroes' side becomes a 'Draw 5' card on the Villains' side! A Heroes' side 'Skip' card becomes a Villains' side 'Skip Everyone' card! Only another Flip card can change things back. And when you're down to one card, don't shout, 'assemble,' shout, 'UNO!' UNO Flip! Marvel card game features a two-sided deck, Heroes and Villains, and the Villains' side has penalties that are especially tough! UNO Flip! Marvel card game has special rules for both the Heroes' side and the Villains' side that really change the game!

name: UNO Flip!: My Hero Academia (McDonald's Happy Meal Edition)
description: This is a double-sided promotional card game released globally as part of the 2026 McDonald's "UNO x Anime" Happy Meal crossover campaign. Packed inside an explosive orange and black box featuring Katsuki Bakugo unleasing an explosion, this licensed travel-sized mini-deck brings the UNO Flip! mechanics into the superhuman world of Quirks across an optimized 43-card format tailored for 2 to 4 players. The game utilizes two distinct playable sides reflecting the eternal struggle between Heroes and Villains: the "Light Side" (white borders), which features the students of U.A. High School training and working together, and the punishing "Dark Side" (black borders), which turns the tables to feature the dangerous League of Villains. When a "Flip" card is played, all players must instantly turn over their hands, the draw pile, and the discard pile to activate severe Dark Side penalties like "Draw 5" and "Skip Everyone." This set features a franchise-exclusive holographic foil "Howitzer Impact" Wild Card. When played on either side, it triggers Bakugo's explosive combat drive: the active player chooses the next color to continue play, and then forces the next player in turn order to instantly reveal cards from the draw deck one by one until they pull a card matching that chosen color, adding all revealed non-matching cards directly into their hand.

name: UNO Flip!: Naruto (McDonald's Happy Meal Edition)
description: This is a double-sided promotional card game released globally as part of the 2026 McDonald's "UNO x Anime" Happy Meal crossover campaign. Housed in a dark teal/blue box featuring Sasuke Uchiha wielding his Chidori, this licensed travel-sized mini-deck adapts the popular UNO Flip! mechanics into an optimized 43-card format designed for 2 to 4 players. The game utilizes two distinct playable sides: the "Light Side" (white borders), which features standard gameplay with heroes from Konoha like Naruto and Sakura, and the punishing "Dark Side" (black borders), which shifts focus to villains and rogue shinobi like Orochimaru and the Akatsuki. When a "Flip" card is played, all players must instantly turn over their hand cards, the draw pile, and the discard pile to unleash much more aggressive action penalties, such as "Draw 5" and "Skip Everyone." This set features a franchise-exclusive holographic foil "Amaterasu / Eternal Mangekyo" Wild Card. When played on the Dark Side, it allows the active player to change the color and force an opponent to "burn" a card from their hand—permanently removing it from the round directly to the bottom of the draw pile—while skipping that opponent's next turn.

name: UNO Flip!: SPY x FAMILY (McDonald's Happy Meal Edition)
description: This is a double-sided promotional card game released globally as part of the 2026 McDonald's "UNO x Anime" Happy Meal crossover campaign. Packed inside a vibrant pink box featuring the energetic Anya Forger, this licensed travel-sized mini-deck brings the UNO Flip! mechanic to the world of Ostania across an optimized 43-card format tailored for 2 to 4 players. The game utilizes two distinct playable sides that mirror the dual natures of the characters: the "Light Side" (white borders), which highlights everyday family life with cute character illustrations of Anya, Bond, and school classmates, and the "Dark Side" (black borders), which plunges players into the secret underworld featuring Twilight's espionage missions and Thorn Princess's assassination targets. Playing a "Flip" card forces all players to instantly flip their hands and the draw piles over, unlocking much harsher action penalties like "Draw 5" and "Skip Everyone." This set features a franchise-exclusive holographic foil "Starlight Anya" Wild Card. When played, the active player chooses the next color and immediately awards themselves a "Starlight." In gameplay terms, this allows the player to select any opponent and force them to play the rest of the current round with their hand completely revealed face-up on the table, simulating Anya reading their mind to predict their next moves.

name: UNO Flip!: Stranger Things
description: UNO FLIP! flips classic UNO game play with twists like a double-sided deck, special FLIP card and tougher penalties that add a competitive edge…and with a theme inspired by the supernatural TV thriller Stranger Things, fans will really flip over this edition! There is a "Real World" side to the deck, which plays like the classic UNO game, and an "Upside Down" side where penalties are super-tough. Play the FLIP card, and all cards in the player's hand, the draw pile and draw deck are flipped over to reveal an entirely new set of numbers and colors on the opposite side. The holder of the FLIP card determines which side to play -- and when cards are switched back around. The "Upside Down" side of the deck includes action cards that really shake things up, like Draw Five and Skip Everyone. Strategize to rattle the competition and be the first to get rid of all cards to win. When players are down to one card, they still can't forget to shout "UNO!" This fun family card game is perfect for 2 to 10 players ages 7 years old and up, especially fans of the show. Colors and decorations may vary. Inspired by the hit supernatural thriller, UNO Flip! Stranger Things adds twists to classic gameplay with elements that offer a competitive edge! The collectible edition features a double-sided deck and special FLIP card designed with characters and images from the show! Play the special FLIP card and all cards are turned over, including the draw pile, to reveal an entirely new set of numbers and colors on the opposite side! The 'Real World' side of the deck plays like the classic UNO game; the 'Upside Down' side includes penalties that are super-tough, like Draw Five and Skip Everyone cards! The first to get rid of all their cards wins, but only if they don't forget to shout 'UNO!' —description from the publisher

name: Uno Flip!: Transformers
categories: Card Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number;Science Fiction
description: UNO Flip! card game adds an exciting twist to the classic game that includes Autobots and Decepticons from Transformers! Play a Flip card and the deck FLIPS from the Autobots' side to the Decepticons' side, which has penalties that are extra tough. Battle to get rid of cards with the Might of Optimus Prime Rule OR fight to see who must draw cards with the Tyranny of Megatron Rule! Only another Flip card can change things back. Makes a great gift for players 7 years and older, especially Transformers fans. —description from the publisher

name: UNO Friends Card Game
description: The UNO game brings friends together with a deck inspired by the Friends television show featuring favorite characters from the series. Players still try to match colors and numbers and will want to draw 'The One Where You Draw' card with a special rule that will have opponents drawing until they find the right Friend. When down do their last card, players don't say 'How You Doin'?', they yell 'UNO!' One for special 'The One Where You Draw' rule forces opponents to draw until they find the correct Friend.

name: UNO H2O
description: From the publisher: Ever played UNO underwater? Now you can, with UNO H20. Waterproof cards and carrying case let you take this easy, fast-paced family game to the pool, beach or anyplace that's wet. For 2 to 10 players, Ages 7 and up -- UNO H20 includes two new cards: Wild Downpour 1 and Wild Downpour 2. When played, all other players must draw 1 or 2 cards, respectively. The player of the card also determines the new color.

name: UNO H2O Splash
description: This version of UNO includes transparent, waterproof cards similar to UNO H2O and a special Whirlpool device. The Whirlpool has random effects that appear when shook (it works like a Magic 8-Ball). The rules are simplified. For example, the winner conditions are no longer points based. The first player to win three hands wins the game. Also gone are rules regarding playing Wild Draw 4 Cards when you can play another card. The Whirlpool is activated by playing a special Splash card or playing a 0 or a 2. The next player must then shake the Whirlpool and follow the results: 1) Draw H2O - draw until they get a blue, 2, 0 or wild card. 2) Wave Right - show a card to the player on the right. 3) Wave Left - show a card to the player on the left. 4) Wipeout - reverse order of play (player who started the Splash must use the whirlpool) Other possible Whirlpool results are draw, discard and give cards. The cards and Whirlpool are contained in a sturdy plastic box, with a slide on/off lid.

name: UNO Harry Potter Fandom Dark Arts
description: Fans of Harry Potter will love playing this Dark Arts themed UNO card game. With a deck featuring the Dark Mark, Deathly Hallows, and the seven Horcruxes, players try to match colors and numbers. There's even a special rule that, when triggered, compels other players to draw cards. Each deck also includes one collectible foil card. And when down to a last card, don't forget to yell, 'UNO!' Makes a magical gift for fans of Harry Potter and card game lovers ages 7 years old and up. Colors and decorations may vary. The UNO game players love features iconic images from the world of Harry Potter that fans will love! Gameplay matches the classic card game where players match colors and numbers to get rid of all their cards! The special rule allows a player to compel another player to produce a card of a chosen color. If they don't have it, they must draw three cards, but if they DO have it, the rule rebounds to another player of their choice! The deck comes with a special, foil-embossed card, which can be saved as a collectible or used in the game! This game is part of the UNO Fandom series, featuring the most iconic pop culture properties in movies, sports, comics, and more. Designed for 2 to 10 players ages 7 years and older, the collectible card game makes a great gift for fans of the Harry Potter and the Dark Arts!

name: UNO Hearts
description: This game combines the standard game of hearts with special cards. There are cards that when played force everyone to pass their hands to the next player. There are wild cards that can be any color. If you win a trick with a wild card in it the wild card will specify an amount of cards you must draw and add to your won tricks pile. At the end of a round you receive 1 point for each heart (red cards) in your wins and 13 points for winning the yellow 13 card. If one player takes all the points, that player gets 0 points and all other players are penalized 20 points. Fewest points wins.

name: UNO Hello Kitty & Friends
description: UNO Hello Kitty & Friends card game features cards with beloved Hello Kitty characters and a special rule to enhance gameplay. You want to match a card in your hand with the current card shown on top of the deck, and you’ll score points for the cards your opponents are left holding. In UNO Hello Kitty & Friends, there’s also a special rule card: the Badtz-Maru card! Badtz-Maru is a mischievous penguin who makes the player with the fewest cards draw four more. And if there’s a tie for the fewest cards, both players draw four cards!

name: UNO House Rules
description: This is the original Uno Card game with three new ways to play. Mattel had a contest to see what "House Rules" people used and added the three best variations. The Variants are as follows. Jump-In Uno: In this variation a player can assume control of the game if they have the exact same card that is on top of the discard pile. (This was the first place winner submited by Wess Eslinger.) Seven-O Uno: This involves passing your hands to other players when certain cards are played. (This was the second place winner submitted by Sarah Petite.) Progressive Uno: If a draw card is played then the "victim" can play the same type of card thus passing the result on to the next player. (This was the third place winner submitted by Douglas Temple.)

name: UNO Junior
description: Uno for children Ages 3 and up. Players are dealt 5 cards, the rest forming a draw pile. The first card from the draw pile is turned over and players take turns matching the top card in the discard pile. Cards can match by number, color or animal. A player who can't match a card must draw from the draw pile. A player must call "UNO" once he is down to a single card. A player who fails to do so and is challenged by another player must draw 2 cards. The first player to get rid of all his cards wins. Components: 56 cards Instructions Instead of numbers (in the classical version) the cards show some animals and some cards are missing.

name: UNO Junior Move!
description: UNO Junior Move! is a child-friendly adaptation of the classic UNO game, featuring simplified rules and engaging movement mechanics. Players match colors or numbers on cards while navigating a fun gameboard with their pawns. The first player to reach the finish line wins! Perfect for younger players, UNO Junior Move! combines the excitement of UNO with the thrill of a race. —description from the publisher

name: UNO Madness
description: UNO Madness is an implementation of the classic card game UNO with a mechanical gimmick. The game is played on a spring-mounted tray. After latching, the tray springs when a mechanical timer expires. The tray has 24 slots lined in a spiral path; the final slot (in the centre) is labeled with the word UNO. At the start of the game, the tray is latched and the timer wound up. Each player draws five tiles and keep their hand secret from the others. The first player places a numbered tile in the first slot on the tray and starts the timer. Continuing with the next player in sequence, the players follow the standard UNO rules in playing their tiles (color succeeds color, number succeeds number, draw when unable to play, etc). They also have to say "Madness" to signify the end of their turn. Play stops when a player has played his or her last tile, has played a tile on the last slot, or when the timer expires. In the first two cases, the player records his score (according to UNO rules, summing up values of the tiles in other players' hands) and the game is reset (tiles reshuffled and redrawn, etc). For the last case, everybody keeps their hand and the player who has yet to finish his or her turn when the board has sprung draws four more tiles. Play then continues. The game ends after a certain accumulated score has been reached or a certain number of rounds have been played.

name: UNO Marvel Captain Marvel
description: It's the classic matching card game you know, now with a thrilling Captain Marvel theme! Based on the action-packed film, this UNO deck features cards with images of fan-favorite Captain Marvel characters. Includes a special rule! The Cosmic Crush card forces opponents to replace their entire hand with new cards from the deck!

name: UNO MASTER
description: UNO version with time remaining for take cards. The rules are the same that basic UNO game -- players play cards to a central pile if they can match color or number, or use a special card. However, there is a timer machine for a non-stop match. There are 3 skill levels: an easy level with 8 seconds, a medium level with 6 seconds and a hard level with 4 seconds. Throw or take a card and switch on the red button before ends your time. If you do it later, you must take 4 additional cards!

name: UNO MOD
description: From the publisher: The ultra-popular card game gets a modern makeover with bold graphics and a sleek, portable case, making it a great gift idea! It's still the classic race to get rid of all your cards by matching colors and numbers - but has been enhanced with an exclusive MOD card. When you're down to your last card, don't forget to yell "UNO!" For ages 7+. -- This game is almost the same as regular UNO but introduces the MOD card which does add some rules to the base game of UNO. When playing a MOD card you name a color and then pass, in turn order, all cards you have of that color to the other players.

name: UNO Moo!
description: (from back of box) Match colors or animals to get the critters back in the barn! The farm animals have come out of their barn to play Uno! Round them up by matching colors or animals. Is there a blue pig on the barn door? Match it with any blue animal or any color pig. You can also play a farmer--he's wild and matches anything! The first player to get all of their figures back in the barn wins.

name: UNO Party!
description: Your goal in UNO Party! remains the same as in the original UNO game — empty your hand of cards first — but special rules and cards make the game playable with up to sixteen people at a time: ​The "Drawn Together" rule links two players who must draw cards at the same time. The "Point Taken" rule has all players pointing at other players, then each player must draw as many cards as there are fingers pointing at them! ​"Speed Play" lets players play a card out of turn — if they're fast enough... A direction tracker card helps keep track of the direction of game play.

name: UNO Pocket
description: The familiar Uno card game, in a smaller version. There are many variations of Uno Pocket (sometimes new decks are called Uno Mini). They usually contain around 46 cards and were made usually by Cartamundi as a promotion for the brand. They always feature a customized backs, but no rules differ from original Uno. Available as a gift by buying two packs of Mentos. In Europe, this was available in 2015 as part of a Nivea promotion.

name: UNO POP
description: It plays just like classic UNO, but with a twist: a pile of 12 Pop Cards that crank up the suspense. Anytime you must draw an UNO card you flip the top Pop Card instead. As numbers add up, tension builds until... BAM! - someone flips a Pop+1 or Pop+2 card. Add the total of all the Pop Cards and draw that many UNO cards.

name: UNO Power Grab
description: UNO Power Grab is a quick playing card game that presents a twist on the classic game of UNO. Players try to be the first empty their hand by matching either number or color of the card on top of the discard pile. Players must yell "UNO" when they have one card remaining. Wild cards can be played on any color and some cards give you control of Power Towers. Power Towers can be used to block action cards or sabotage opponents. If you manage to collect all 4 Power Towers, you get instant UNO! Discard until you have one card left. Includes 112 UNO cards, 4 Power Towers and discard tray

name: UNO Quatro
description: UNO Quatro is a classic four in a row game with an UNO twist! On your turn, play a tile in a column and try to make four in a row by matching color or number. There are three action tiles that can change the game. Swap lets you swap the positions of any two columns. Minus 2 removes some of your opponent's options. Lastly, Push pushes the bottom tile out of the column. Pay attention to what you play- everyone shares the tiles and you might set up your opponent's victory! —description from the publisher

name: Rage
description: Based on the widely-known card game Oh Hell!, players use the deck of zero through fifteen in six suits to bid for a particular number of tricks and then subsequently take exactly that many. Each game consists of ten hands, with the hand size shrinking by one each time, until the final one-card hand. Along the way, trump is randomly determined and can be changed during the hand through the use of special cards. There are also special cards that make the trump not count for a trick, others that can be declared any suit and value when played, and others that will give bonuses or penalties for taking the trick on which they're played. A newer version of this game was released by Amigo in 2000.

name: UNO Reflex
description: UNO Reflex Game: UNO reflex brings fast, fun action to the classic game of UNO. Race to match the colored light one of two ways: in Reflex mode, race to play the color first, in Wild mode use your skills to select the color you want. Includes the electronic UNO Reflex unit, 108 cards and instructions. For 2 to 10 players.

name: UNO Remix
mechanics: Hand Management;Legacy Game;Lose a Turn;Matching;Take That
description: UNO Remix features familiar UNO gameplay, with players trying to empty their hand by playing cards that match the value or color of the topmost discard play, but now you can personalize the deck to make it your own and change what's possible during the game. At the start of each round, you add special cards or write-on cards to the deck. You can personalize cards to specific players, e.g., "Skip to Aldie" or "Draw 2 Chad", you can add a mark to a card to increase the number of cards drawn the next time it's played, you can introduce cards that block penalty cards, and much more! And as always, when you have only one card left in hand, you must yell "UNO!" to warn others that you're about to win.

name: UNO Roboto
designers: Brian S. Spence;Kit Ho;Jessica Smith Yu
description: For the first time ever players are able to customize and personalize their UNO game with UNO Roboto. Record each player’s name and set unique house rules, then let UNO Roboto get the party started with surprise commands and funny phrases that change-up the game every time. After capturing rules and names, UNO Roboto gets the party started with surprise commands and funny phrases that change the outcome of the game! As the game progresses, players must keep up with UNO Roboto as he randomly selects the games twists and turns. Components: UNO Roboto figure, 108 cards

name: UNO Rummy-Up
description: UNO Rummy-Up combines two favorite classics, UNO and Rummikub, into one game. In this game, colorful UNO tiles are played like rummy but also use special UNO rules that make this game fun and exciting." A variation of Rummikub that adds the Draw Four, Draw Two, Reverse, and other special cards from the UNO card game. The object is still getting rid of all your tiles and having the lowest score.

name: UNO Showdown
description: UNO Showdown is the matching card game everyone loves but with the unexpected excitement of a card-shooting smackdown! When the lightning sounds and the UNO Showdown unit signal goes off, be the first to push down on the paddle. The quickest player wins the showdown and sends cards flying out of the UNO Showdown unit at their opponents! Players race to get rid of all their cards by matching them to the card shown on top of the deck. When players are down to one card, they must remember to yell "UNO!" Fun for kid, family or adult game night and a great gift for players ages 7 years and older. —description from the publisher

name: UNO Slam
description: Uno Slam is one of many variations on the popular Mattel card game Uno. It includes 108 cards as well as an electronic Slam unit, with a big red button and two card holders. The main difference from the original Uno is that every time you play a card, you have to slam the big red button. —user summary The UNO button is SLAMMED to start a race against the clock. Each player in turn attempts to play one card from their hand by matching either colour, number or symbol. After their turn they must quickly SLAM the UNO button before the 'BOING' sounds. If they fail, they must add another four cards to their hand. Players must remember to shout "UNO" when they only have one card left. The UNO SLAM unit has adjustable times for different levels of play. This new and exciting way to play UNO will give hours of tantalising hun for all the family. —description from the box (1996 First Edition)

name: Solitaire
mechanics: Point to Point Movement;Solo / Solitaire Game
description: A family of games designed for a single player. These puzzle-games challenge the player to clear a grid of tokens or pegs. Typically all but one space on the board is filled. The game is played by jumping a peg over one other into an empty space. The peg jumped over is removed from the board. This continues until no more jumps can be made. The object is to leave only a single peg or token left on the board. The two most common boards are the 33-peg English cross and the 37-peg French octagon boards. Ostensibly, this is Outside the Scope of BGG, but is kept in the database by fiat due to history.

name: Das UNO Spiel
description: UNO stands for United Nations Organization (i.e., the UN). In this game two players take both the roles of industrialized countries and as well as the role of a developing countries. The game is driven by chance cards, which have different effects for the industrial and developing countries (and also are different at different stages of the game). Players buy improvements of various sorts in an effort to earn "honors," but equal points are awarded at the end of the game for having the most money.

name: UNO Spin
description: From the Manufacturer: The UNO classic card game goes revolutionary! When a spin card is played, someone must spin the wheel. Will luck be on your side? Will players get to discard cards, be forced to pick up more cards, or even exchange hands? In a single turn, everything can change! Players can come from behind and suddenly take the lead. It's fast-paced fun that'll make your head spin! Includes one UNO Spin? wheel and 112 UNO Spin cards and instructions.

name: UNO Stacko
description: Jenga meets Uno. The blocks are colored and numbered, so you have to pull a block that matches either the color or the number of the previously-pulled block. Earlier editions of this game (1994-1996) had a die, the Uno cube, which was used to determine which kind of block had to be moved. In the versions with dice, the die determined either the number or the color of the block to be removed. The Reverse and Draw Two actions were only reflected on the die. In the later non-dice versions (1999-present), the actions were instead represented with symbols on some of the blocks (Reverse, Draw Two, Skip Turn, and Wild).

name: UNO Stacko Travel Size Bonus Pak
description: A bundled set of the UNO Stacko dexterity game and the UNO card game.

name: UNO Teams!
description: UNO Teams is a new way to play the classic game! Players still match color, number and symbol but instead of every-man-for-himself, they team up in pairs of two and play together to win. Special cards and rules help teammates work together, but both players must get rid of all the cards in their hands to win. And remember, when you (or your partner!) are down to your last card, don't forget to yell 'UNO!' —description form the publisher

name: UNO Tiki Twist
description: An interesting variant on the classic UNO theme in which players spin a tiki idol to learn their destiny! The mischievous tiki idol has taken over the game and whoever he points to must obey his commands. Sometimes he will be kind, allowing you to discard certain cards; other times he will be cruel, asking you to pick up even more cards! Sixteen unique action cards add unpredictability to every round. Like other UNO games, the first player to get rid of all their cards wins the round. Points in rounds accumulate and the first player to reach 500 points wins!

name: UNO Tippo
description: Like the classic game of UNO - the object is to be the first to get rid of all your cards. But now UNO Tippo has two discard piles to match color and number. Discard carefully! If you tip the trays you'll have to draw 2 cards!

name: UNO Triple Play
description: UNO Triple Play features the familiar UNO gameplay, with players trying to rid themselves of cards first, but this game comes with a special electronic unit that holds three discard piles and features lights and sounds. On your turn, you can play onto a discard pile only if it's lit up — and if any pile gets too many cards in it, it may overload, with the LED display indicating how many cards must be drawn! Lights and arcade sounds on the machine create maximum anticipation and excitement, and the "timer mode" makes the game move even faster. As always, when players have only one card left, they must yell "UNO!"

name: UNO Truth: Adults Only
description: Adult fans of UNO card games will love this honest take on the classic game. It plays like regular UNO matching color and number, but if a Truth Card is played, the player must decide if they are willing to risk telling the truth versus the penalty of drawing cards. There are four levels of truth: juicy, shameful, dirty, and dark! A chance roll of the die determines which truth players must tell. A card with a “reverse” icon on it forces the player who played the Truth Card to tell the truth! But the party doesn't end there, these cards are durable, waterproof plastic cards to make them completely spill-proof and comes with a handy clip to keep them together! Makes a great gift for fans and game lovers ages 18 years old and up. —description from the publisher

name: UNO Ultimate DC
description: If you can't be a superhero at least you can play UNO like one with the DC Comics UNO Ultimate Card Game! Each player chooses the identity of a DC character who has powers you can use on every turn! After you choose your character, you play the game with a corresponding Character Deck. In the UNO Ultimate card game you match colors, numbers, and symbols just like classic UNO. Each Character Deck has special power and Wild Cards designed just for that character. There's also a Danger Deck with "Event", "Enemy", "Item" and "Location" cards that can really change the game! Like any great superhero battle, there's going to be a lot of powers and stuff lying around, so buckle-up and pay attention! There are also two ways to win: Get rid of all your cards in your hand or be the last player standing with cards in their character deck. Look out for more add-on decks to expand your game (sold separately) —description from the publisher Aquaman The king of the seven seas, Aquaman needs to have his locations in play to really take control of the game. Use your cards to "fish" for new locations and get the benefits of battling in your character-specific locations as well as from your character power. Wonder Woman Always thirsting for battle, Wonder Woman thrives when she is fighting and defeating enemies. Play your "!" Cards purposefully to get enemies into the game so you can then defeat them! Don't be afraid to keep Enemy Cards around longer to activate your character power when you need to take control of the game. Superman More powerful than a locomotive and faster than a speeding bullet. The big blue Boy Scout is not to be underestimated. With a well-balanced deck of utility wild cards, Superman is perfect for going up against any other character. Since his power is reactive make sure to always be on your toes when someone tries to skip you. Green Lantern Protector of sector 2814, Hal Jordan battles with all his will and might. As a Green Lantern, your power is related to your willpower. Green Lantern's power mirrors his will power. Use his character power strategically when you have powerful cards in your burn pile to surprise your opponents. Remember to keep an eye on your character deck so it doesn't get down to only a few cards!

name: UNO Ultimate Marvel
description: If you can't be a Superhero at least you can play UNO like one! Each player chooses the identity of a Marvel character who has powers you can use on EVERY TURN! After you choose your character, you play the game with a corresponding Character Deck. In the UNO Ultimate card game you match colors, numbers, and symbols just like classic UNO. Each Character Deck has special power and Wild Cards designed just for that character. There's also a Danger Deck with "Event" cards and "Enemy" cards that can really change the game! Like any great superhero battle, there's gonna be a lot of powers and stuff lying around, so buckle-up and pay attention! There are also two ways to win! Get rid of all your cards in your hand or be the last player standing with cards in their character deck. Collectible foil cards in each box. Don't forget to call Uno when down to 1 card! Characters: Black Panther Black Panther is in it for the long haul by trying to stay in the game as long as possible. As Black Panther's ability comes from defeating Enemies, you will want to hold onto your Danger Icon Cards and play them when you have cards in your Burn Pile. You might not always get an Enemy when you play them but you don't want to waste the chance at recovering cards early on by defeating Enemies. Captain Marvel Captain Marvel is always looking for the right strategy to do the most damage. With her character power letting her always have the right color to play, use it to never miss your plays. Change the color when you can to prevent other players from being able to defeat their attacking Enemies. Sometimes you may want to use her power to change the color to play a powerful Action Card such as Skip or Draw Two. Iron Man Iron Man always likes to be on the attack. Iron Man wants to burn as many cards as possible from the other players decks, and try to eliminate multiple players at a time to win. So, you want to play as many Danger Icon Cards as you can to keep the pressure on. Keep in mind that every time you play a Danger Icon Card you will have to flip a Danger Card. Thor Thor is great at attacking other players and trying to eliminate them one at a time. When playing as Thor you want to decide either to focus on one player at a time or spread out your Wild Cards to affect all players. That means when you play your Wild Cards you want to make sure you are using them to change the active color o get the most effectiveness out of your character power.

name: UNO Ultimate Marvel: 2nd Edition
categories: Card Game;Collectible Components;Comic Book / Strip;Number;Party Game
description: With this UNO Ultimate card game, players may not be Marvel Super Heroes, but they can play like they are! This premium version of UNO features four card decks, each designed specifically for a popular, heroic character. Each player chooses to play as a character who has special powers that they can use on EVERY turn. A Danger Deck holds "Event", "Enemy" and the new "Item" cards to switch the balance of power! Players race to get rid of all their cards just like the classic UNO game, and they can't forget to yell "UNO!" when down to their last one. Unique to UNO Ultimate are TWO ways to win each round as well as four collectible, never-before-seen Foil Cards which players can keep and collect or put in the game itself to spice up the Ultimate deck! The card game makes a great gift for fans of UNO, Marvel and fun on game night. Colors and decorations may vary. —description from the publisher Shuri A tech genius and strategist, Shuri always has the right tool for any job and if she doesn't, she will make it. Use her power to swap the cards you need for the perfect moment or save it for later. As she is item focused, always pay attention to other players when they get or use their items. Captain America Fights for freedom wherever there is trouble. He will never give up and never surrender. He is a utility fighter. Cap uses whatever is at his disposal to get the job done. Use his cards in the right situation to deliver the best results. Pick the right targets and save the day. Black Widow A master spy and assassin, Natasha Romanoff is always in control. Use her cards to manipulate her opponents into playing into her traps. Maximize her character power by eliminating opponents' ability to play cards or remove wild card threats. Hulk The strongest there is. His strength is overpowering and his toughness is unmatched. Hulk's power and cards reflect his reckless abandon and unstoppable force. Use your cards to burn through your deck to get angry while dishing out massive destruction against your opponents. Play your danger icon cards to get more enemies out for Hulk to fight and get him enraged.

name: UNO Ultimate: Spider-Man 2099 vs. Venom Add-On 2-Pack
description: Take your game night to new superhero levels with the UNO Ultimate Marvel Spider-Man 2099 vs. Venom Add-On 2-Pack. Each package includes two never-before-seen decks with special cards and unique rules for each character. The Spider-Man 2099 and Venom cards contain comic-inspired artwork and special Venom symbiote-infected packaging that visually emulates the characters’ narratives. UNO Ultimate Marvel Spider-Man 2099 vs. Venom Add-On 2-Pack Set of two UNO Ultimate decks featuring characters from the Spider-Verse First UNO Ultimate decks with all-foil cards Can be played together or added to any UNO Ultimate deck Special comic book designed packaging with a transparent vinyl sleeve overlay Colors and decorations may vary.

name: UNO Wild Jackpot
description: UNO Wild Jackpot is a spin on traditional UNO that incorporates a slot machine-style device and re-writable custom rules cards. Before the game begins, players come up with their own unique custom rules and write them on the dry erase custom rules cards. These are shuffled and inserted into the back of the slot machine. During the game, which plays exactly like standard UNO, you can play a special Jackpot card to pull the lever on the slot machine. This spins a random result on the center wheel, such as dispensing one of the custom rules to a player at the table who must then follow that rule.

name: UNO Wild Tiles
description: Players draw hands of tiles with color and number and arrow markings. Much like in the card-based UNO, each player must play the next tile that matches either the color or number of the previous one played. However in UNO Wild Tiles, they must play it on the space indicated by the arrow on the previous tile, and may place their own tile so that the arrow suits them. Winner is the first to clear their rack, or the person with the fewest points when it is impossible to play any more tiles.

name: UNO Zero
mechanics: Grid Movement;Hand Management;Lose a Turn;Memory;Pattern Building;Take That
description: UNO Zero is a table top card game, where the goal is to score as low as possible (ideally zero points hence the name). Each player at the beginning has a set of six cards faced down in front of them. The grid consists of three columns and two rows. At the beginning each player can turn and reveal two of their cards. After that all players attempt to reveal all their face-down cards by drawing one card each turn from the discard or draw pile and exchanging them with one of their cards. Two cards of the same colour or the same number in one column are discarded. That way players can get rid of their points. What's special about UNO zero is that the typical UNO action cards are part of this game. The reverse card changes the direction of the game. The draw two or draw 4 card makes players add more columns to their grid. And the skip card has the next player skip their turn. That makes this game vey dynamic, surprising and fun. Each round is different and you can get very lucky and have only two cards left at the very end, or unlucky and you still have 12 cards in front of you while another player finishes the game. Once there is only one face-down card left in your grid you have to say UNO or you'll be punished to draw two more cards. It's easy to learn and start, since the rules are quickly explained and the famous UNO action cards almost anybody already knows. —description from the publisher

name: UNO: 30 Year Anniversary Edition
description: The same basic Uno game, but it adds in an Anniversary Card that allows a player to give all their cards except one to another player.

name: UNO: 50th Anniversary
description: The UNO card game is celebrating 50 years of bringing people together for fast fun and unpredictable twists with this premium Golden Anniversary edition of the classic card game. It arrives in a deluxe, specially designed box and includes cards with a velvety smooth finish. A commemorative golden medallion collector coin is included, and when someone plays the special "50/50" card you flip it to see who will have to draw extra cards! Just like the last 50 years, when a player is down to one card, they must yell "UNO!"

name: UNO: A Charlie Brown Valentine
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Another Uno variation. This features the theme of A Charlie Brown Valentine. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The "Secret Valentine" card, which lets you look into your opponent's heart (and hand) and gives you an advantage in planning your moves

name: UNO: Alex Rodriguez Limited Edition
description: Celebrate one of the biggest stars in Major League Baseball with this special Alex Rodríguez Edition of UNO. 112 Custom Cards feature A-Rod of the Yankees in action at third base or at the plate doing what he doeas best: getting big hits and driving in runs. Same great UNO play PLUS the exclusive MVP card and rule. Be sure to yell "UNO" as you try to be the best player in the game just like A-Rod is year after year. —description from the box

name: UNO: All Wild!
description: UNO All Wild plays just like traditional UNO except every card is wild. That means instead of having to matching color and number, you can play any card you want. The goal is the same: be the first player to get rid of all your cards. But it gets complicated thanks to the addition of new action cards that let players strategize and make sure no one goes out too soon. —description from the designer The card distribution of "Uno All Wild!" is as follows: Normal Wild Card: 54 Reverse Wild Card: 14 Skip Wild Card: 14 Skip 2 (Double Skip) Wild Card: 6 Draw 2 Wild Card: 10 Targeted Draw 2 Wild Card: 4 Draw 4 Wild Card: 6 Forced Swap Wild Card: 4

name: UNO: All Wild! Grogu!
categories: Card Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Science Fiction
description: No colors, no numbers - no problem! ALL CARDS ARE WILD! Swap cards with other players with the special "Grogu's Help" rule! —description from the back of the box Grogu's Help allows the player that has played it to look at another player's hand and swap any equal number of cards with theirs.

name: UNO: American Kennel Club
description: This is a slight variation on the standard Uno card game, in which you try to be the first to play all the cards in your hand by matching the last discard by color, number, or card type (Wild, Draw 2, Reverse, Skip, etc.). This version features different dogs for each number card (i.e., all the 1's have one specific dog, all the 2's have another dog, etc.), and each dog is a particular breed as recognized by the American Kennel Club. This is packaged in one of 4 sets: Terrier Group, Sporting Group, Non-Sporting Group, and Herding Group. Each group showcases dogs from that category of the AKC. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The Best in Show card. When you play this card you name a card color (red, yellow, blue, or green). Each player draws a card from the draw deck until he draws a card of the named color. Once all players have done this the player to your left resumes by playing a card of the named color.

name: UNO: Angry Birds
description: From the publisher: "Get ready to for high-flying fun with the Angry Birds UNO Card Game! It's the original UNO card game with colorful graphics and card illustrations from the popular app Angry Birds, plus a unique, special rule! Play the special King Pig card and choose a color. Each opponent then has to draw cards until they find a card that matches the selected color. It's fast fun for everyone, but especially Angry Birds fans."

name: UNO: Arsenal Highbury Legends
description: Themed Uno game based on the football (soccer) club, Arsenal Highbury. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The special "Red Card" and "Yellow Card" cards and rules (referring to the card penalties given by players for infractions), which do not correlate to cards/rules in regular Uno.

name: UNO: Avengers
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Unite with Earth's Mightiest heroes in this Avengers edition of Uno Game! Fight the foes no single hero could withstand with the special Avengers Assemble card! And remember to yell "Uno!" before you play your last card and the battle is won! Contents: 112 cards, instructions. includes 4 special Avengers Assemble cards with a special rule: Whenever evil dares to show its face, the Avengers assemble to defeat it! When another player plays a Draw 2 or a Draw 4 card on you, you may use this card to block it! This card is also a wild card, so you choose the color that resumes play.

name: UNO: Barbie
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Another Uno variation. It features Barbie and friends on the back of the cards and a Barbie-esque decorative scheme on the front including a phone, purse, hat, perfume and flower. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The Friendship card. When a Friendship card is played, it allows you to trade cards with another player, exchanging your entire hand for theirs.

name: UNO: Barbie California Girl
description: Based on the Barbie Cali Girl Line of Toys. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The "Beachcomber" Card - When played the "Beachcomber" card allows a player to instantly discard one card from each color (up to four cards total) to any other player of their choice.

name: UNO: Barbie The Movie
description: The game of Uno with a Barbie The Movie theme. A special “Played With Too Much” rule will have players both discarding and drawing cards. Game play matches the classic card game where players match colors and numbers to get rid of all their cards.

name: UNO: Batman Begins
categories: Card Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Based on the 2005 Batman Begins movie. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: the special Justice Card. "When a Justice card is played, the player who plays it may deal out 'justice' to the other players in the form of his/her cards. Starting in the current direction of play, the player dealing 'justice' gives one card to each of the remianing players until he/she is down to one card. Upon dealing the next to last card the player of the Justice card must call 'UNO' or be subjected to the two-card penalty. This card also functions as a regular Wild card allowing the player who plays it to call out a new colour when he/she finishes dealing out his/her cards."

name: UNO: Batman Comics
description: The UNO game players love features graphics inspired by favorite characters from DC Comics' Batman. Game play matches the classic card game where players match colors and numbers to get rid of all their cards. The special 'Bat Signal' rule forces an opponent to draw cards until they get a card with either Batman, Robin, Batgirl or Nightwing on it, and then add all the cards to their hand! When down to one card, don't forget to yell, 'UNO!' Designed for 2 to 10 players ages 7 years and older, the collectible card game makes a great toy for fans of Batman comics!

name: UNO: Batman Special Edition
categories: Card Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: On the dark streets of Gotham City, an urban legend meets America's #1 brand of family games. UNO - Batman Edition includes 112 cards featuring the Dark Knight and evil villains, The Riddler, Catwomen, Harley Quinn, and Two-Face. The Joker causes havoc for all who cross his path with the exclusive Joker's 3 Card and rule! Packaged in this collectible tin, UNO - Batman Edition brings the excitement of Gotham City to you and your friends. Use your stealth and speed, and be the first to get 500 points to win the game!

name: UNO: Batman v Superman – Dawn of Justice
categories: Card Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Similar to regular UNO except there are a few special Justice cards. Based on the 2016 movie Batman Vs. Superman.

name: UNO: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
description: The UNO game players love features graphics inspired by favorite characters from the Beetlejuice Beetlejuice movie. The special “Beetlejuice Beetlejuice Beetlejuice” rule lets a player draw 3 cards and then give them to any opposing player they want. But be careful – whoever plays the card must remember to say “Beetlejuice” three times or they must take all the cards. When down to one card, don’t forget to yell, “UNO!”

name: UNO: Betty Boop Vintage
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Another Uno Variation. The Betty Boop Vintage Edition. Comes in a special collector's tin and stars vintage Betty Boop and company. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: On-the-Go card and rule.

name: UNO: Boruto – Naruto Next Generations (McDonald's Happy Meal Edition)
description: This is a travel-sized, promotional version of the classic card-shedding game, released as part of the global 2026 McDonald's "UNO x Anime" Happy Meal crossover. This licensed deck scales the traditional formula down into a fast-paced 43-card mini-deck optimized for 2 to 4 players. The game features character art from the Boruto: Naruto Next Generations anime series across four colored suits (Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green), containing numbered cards alongside essential action variants like Skip, Reverse, and Draw 1. In addition to standard Wild cards, the deck introduces a franchise-exclusive "Momoshiki Takeover" rule card. When played, it allows the active player to change the current color while forcing opponents to reveal their hands, granting the power to steal a card or force a card swap between two competing players; it also can be played against Draw 1 card.

name: UNO: Boston Celtics Legends
description: Another Uno variation. UNO Boston Celtics Legends Edition celebrates basketball stars such as Larry Bird, Robert Parish, Kevin McHale, Bill Russell and more of Boston's finest. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: exclusive Steal card and rule.

name: UNO: Boston Red Sox
description: This themed vesion of Uno features the 2004 World Series Champion Boston Red Sox players and team. This version of Uno includes a special card/rule that does not correlate to any card in regular Uno, the "ESRUC" card and rule commemorating Jason Varitek and Keith Foulke in the ultimate celebratory embrace after winning the championship.

name: UNO: Brett Favre NFL Greatest Players Edition
description: Another Uno variation, this one based on NFL quarterback star Brett Favre. Comes in a case shaped and decorated like Favre's #4 Jersey. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: exclusive "Leap" card and rule celebrating the famous "Lambeau Leap".

name: UNO: Brian Urlacher Special Edition
description: An Uno variation themed on Brian Urlacher, star football player for the NFL Chicago Bears Football team. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Exclusive "MLB" (i.e. Middle LineBacker) card and rule.

name: UNO: BTS
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Basically the same as UNO, except with cards that feature the K-pop band BTS. Cards that are different from traditional UNO: The Dancing Wild card -- the next player in current order must perform a BTS dance routine in from of everyone OR draw three cards.

name: UNO: Burger King Edition
description: A somewhat streamlined version of Uno, first given away as a promotional item in Burger King Kid's Meals in 2012. The Deck is only 36 cards. Each suite (green, yellow, blue and red) is comprised of 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and Draw 2. Finally, there are 4 Wild Cards. As in regular Uno, the object is to eliminate your hand before your opponents. Because of the reduced card counts, this edition seems to be optimized for 2-player play: the set lacks the traditional skips, reverses and draw 4 wilds of the normal edition.

name: UNO: Care Bears
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Basic Uno Themed card game. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The "Care A Lot" card. This card works like a wild card and basically spreads the love around the table. Everyone is allowed play any card they want to regardless of color. Any action card is basicaly dead for this round of play.

name: UNO: Cars
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: The usual Uno rules - Players race to empty their hands and catch opposing players with cards left in theirs, which score points. In turns, players attempt to play a card by matching its color or number to the topmost card on the discard pile. If unable to play, players draw cards from the draw pile until they are able to place a card. Wild and special cards spice things up a bit. Additionally, when playing their penultimate card from their hand, players must shout 'UNO' or face a forfeit of drawing two further cards. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Victory Lap Card. When played, each player puts their hand face down on the table and passes it to the next player. Only the player of the victory lap card gets to look at the hand in front of them, which they choose to either keep or pass. If they keep passing, the hands keep getting passed around, until the Victory Lap player selects a hand to keep. Play then continues with all players adopting the new decks they now have in front of them.

name: UNO: Cars 2
description: A new spin on an old game! From Mattel comes this fast paced Uno Card Game celebrating the 40th Anniversary Year of UNO!! Join Lightning McQueen and all your CARS 2 friends for an UNO race to the finish! Get a secret peek at everybody else's hand with the Special Agent Mater card and rule! And don't forget to yell UNO! before you cross the finish line! 112 Cards included plus Instructions

name: UNO: Cars 3
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Racing
description: Description from the Included Instructions: Object of the Game Be the first player to get rid of all of your cards in each round and score points for the cards your opponents are left holding. Points in rounds accumulate and the first player to reach 500 points wins. Crash-Up Rule — Accidents happen! If you pull this card from the draw pile — CRASH! IMMEDIATELY combine the cards in your hand with the cards from the hand of the next player in order. Shuffle the cards well, and then deal them back between the two of you starting with the other player. Put the Crash Up Rule card on the discard pile, and since it's a wild card, pick a new color that resumes play. If this card is turned up at the beginning of play, the person to the left of the dealer chooses the color that begins play. Contents 112 Cards as follows: 19 Blue cards - 0 to 9 19 Green cards - 0 to 9 19 Red cards - 0 to 9 19 Yellow cards - 0 to 9 8 Draw Two cards - 2 each in blue, green, red and yellow 8 Reverse cards - 2 each in blue, green, red and yellow 8 Skip cards - 2 each in blue, green, red and yellow 4 Wild cards 4 Wild Draw Four cards 4 Crash-Up Rule Cards Description from the publisher: (inconsistent with cards provided in the pack and the included instructions) It's the matching game you love, now featuring your favorite iconic characters from Cars 3!
