This card works like a wild card and also the player may designate himself or another player to put their hand under the Gamma Blast card and then draw that same amount of cards form the draw pile. They then discard the Gamma Blast along with their original hand and play continues.

name: UNO: Incredibles 2
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number
description: This special deck includes the Wild Screen Slaver Card, which hypnotizes cards and adds a fun twist to the game!

name: UNO: Iron Man 2
categories: Card Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number
description: Plays like standard Uno with red, green, blue, and yellow cards (25 each color) numbered 0-9, with skip, draw, reverse, wild and wild draw four cards. In addition, there are four additional "War Machine" cards for a total of 112 cards for this version. War Machine cards count 50 points in scoring and make you impervious to the effects of draw 2 and draw 4 cards by making your opponent draw those cards. The Iron Man 2 version of Uno is listed in the main Uno Wikipedia page under "Theme packs". The Iron Man character is prominent on the bulk of the cards, with other characters from the movie used on the skip, draw, reverse, etc... cards.

name: UNO: It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: This is a themed version of Uno based on the amnimated classic "It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown!" This version has an additional, special card which does not correlate to an card in regular Uno, the "Trick or Treat!" card.

name: UNO: Jean-Michel Basquiat
description: Players race to empty their hands and catch opposing players with cards left in theirs, which score points. In turns, players attempt to play a card by matching its color, number, or word to the topmost card on the discard pile. If unable to play, players draw a card from the draw pile, and if still unable to play, they pass their turn. Wild and special cards spice things up a bit. UNO Artiste series - jean-michel basquiat is the first deck in the UNO series inspired by great artists. Basquiat made his debut as a writer in the late 1970s and many of his creations are reproduced in these cards. Contains four extra two-sided "artist" cards, which combine to recreate one of his masterpieces. This is a premium and collectible deck.

name: UNO: Jelly Belly Special Edition
description: From the back of the box: "UNO teams up with Jelly Belly for this special edition of the fast-paced card game loved by millions. Each game box includes a special deck of bean-shaped UNO cards, Jelly Belly jelly beans and special rules that sweeten the play." Contents: 54 cards 3.5 oz. Jelly Belly jelly beans (5 flavors) Compared to a standard Uno deck, there are half as many cards, with only one Wild and one Wild Draw Four but still four zeroes. The rules state that when you force someone to draw cards (with a Draw 2 or wild Draw 4) you can take that many beans from the source pile. If you collect 10 beans, you may immediately discard all cards but one in your hand.

name: UNO: John Deere Edition
description: Test you mettle with the John Deere version of UNO! 112 Custom Cards featuring legendary John Deere equipment. Same great UNO play PLUS the special Harvest card which forces your opponents to do some heavy lifting! When you play this card, select another another player to draw cards from the draw pile until he/she draws a green card which will allow them to complete the harvest (or until they draw 5 cards, whichever comes first.) Remember to shout "UNO!" when your hand gets down to the last "crop"! Comes in Collector's Tin.

name: UNO: Jurassic World
description: It's the world's #1 card game, now featuring dinosaurs! Jurassic World fans and Uno players alike will enjoy this new spin on a classic card game. Not only do the cards feature dinosaurs and characters from the movie, but they include a special action card that allows you to discard all raptors from your hand! Just like classic Uno, the goal is to discard all of your cards to win the round. The first player to reach 500 points wins! Don't forget to yell "Uno!" when you have only one card left. —description from the publisher

name: UNO: Jurassic World Rebirth
categories: Animals;Card Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number;Party Game;Science Fiction
description: Fans of Jurassic World Rebirth will love playing with this themed UNO card game. With a deck featuring graphics inspired by favorite characters and scenes, players try to match colors and numbers -- there's even a special 'Attack of the T. Rex' rule that will have somebody drawing five cards! And when down to a last card, don't forget to snarl 'UNO!' Makes a great gift for fans of Jurassic World Rebirth and card game lovers ages 7 years old and up. Colors and decorations may vary. The UNO game players love features graphics inspired by characters from Jurassic World Rebirth. Game play matches the classic card game where players match colors and numbers to get rid of all their cards. The special 'Attack of the T. Rex' rule has players trying to match a chosen color with cards in their hand or they must draw 5 cards! When down to one card, don't forget to yell, 'UNO!' Designed for 2 to 10 players ages 7 years and older, this card game makes a great gift for fans of Jurassic World Rebirth! Includes 112 cards, 1 collectible foil card and instructions.

name: UNO: Justice League
categories: Card Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: It’s the family favorite card game you love, now enhanced with the power of the Justice League! Players race to get rid of all their cards by matching a card in their hand with the current card shown on top of the deck. There are two customizable cards and a special new wild card: the Superman X-Ray vision card! That card lets you look at any other player's cards and make strategic exchanges that pump up the excitement! Score points by being the first to get rid of all the cards in your hand. First player or team to 500 wins. When you're down to one card, don't forget to yell "UNO!" Contains 112 cards plus instructions. For 2 to 10 players, ages 7 and older. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down. —description from the publisher

name: UNO: Kobe Bryant Special Edition
description: Uno variation themed on Kobe Bryant, star basketball player for the NBA Los Angeles Lakers team. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Exclusive "Three-Pointer" card and rule which allows you to choose a player to keep drawing cards until they can draw a #1, #2, or #3 card.

name: UNO: KPop Demon Hunters
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number;Party Game
description: Fans of Netflix’s KPop Demon Hunters will love this UNO card game. Featuring artwork inspired by the film, players race to match colors and numbers, plus a Wild Golden Honmoon card unites everyone to seal the Honmoon before play continues. Packed with dramatic twists, this deck brings excitement to every round. UNO® KPop Demon Hunters Deck Dynamic UNO edition featuring characters from the hit movie Comes with 112 cards plus instruction sheet Wild Golden Honmoon is a special rule card unique to KPop Demon Hunters decks Illustrated closed box packaging Colors and decorations may vary. Product subject to availability. Purchase limits subject to change at the sole discretion of Mattel. Please note: The cards and packaging depicted in these images are design prototypes. Final production design, colors, and textures may vary.

name: UNO: Kung Fu Panda
categories: Animals;Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Join Po & the Martial Arts Masters for an UNO card game showdown! Challenge any opponent to a Kickin' Battle with the exclusive card & rule! And Don't forget to yell UNO when you are about to become the Chosen One!

name: UNO: LaDainian Tomlinson Special Edition
description: An Uno variation themed on LaDainian Tomlinson , star running back for the National Football League San Diego Chargers Team. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Exclusive "MVP" card and rule commemorating Tomlinson's selection as the NFL's Most Valuable Player

name: UNO: LeBron James Special Edition
description: An Uno variation themed on LeBron James, star basketball player for the NBA Cleveland Cavaliers team. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Exclusive "Hail to the King" card and rule that forces an opponent to draw cards from you and other players

name: UNO: Lilo & Stitch
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number;Science Fiction
description: The UNO game players love features graphics inspired by characters from Disney's Lilo and Stitch. Game play matches the classic card game where players match colors and numbers to get rid of all their cards. The special 'Ohana' rule lets players with more than 4 cards in their hand discard down to 4, and player with less than 4 cards in their hand draw up to 4. When down to one card, don't say, 'Aloha' -- shout 'UNO!' —description from the publisher

name: UNO: Limited Too It's A Girl's World
description: From the box: Pack your bags and get ready for fun with the Limited Too edition of Uno! 110 Custom Cards featuring the Limited Too crew exploring their favorite cities with their best friends. Same great Uno play plus the exclusive Around the World card that allows players to travel to a new place and gain an edge on their opponents. Summary: Just like standard Uno. The Around the World card allows you to swap all hands left, right or across, player's choice, and also choose the color like a Wild card.

name: UNO: Los Angeles Lakers Legends Edition
description: An Uno variation based on great players from the National Basketball Association (NBA) team, the Los Angeles Lakers. Cards feature Hall of Famers and championship winners including Shaquille O'Neal, Magic Johnson, Jerry West, James Worthy, Kareem Abdul-Jabaar & more. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Has an exclusive "SHOWTIME!" card & rule which does not correlate to any card in regular Uno.

name: UNO: Magic Treehouse
description: This is a version of Uno themed on The Magic Treehouse, a series of children's books for young readers. This version of Uno includes a special card not found in regular Uno, the "Fly Away" card, which operates both as Wild card and also allows a player to "Fly Away" and look at another player's hand.

name: UNO: Mario Kart
description: UNO Mario Kart plays like classic UNO except every card has a symbol in the bottom corner that represents iconic Mario Kart items (Mushroom, Banana Peel, Green Shell, Lightning, or Bob-omb). The items don’t do anything during normal play, but if you play a Wild Item Box Card you get to flip the top card of the deck into the discard pile and immediately use the item shown on that card. Each item has a different action: Mushroom: Take another turn. Banana Peel: The player who went before you has to draw two cards. Green Shell: Any player of your choice must draw one card. Lightning: All other players must draw one card, then you take another turn. Bob-omb: You must draw two cards, then you can choose the color that continues play.

name: UNO: Marvel Heroes
description: An Uno variation. This version features various Marvel Super Heroes and Villains. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The Feats of Fate card. When you play the Feats of Fate Card is played you can trade one of your cards to the first player in clock-wise order who has a Draw 4 Wild or Draw 2 card. If none of your opponents have one of the requested cards then you can play another card of your choice.

name: UNO: Marvel Ultimate Spider-man Web-Warriors Card Game
description: With great power comes great fun in this Ultimate Spider-Man edition of UNO game! Get yourself out of a sticky situation with the special "Web Slinger" card! Listen to your Spidey-Sense and yell "UNO!" before you play your last card! —description from the publisher This variant of UNO differs in that there are 'web slinger' wild cards. They are wild plus you get to 'sling' up to 3 cards from your hand, all of the same color, to other players' hands (however you choose).

name: UNO: Masters of the Universe
description: The UNO card game everyone loves gets a powerful look with He-Man and the Masters of the Universe. Featuring dynamic graphics of MOTU characters from powerful heroes to deadly sorcerers, it also includes a unique rule -- the Power of Greyskull Card. To use it, the player must hold it above their head and say, "By the power of Greyskull, I have the power!!" All other players then draw 3 cards. Game play is like classic UNO: players match cards by color or number in a race to get rid of all the cards in their hand. When down to one card, they must shout triumphantly like He-Man "UNO!"

name: UNO: Mets Special Edition
description: Get ready to make a run to October with the 2007 New York Mets edition of UNO. 112 custom cards feature Pedro Martinez, David Wright, Jose Reyes, Carlos Beltran, Carlos Delgado and other Mets stars. Same great UNO play PLUS the exclusive Acquisition card celebrating the signing of dominating closer Moises Alou. Make sure you yell "UNO" as you go for a walk-off winner of your own! —description from the back of the box

name: UNO: Michigan
description: Show your school spirit with the Wolverines in the University of Michigan edition of UNO. 112 custom cards feature campus landmarks including the Law Quad, the Rock, the Michigan Union, the Cube, and more. Same great UNO play PLUS the exclusive Go Blue card and rule. Be ready to yell "UNO!" as you show your blue and maize pride and go for the win! —description from the back of the box

name: UNO: Minecraft
description: UNO with a Minecraft Theme. Playing UNO Minecraft is a TNT blast of fun. Watch out! The Creeper card will make you draw 3 more cards. And don't forget to yell "UNO!" before you mine your last card. —description from the publisher

name: UNO: Minions – The Rise of Gru
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: UNO with Minions theme, but with a special rule that let's you strike a pose in the game. There is a card called the Wild Dumb Fu card. If you play it, the next player in line skips their turn. Instead they have to hold a martial art pose until the next time, their turns comes on. If they move before it's their turn, they have to draw 4 cards. It also is a wild card so when you play it, you can choose the color to resume in play.

name: UNO: Monster High
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Fantasy;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Monster High UNO Card Game: The classic game of UNO gets a new twist with the Monster High edition. It's the original UNO card game featuring favorite Monster High characters and scenes. Plus, there's a new special rule: the Creeperific “Urrrhhh” card allows the player to channel his or her inner zombie and give away some of those frightful cards! It's Fast Fun For Everyone! Includes 112 cards and instructions. —description from the publisher

name: UNO: Monster High
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Fantasy;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Easy to pick up... Impossible to put down! Same great UNO plus the EXCLUSIVE Skull* card and play! (*Blocks a "Draw 4" card) 112 Custom Cards Featuring Monster High. And do not forget to yell UNO when you only have one card left! —description from the publisher

name: UNO: Monster High
description: The original game of UNO gets a spook-tastic Monster High twist! Classic UNO rules apply, and the addition of a special rule and 4 extra cards gives players a chance to experience all new game changing moments! When you play a Beast Ghoul Friends Card, you get to choose a color and then discard up to three frightful cards from your hand. Plus, pick another player who gets to discard one card of that color, too! Fans of the series will recognize their favorite Monster High characters and scenes featured on the cards they play. And do not forget to yell UNO when you only have one card left! Includes 112 cards and instructions. —description from the publisher

name: UNO: My Hero Academia (McDonald's Happy Meal Edition)
description: This is a travel-sized promotional card game released globally as part of the 2026 McDonald's "UNO x Anime" Happy Meal crossover campaign. Packaged in a bright green box featuring Izuku Midoriya (Deku) ready for action, this officially licensed mini-deck shrinks the traditional Mattel game formula into a streamlined 43-card format designed for 2 to 4 players. The deck is divided into four vibrant colored suits adorned with dynamic character illustrations of U.A. High School's Class 1-A heroes, including Deku, Bakugo, Todoroki, and Ochaco, alongside the legendary All Might. Players attempt to empty their hands by matching colors or numbers, while strategic action variants like Skip, Reverse, and Draw 1 keep the flow unpredictable. This promotional set includes a franchise-exclusive holographic foil "One For All: Full Cowling" Wild Card. When played, the active player names the next color to continue play and channels Deku's power to force the next player in turn order to choose between drawing 3 cards immediately or passing their entire upcoming turn completely.

name: UNO: My Neighbour Totoro
description: This UNO special edition features the characters from the Studio Ghibli film "My Neighbor Totoro"! Cards feature pictures of Mei, Satsuki and Totoro along with other characters from the movie. The game contains 112 cards. 25 each of four colour sets (red, green, yellow, blue - 1 x 0 card, 2 x number cards 2 to 9, 2 x Reverse, 2 x Skip, 2 x Draw 2) plus 4 of three wild card types (Wild, Wild Draw 4, Sanbo Wild) The game plays like a standard game of UNO with only one exception. The Sanbo Wild, or "Walk" card, is exclusive to this version of UNO - when played each player must give their hand to the next clockwise player. The person who played the card then chooses the colour. If drawn as the first card it should be returned to the deck and a new card drawn.

name: UNO: My Scene
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: UNO Fun with girls' favorite My Scene (r) characters. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The Casting Couch.... uh, I mean, Casting Call card -- ????

name: UNO: Naruto (McDonald's Happy Meal Edition)
description: This is a fast-paced, travel-sized promotional card-shedding game released as part of the massive 2026 McDonald's "UNO x Anime" Happy Meal crossover event. Housed in a blue box featuring a dynamic illustration of Naruto Uzumaki executing a Rasengan, this licensed mini-deck shrinks the classic game formula down into an optimized 43-card architecture meant for 2 to 4 players. The deck spans four colored suits featuring custom character portraits of iconic characters from the classic Naruto series (including Naruto, Sasuke, Kakashi, and Sakura). The core objective mirrors traditional UNO gameplay: players match cards by number or color to empty their hands, deploying tactical Skip, Reverse, and Draw 1 action variants along the way. This promotional set includes a franchise-exclusive holographic foil "Nine-Tails Chakra / Kurama Mode" Wild Card. When played, it allows the active player to change the active color and forces all other players to immediately discard their highest-numbered cards back into the draw pile, resetting hand progression and completely altering the endgame balance.

name: UNO: National Football League NFL Editions
description: The usual Uno rules - Players race to empty their hands and catch opposing players with cards left in theirs, which score points. In turns, players attempt to play a card by matching its color or number to the topmost card on the discard pile. If unable to play, players draw cards from the draw pile until they are able to place a card. Wild and special cards spice things up a bit. Additionally, when playing their penultimate card from their hand, players must shout 'UNO' or face a forfeit of drawing two further cards. These two football themed editions of UNO feature pictures of AFC and NFC stars on the cards. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: 'Champs Card' - When this card is played, the player who plays it selects another player to draw cards. That player must draw until he has drawn a number 4 card or seven cards total. The player playing the 'Champs Card' also selects the new color of play.

name: UNO: National Parks
description: Another UNO themed edition. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: BEAR ALERT. When the BEAR ALERT card is played, the player playing it must call out a new color. The remaining players in turn must draw from the DRAW pile until they draw the called color. Players must show the cards as they draw them.

name: UNO: New York City
description: Special deck featuring photos taken by New Yorkers. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: SKIP EVERYONE card.

name: UNO: New York Knicks
description: An Uno variation themed on the National Basketball Association (NBA) team, the New York Knicks WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Exclusive "Dunk" card and rule commemorating John Starks' 1993 driving, left-handed tomahawk slam.

name: UNO: New York Yankees
description: A series of Uno variants based on assorted major league baseball teams. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The Yankee Stadium Card. If a Draw 2 or Draw 4 card is played against you, play this card to block it. After discarding the Yankee Stadium card, designate a color of your choice and play resumes. This card can also be played at any time as a Wild card; you do not need to use it to block a Draw card. This card can also be played as your last card. The point value of the Yankee Stadium card is 50 points.

name: UNO: Nintendo
description: Standard Uno-themed card game. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The 'Power' card, which can be played to cancel out another player's special card.

name: UNO: Nonpartisan
description: Uno with red and blue cards replaced with orange and purple, and with a Veto card to show if anyone starts talking politics. Otherwise, Uno.

name: UNO: NSync
description: WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Adds a fifth color (purple) and has a different ratio of cards than traditional Uno. Cards are only from 1 to 7 instead of 0 to 9. The game includes rules for a special card, the 'On-Tour' Card. This card when played allows the player to trade cards with another player. The 6 special 'On-Tour' cards are only available in the 3 *NSYNC #1 Fan Dolls; Barbie, Teresa, and Christie. The game is package in a double CD case and comes with an exclusive *NSYNC CD.

name: UNO: One Piece
description: Another UNO Variation. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: UNO - One Piece, includes 110 cards featuring two special cards, 'Shanks' and 'UNO UNO no mi', 'Shanks' , When this card is played, the player may ask any of his/her opponents to show all cards in the same colors' stated by the play, this function can only be cancelled by playing a number one card 'Luffy'. 'UNO UNO no mi' always plays with another function card which copy the effect of that function.

name: UNO: Over the Hedge
categories: Animals;Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: This themed version of Uno is based on the family film, "Over the Hedge." This version includes a special card/rule which does not correlate to any card in regular Uno, the Verminator's "Trap" card.

name: Uno: Patriots
description: A series of UNO variants based on assorted baseball and football teams. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The "Acquisition" card, with a picture of a specific player from the team. Using this card means you take a card from your hand and declare what card you want. If any player has it, they must exchange it for the card you have offered.

name: UNO: Paw Patrol
categories: Animals;Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: This is a Paw Patrol version of the classic UNO game. It has all the same card types of the original game, plus a unique "Silver Badge" card which forces the next player to draw until he reaches a card with a picture of Chase, Rubble or Marshall.

name: UNO: Peanuts
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Another UNO Variation. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The GOOD GRIEF card: When this card is played, the player may choose any of her/his opponents to draw until they get a card with Charlie Brown on it.

name: UNO: Peanuts – A Charlie Brown Christmas
categories: Animals;Card Game;Children's Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: This Christmas-themed Uno variant comes packaged in a plastic Snoopy doghouse, and introduces a new type of Wild card: The "Happy Holiday" Wild card forces all other players to draw 1 card, but they may discard it if it matches the color called. From the packaging: "It's time to come together and celebrate an all-time classic with the Charlie Brown Chrismas edition of Uno . 112 custom cards feature the Peanuts gang getting into the Christmas spirit, including Snoopy, Charlie Brown, Lucy, Linus, Woodstock, and more. Same cheerful play plus the exclusive Happy Holidays card & rule. Bring your family and friends together to try to be the one to sing "UNO" first and go for the win!"

name: UNO: Philadelphia Phillies
description: Another Uno variation. Philadelphia Phillies Uno comes with 112 Custom cards featuring the Phils' 2005 line-up including Jim Thome, Bobby Abreu, Jon Lieber, Pat Burrell and more. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Acquisition card and rule.

name: UNO: Phineas and Ferb
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Classic UNO with Phineas and Ferb artwork on the cards. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Agent P Card - Play Agent P Card whenever someone plays a Draw 2 or Wild Draw 4 on you and that person must draw the designated amount of cards from the discard pile. The Agent P Card is also a wild card where you choose the color that resumes play.

name: Uno: Pinkalicious
description: Similar to Uno with a special card for this edition: Pinkititis - if you come down with a case of Pinkititis, there's only one way to cure it: discard it and cover it up with all the green cards in your hand! You may choose the next color to resume play. If you do not have any green cards, use the card as a wild and select the next color to resume play. The point value of the Pinkititis card is 50 points Game comes in a standard cardboard box and a collector's tin

name: UNO: Pirates of the Caribbean at World's End
description: This is a themed version of Uno based on the film "Pirates of the Caribbean at World's End." This version of Uno has a special card/rule which does not correlate to any card in regular Uno, the "Black Pearl" card.

name: UNO: Pixar Card Game
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number
description: Essentially the same Uno but with several Pixar characters and a new rule: The Pixar Pop Quiz (applied to 4 wild cards). The person who plays this card chooses any other player and asks them to name a Pixar movie. The player holding the wild card must name as many characters from that movie as they can (up to five characters). The other player then must draw one card for every character named correctly.

name: UNO: Planes
categories: Aviation / Flight;Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: The usual Uno rules - Players race to empty their hands and catch opposing players with cards left in theirs, which score points. In turns, players attempt to play a card by matching its color or number to the topmost card on the discard pile. If unable to play, players draw cards from the draw pile until they are able to place a card. Wild and special cards spice things up a bit. Additionally, when playing their penultimate card from their hand, players must shout 'UNO' or face a forfeit of drawing two further cards. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Altimeter Alert Card. When played, the player of the altimeter alert card chooses one color and each player puts 1 card of that color, face down, in front of them. Then each player reveals their card and whoever has the highest number wins. If 2 players have the same card, the number is invalid and the next one who has the highest number wins. Whoever wins then plays his card and the game continues.

name: UNO: Pokemon Asia
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Fantasy;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Video Game Theme
description: "Join Pikachu and all his friends when you play this Pokemon edition of UNO! Master the game with the special 'Snorlax Traffic' and 'Battle Bond' rules! And when you're down to your last card, don't yell 'pika pika', yell UNO!" UNO variation where all of the cards have a pokemon, including some of the original 150 and newer pokemon from Sword & Shield. The deck is the same as normal UNO, but with 4 extra wild cards: - Wild Snorlax Traffic Cards: you choose a colour, the next player draws 3 cards and then discard all cards of your chosen colour from their hand (their turn ends). - Wild Battle Bond Card: you choose a colour and the next player draws a card. If their drawn card does not match the chosen colour, they have to draw another card. You can then choose the colour that continues play. You can choose to play a normal game of UNO without these extra cards, or keep them in for something a bit different.

name: UNO: Pokemon Sun & Moon
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Fantasy;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Video Game Theme
description: Collectible UNO card game with designs from the video game Pokemon Sun & Moon. The global rule is same that UNO, but is a Japanese version. UNO appeared with a lot of Pokemon including Pikachu, Mokuro, Ashimari, Nyaby and so on.Four original special rule [1000 Mangold] cards also entered, and it was more fun and finished in a special UNO. —user summary

name: UNO: Pokémon
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Fantasy;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Video Game Theme
description: Variation of UNO celebrating the 10th Anniversary of Pokémon. Cards feature various Pokémon, some themed to the cards they're featured on (Wobbuffet is on the "Reverse" card, Slaking is on the "Skip" card, Plusle and Minun are pictured on the "Draw 2" card). WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Comes with a special "Trainer" card that allows the player to exchange all of their cards with one of their opponent's cards.

name: UNO: Polly Pocket
description: The usual UNO rules - Players race to empty their hands and catch opposing players with cards left in theirs, which score points. In turns, players attempt to play a card by matching its color or number to the topmost card on the discard pile. If unable to play, players draw cards from the draw pile until they are able to place a card. Wild and special cards spice things up a bit. Additionally, when playing their penultimate card from their hand, players must shout 'UNO' or face a forfeit of drawing two further cards. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Rockin' Blockin' card - a special wild card that can be used in two different ways: Rock the card: Play this card and each of your opponents must draw one card from the draw pile. Block their cards: If the player before you plays a Wild Draw 4 card, you can instantly discard the Rockin' Blockin' card to block their card. If you do this, you don't have to draw four cards and you still get to take your turn.

name: UNO: Ratatouille
categories: Animals;Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: This version of Uno uses the theme of the Disney/Pixar movie: "Ratatouille." Includes a special card not found in regular Uno, the "Recipe For Chaos" card.

name: UNO: Red Sox 07 World Series Champions
description: This themed version of Uno features the second World Series championship won by the Boston Red Sox this decade (2007). This version of Uno includes a special card/rule that does not correlate to any card in regular Uno, the "Sweep" card.

name: UNO: Reggie Bush Special Edition
description: An Uno variation based on Reggie Bush, star running back for the NFL New Orleans Saints football team. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: exclusive "All Purpose" card and rule celebrating Bush's versatility as a running back, receiver, and kick returner.

name: UNO: Ren and Stimpy
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Basic Uno-themed card game. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The "Eediot" card. This card is played like a wild card but it allows the player playing it to designate another player to make him hold his cards backwards so that everyone else can see them till a card with Stimpy is played.

name: UNO: Rick & Morty
categories: Card Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number
description: Rick and Morty UNO Card Game [Adult Swim] including Special Rule Mr. Meeseeks Fun Gift. If you know Rick and Morty, then you know that rules aren’t really their thing. So, in Rick and Morty Uno, the typical game we all know and love has a rule-breaking twist. The Mr. Meeseeks Rule lets you search through the discard pile to find the perfect card to play should you not have one that works.

name: UNO: Royal Revenge
description: Description from the publisher: UNO Royal Revenge presents a whole new way to play your favorite card game – complete with King’s crown, a Jester’s hat and royal scepter! Just like in classic UNO, the object of the game is to be the first player to get rid of all your cards. With the addition of a crown, jester hat, and special action cards, players get a whole new way to control the play. New Royal Revenge action cards add all new game changing moments that will have everyone on the edge of their seats.

name: UNO: San Antonio Spurs
description: This themed vesion of Uno features the NBA Basketball Team the San Antonio Spurs. This version of Uno includes a special card/rule that does not correlate to any card in regular Uno, the "Dunk" card.

name: UNO: Schitt's Creek
description: It's the UNO matching card game everyone knows but featuring favorite characters from Schitt's Creek. Players still race to get rid of all their cards by matching color, number and symbol, but every card has either a 'Love' or 'Money' icon on it. When someone plays a special 'Where Everyone Fits In' card, they call out either 'love' or 'money.' Players then reveal their hands and may have to draw cards if they don't have enough of the chosen icon. And just like always, when a player is down to one card, they must shout, 'UNO!' Makes a great gift for card game lovers and Schitt's Creek fans ages 7 years and older. Colors and decorations may vary. The classic UNO card game builds fun on game night with themes inspired by Schitt's Creek. Each game features a deck decorated with character graphics from beloved show! As in classic UNO game, players match colors, numbers and symbols to the card on top of the discard pile! A special 'Where Everyone Fits In' rule may force some player to draw cards. Makes a great gift for kid, teen, adult and family game nights with 2 to 10 players ages 7 years and older!

name: UNO: Seattle Mariners
description: Standard Uno-themed card game with the addition of the Open Roof card. The Open Roof card works as a standard WILD card but also allows you to look at the hand of another player. From the tin: "Step up to the plate with America's National Pastime and America's #1 Brand of Family Games in UNO the Seattle Mariners Edition. This grand slam version of UNO is fully customized depicting Seattle Mariners all stars Ichiro, John Olerud, Edgar Martinez and much, much more. We have added the exclusive Open Roof card and rule, where you can look "through the roof" at another player's hand. The whole game comes packaged in a highly detailed collector's tin. Don't strikeout by missing this great tribute to the Northwest's home team."

name: UNO: Seinfeld
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Humor;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number
mechanics: Hand Management;Lose a Turn;Matching;Take That;Variable Set-up
description: Fans of the classic sitcom Seinfeld will love playing this themed UNO card game. With a deck featuring graphics inspired by favorite characters and scenes, players try to match colors and numbers -- there are even eight special rules all based on favorite moments from the show! And when down to a last card, don't forget to yell 'UNO!' Makes a great gift for fans of Seinfeld and card game lovers ages 7 years old and up. Colors and decorations may vary. UNO game players will love feature graphics inspired by characters from the TV show Seinfeld. Game play matches the classic card game where players match colors and numbers to get rid of all their cards. There are 8 special rules based on moments from the show, including 'Serenity Now!', Yadda-Yadda', 'It's Not You, It's Me' and more. When down to one card, don't forget to yell 'UNO!' Designed for 2 to 10 players ages 7 years and older, the collectible card game makes a great gift for fans of the TV show! —description from the publisher

name: UNO: Sesame Street
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Basic Uno-themed card game. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The "GROUCH" card. This card allows the player to throw out their trash. The player playing the card can dump up to three of their cards by distributing all the cards to one player or spreading them out to multiple players.

name: UNO: Shark Week
description: Same cards as the original UNO plus a unique one: Shark Attack - When this card is played, all players must race to put their hand on the discard pile. The last player to do so is attacked and must draw 4 cards. This card is also a wild card.

name: UNO: Show 'Em No Mercy
mechanics: Hand Management;Lose a Turn;Matching;Player Elimination;Take That
description: UNO Show 'Em No Mercy is a brutal, ruthless version of the classic UNO card game. In addition to standard action cards like Skip, Reverse, and Draw 2, No Mercy comes with Wild Draw 6, Wild Draw 10, Skip Everyone, Discard All, and the new Wild Color Roulette - a card that forces the next player to choose a color and then draw until they get a card of that color. In addition to new action cards, many popular house rules have been included in the actual rules. Stacking is legal. 7s swap and 0s pass hands. And when you can't play a card, you must draw until you can play. But the biggest change in UNO Show 'Em No Mercy is the Mercy Rule. If you ever have 25 or more cards in your hand, you get kicked out of the game. UNO Show 'Em No Mercy comes with 168 cards (compared to 112 in standard UNO).

name: UNO: Show 'Em No Mercy Attack
description: UNO Show 'Em No Mercy Attack cranks up classic UNO play with a two-button card launcher and ruthless, hard-hitting rules. Match colors and numbers, then brace for unpredictable card blasts that can crush you in an instant. Press your luck, outlast opponents and don't forget to yell "UNO!" A pitiless game night pick for players ages 7+. NO Show 'Em No Mercy Attack! combines classic color-and-number matching with a card launcher for fast-paced, unpredictable gameplay. Press the Yellow Button when you have to draw—maybe nothing happens, maybe a burst of cards flies out and wrecks your plans. Special cards trigger the Red Button—press and hold to charge up a massive blast that could unleash an insanely brutal flood of cards. Savage rules and powerful action cards raise the stakes, adding chaos, tension and punishing surprises to every turn. Designed for 2–6 players ages 7 and up, this merciless game makes an exciting gift for kids, families and grown-ups. —description from the publisher

name: UNO: Shrek
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Fantasy;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: The usual Uno (including themed editions without new cards) rules - Players race to empty their hands and catch opposing players with cards left in theirs, which score points. In turns, players attempt to play a card by matching its color or number to the topmost card on the discard pile. If unable to play, players draw cards from the draw pile until they are able to place a card. Wild and special cards spice things up a bit. Additionally, when playing their penultimate card from their hand, players must shout 'UNO' or face a forfeit of drawing two further cards. Based on the Dream Works film Shrek 3. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: 'Merlin Card' When you play this card you call out a color of your choice. All other players draw cards from the DRAW pile until each draws a card of that color. All of the cards that they draw are added to the cards in their hands.

name: UNO: Shrek 2
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Fantasy;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Basic Uno-themed card game. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The "Blind" card. This card works like a wild card, but the person playing it is allowed to choose any of the other players to close his or her eyes and pick a card from all the other players' hands. Then the person who played the Blind card picks the color and play resumes as normal.

name: UNO: Simpsons Edition
description: This version of UNO features Simpsons images on the cards, a new card type (Blinky Card) and it is housed in a box shaped like Homer's head.

name: UNO: Sonic The Hedgehog
categories: Animals;Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Video Game Theme
description: It's the UNO matching card game everyone knows and loves but featuring graphics from the video game Sonic the Hedgehog. Players still race to get rid of all their cards by matching color, number and symbol, but when someone plays a Wild Victory Lap Card, all other players must draw one card! And when a player is down to one card, they can't forget to shout, "UNO!"

name: UNO: South Park
description: Basic Uno-themed card game. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The 'Dead Kenny' card. By playing this card, you choose a player (kill them) and they must draw cards until another card with Kenny on it turns up. When drawn, play continues with that card, and the player keeps all other cards drawn. If another 'Dead Kenny' card comes up, they get to 'kill' another player, and so on. As a side note, the box says "Ages 18+" though I'm not sure why.

name: UNO: Space Jam – A New Legacy
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Sports
description: Play out this special edition of the UNO card game inspired by the 1996 original movie Space Jam and 2021 sequel Space Jam: A New Legacy. This pack and cards are adorned with graphics of Looney Tunes animated characters and basketball stars from the movie. The special 'Welcome to the Jam' wild card could let you discard two cards or draw two cards, depending on which way the 'ball' bounces! When players have only one card left, they must yell 'UNO!' Colors and decorations may vary. - This special edition of UNO, everyone's favorite card matching game, features images of Looney Tunes characters and basketball stars. - Game play is the same as classic UNO, but there's a special rule unique to this deck the Welcome to the Jam wild card with a very special 'jump ball' rule.

name: UNO: Speed Racer
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number;Racing
description: The usual Uno rules - Players race to empty their hands and catch opposing players with cards left in theirs, which score points. In turns, players attempt to play a card by matching its color or number to the topmost card on the discard pile. If unable to play, players draw cards from the draw pile until they are able to place a card. Wild and special cards spice things up a bit. Additionally, when playing their penultimate card from their hand, players must shout 'UNO' or face a forfeit of drawing two further cards. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Race X Card - This card is a booby trap you can play on your rivals. But be warned, you could get caught in your own trap! When you play this card, you immediately flip the top card from the draw pile onto the discard pile (this card needs to be a number card, so, if necessary keep flipping over cards until a number card is on top. Going in the current direction, each player in turn must play a card from their hand that is ONE number higher than the card on top of the discard pile. You would play a 0 after a 9. Continue to go around until a player can not do this and they will draw 3 cards.

name: UNO: Spider-Man
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Comic Book / Strip;Fantasy;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Standard Uno-themed card game. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: "Spider Sense" card which is both a wild card and allows you to view an opponents hand.

name: UNO: Spider-Man 2
categories: Card Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: This themed version of Uno is based on the movie "Spider-Man 2" (although the card uses comic-book style illustrations as opposed to pictures from the movie itself). This version of Uno includes a special card/rule which does not correlate to any card found in regular Uno, the "Justice" card.

name: UNO: Spider-Sense Spider-Man
description: Uno with Spider-Man theme and special "Spider Sense" cards. The "Spider Sense" cards, when played, require all players to reveal a Spider-Man card from their hand. Those who cannot are forced to draw two cards. These cards also act as "Wild" cards, allowing the player of the Spider-Sense card to choose the color with which to continue play.

name: UNO: Spirit Untamed
categories: Animals;Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: It's UNO with a Spirit themed artwork and a special Spirit card added, "Wild Best Friends Card." This card lets you call out a number and all players can lay down a card of that number, then you get to pick the color to use to continue play.

name: UNO: SpongeBob SquarePants
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: UNO - SpongeBob Squarepants artwork on the cards. Has been released in three variations; SpongeBob Squarepants - Special Edition, SpongeBob Squarepants - All New Special Edition, and SpongeBob Squarepants - Lost in Time. Each set has one new card and rule: WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: SpongeBob Squarepants - Special Edition Super Absorbency - the player with the fewest cards must "absorb" one card from the player to his/her right, one card from the player to his/her left, and one card from the deck, absorbing three cards in total. In case of a tie, the player playing the Super Absorbency card chooses which player draws cards. SpongeBob Squarepants - All New Special Edition Secret Recipe - Allows the player to look at another players hand. The player can also select a new color just like a wild card. SpongeBob Squarepants - Lost in Time Daredevil - Can be played to counter a Draw 2 or Draw 4 card. Can also be used as a wild card.

name: UNO: SPY x FAMILY (McDonald's Happy Meal Edition)
description: This is a travel-sized promotional card game released globally as a headlining part of the 2026 McDonald's "UNO x Anime" Happy Meal crossover campaign. Packed inside a sleek grey box featuring the secret agent Loid Forger (Twilight), this officially licensed mini-deck adapts the classic Mattel formula into a condensed 43-card architecture engineered for 2 to 4 players. The deck spans four colorful suits matching the core aesthetics of the series, featuring character illustrations of the Forger family—including Loid, Yor, Anya, and their dog Bond—alongside prominent supporting characters like Yuri, Damian, and Becky. The objective remains faithful to standard UNO: match colors or numbers to be the first to dump your hand, navigating a leaner lineup of Draw 1, Skip, and Reverse action cards. This set features a franchise-exclusive holographic foil "Anya Mind Reader" Wild Card. When played, the active player names the target color to change the play, then forces all opponents to tilt their card hands forward for a brief three-second window. This telepathic peek gives the player a massive strategic advantage to safely plan their remaining turns or perfectly orchestrate incoming color shifts.

name: UNO: Star Trek
categories: Card Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Science Fiction
description: Three editions have been released of this game, a "Special Edition" by Mattel, a "Collector's Edition" by Fundex and a later "UNO FANDOM" edition by Mattel. The first two editions are packaged in a collector's tin, while the third comes in a standard cardboard container. Each card has a photo of a character or ship from the original Star Trek television show (photos are unique to card values). WHAT MAKES THEM DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Mattel Star Trek UNO When you are down to one card, instead of shouting "UNO" you must instead exclaim "Space, the final UNO frontier!" Includes four exclusive Star Fleet Command cards that alter gameplay from that of traditional UNO: Live Long and Prosper (Wild and New Hand) Card - This card can be played on any card. After playing this card, you must discard your old hand and draw an entirely new hand. You then call any color to continue play, including the one presently being played if desired. NOTE: You can only draw the same number of cards held in your hand after playing this card. Mind Meld Card - This card can be played on any card. After playing this card, you command the next player to show his/her hand to you. Beam Me Up, Scotty (Wild and Stop) Card - Play this card immediately to stop a Command card that is directed to you. You then call any color and play continues. Double Tribble Card - This card can be played on any card. After playing this card, you may call any color to continue play, including the color presently being played if desired. The next player must double the number of cards in his/her hand by drawing additional cards and forfeit his/her turn. Fundex Collector's Edition Star Trek When you are down to one card, instead of shouting "UNO" you must instead exclaim "UNO, I'm a Doctor!" Includes four "Beam Up WILD" cards that can negate the effects of any DRAW 2 or DRAW 4 WILD cards played against a player. That player can then call a new color, and play resumes as if they had played a regular WILD. (It can also be used as a regular WILD if desired.) NOTE: Unlike the 4 different types of "special WILDs" in the Mattel set, the Fundex set only has the one non-standard type of WILD card. It does, however, mirror the effects of the "Beam Me Up, Scotty" card in the Mattel set. UNO FANDOM--Star Trek: The Original Series Contains a special "WILD MIRROR MIRROR" card. When played, you choose a player, who must draw cards until they have the same number of cards as the player holding the most cards in their hand. NOTE: This set comes with 4 regular print WILD MIRROR MIRROR Cards and one special foil version of the card. The rules allow you to switch off one regular version with the foil card if you wish.

name: UNO: Star Wars
categories: Card Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number;Science Fiction
description: Uno Star Wars edition. This edition comes with a special “Wild the Force card”. When you play the special card, choose another player and then choose a color. the chosen player must show you their hand and if they have at least one card of the chosen color, they are forced to draw two cards. If they do not have any cards of the chosen color, they suffer no penalty and play continues in current order with the chosen color. If this card is turned up at the beginning of play, the person to the left of the dealer chooses the color start begins play.

name: UNO: Star Wars – Technical Schematics
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number;Science Fiction
description: It's the classic UNO card game players know and love themed to the universe of Star Wars. The deck features graphics with schematics of the most iconic starships, space stations and droids in the Star Wars universe. The special 'That Was One in a Million' rule will have players tossing cards at the Discard Pile as if it were a thermal exhaust port no more than 2 meters wide! Don't forget, when players get down to only one card, they must yell 'UNO!' Makes a great gift for collectors and fans of Star Wars for teens, adults and game nights with 2 to 10 players ages 7 years and older.

name: UNO: Star Wars – The Mandalorian
categories: Card Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Science Fiction
description: The classic UNO card game builds fun on game night with a theme inspired by the Disney+ show Star Wars The Mandalorian. Features a deck with characters and graphics from the beloved series. Block action cards with the "This is the Way" card and rule.

name: UNO: Stars of the American League
description: This baseball themed edition of UNO features pictures of American League stars on the cards. The National League version is the same, but with National League stars. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The "Top 2" -- this one requires the two players with the fewest number of cards in hand when it is played to draw a card into their hands, with the player playing the "Top 2" card exempt.

name: Uno: Super Bowl XL Steelers Special Edition
description: A Special Edition of Uno the successful commercial version of crazy eights that is dedicated to The Super Bowl XL champion Pittsburgh Steelers. Includes Exclusive MVP Card (Hines Ward) and rule. When an MVP card is played the person who played it chooses another player to draw cards from the draw pile until he gets an 8 or a 6 (based on Hines Ward's uniform number of 86) or has reached five cards drawn if no 8 or 6 comes up. If an 8 or 6 is drawn it is put into the discard pile and the person who played the MVP card chooses the color to continue playing with regardless of last card played to the discard pile. The MVP card can be used as a player's last card allowing him/her to go out of the game. if this happens a player to draw must still be chosen. The MVP card is worth 50 points.

name: UNO: Super Mario
description: Join Mario, Luigi, and all their friends for a game of UNO! It's the UNO you love, but this version also includes a special Mario Super Star Card that makes your character invincible. After another player plays a Draw 4 or Draw 2 card, play the Super Star Card to bounce the card power back to that player. And two customizable cards deliver even more game-changing moments and help defeat opponents! Score points by being the first to get rid of all the cards in your hand. First player or team to 500 wins. When you're down to one card, don't forget to yell "UNO!" Includes special Mario Super Star Card and two customizable cards.

name: UNO: Superman
categories: Card Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Look! Up in the sky! It's a bird! It's a Plane! It's Superman as he meets America's #1 brand of family games in Uno Classic DC Comics Superman Edition. Packaged in a collectible tin, 112 custom cards feature The Man of Steel and evil villains such as Mr. Mxyzptlk, Brainiac, Lex Luthor, Doomsday and more. It's Bizarrow vs. Superman with the exclusive battle card and rule - so use your own super powers and bring the excitement of Metropolis home with Uno Classic DC Comics Superman Edition!

name: UNO: Superman Returns
categories: Card Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Based on the Superman Returns movie. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The Special Kryptonite Card. When the Kryptonite card is played each of the other players, in turn, must play a green or a wild card from their hand. The Kryptonite card may also be used as a wild card.

name: UNO: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
categories: Animals;Card Game;Children's Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Get ready to unleash your turtle power in this Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtle (TMNT) version of UNO, dudes! Classic UNO rules apply, yet with the addition of a special rule and four corresponding action cards, players get the chance to experience all new game changing moments! This fearsome foursome of turtles works together with the Team Attack Card, which allows players to vanquish three villains from their hand! Fans of the cartoon series and movie will recognize their favorite characters, like Leonardo and Michelangelo, who are featured on the cards they play. And do not forget to yell "UNO" when you have but one card remaining!

name: UNO: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles – Mutant Mayhem
categories: Animals;Card Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Inspired by the hit film, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Mutant Mayhem, this edition of UNO brings your favorites like Donatello, Raphael, Leonardo, Michelangelo, and more to your next game night! The new wild "From the Sewers" card forces the next player to draw until they have all 4 colors and then show their hand.

name: UNO: Texas
description: Themed Uno game based on the the state of Texas. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The special "Last Stand" cards and rules (referring to last stand at the Alamo), which allows players to switch hands and does not correlate to cards/rules in regular Uno.

name: UNO: The Amazing Spider-Man
categories: Card Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number
description: UNO inspired by characters from the Marvel comic book series The Amazing Spider-Man. A special "Wild Web Swing" wild card lets you skip any player with a card of the chose color.

name: UNO: The Big Bang Theory
description: Standard UNO, but with custom cards featuring characters from "The Big Bang Theory" television show. Also includes 4 exclusive Kitty action cards. The Kitty card is like a Wild, but it forces the next player to draw cards until he gets one with Sheldon (3s and 9s) or Penny (5s and 0s) on it. Contents: 112 custom cards

name: UNO: The Dark Knight
categories: Card Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Based on the 2008 film "The Dark Knight." Includes the exclusive The Joker's wild card, which forces an opponent to draw cards until they draw a card of the color of your choice.

name: UNO: The Dog
description: Standard Uno-themed card game. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The 'Fetch' card. When this card is played, everyone has to scramble to get hold of it first. If you get it, keep it! Everyone else must draw cards. 2006 Version replaces the 'Fetch' Card with the 'Roll Over' Card. When this card is played the player who plays it chooses a player to reveal his hand to all. That player must play his hand exposed until his turn. The 'Roll Over' Card is also a wild card.

name: UNO: The Golden Compass
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Typical UNO themed edition with the addition of a themed Alethiometer card.

name: UNO: The Legend of Zelda
description: The deck features classic UNO game play, plus some special Legend of Zelda touches. Includes special Triforce Wild Cards that when played require the next player to follow with a card that has a Triforce on it. If they they can't they need to draw three cards.

name: UNO: The Lion King
categories: Animals;Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number
description: It's the classic card game you know, now with a Lion King theme! UNO Lion King features a colorful deck with images of beloved characters from the original Disney movie -- Simba, Timon, Pumba and more -- as well as a special Lion King-themed rule that could change the entire direction of the game! Just like in classic UNO, match cards by color or number and play action cards like Skip, Reverse and Wild Draw Four to shake up the competition. When the Circle of Life card is played, cards pass in a circle from player to player. Score points by being the first to get rid of all the cards in your hand and when you're down to one card, don't forget to roar, "UNO!" This version of the family-favorite card game makes a great gift for 7 year olds and up. Colors and decorations may vary. It's the classic card game you know, now with a Lion King theme! —description from the publisher

name: UNO: The Muppet Show
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Basic Uno-themed card game. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The "Mayhem" card, which works like a wild card except that it makes everyone at the table swap hands, the direction of the swap is decided by the person who played the card.

name: UNO: The National Parks Edition
description: America's #1 Card Game meets America's most beautiful national treasures. Includes 112 cards featuring everyone's favorite parks plus an exclusive parks card and rules. Created in response to the new Ken Burns documentary The National Parks: America's Best Idea.

name: UNO: The Nightmare Before Christmas
description: This is a themed version of Uno based on the Disney movie, "The Nightmare Before Christmas." This version of Uno has an additional card/rule which does not correlate to any card in regular Uno, the "Oogie-Boogie" card.

name: UNO: The Office
description: It's the UNO matching card game everyone loves, but in a special edition featuring characters and settings from the incredibly popular TV series The Office. Players won't have to survive small office boredom using sarcasm and hilarious pranks, but they will try to get rid of all the cards in their hand. And if you're not quick, you may end up drawing card with the 'Kevin's Famous Chili' rule - Whoever drops all their cards LAST has to draw two cards. Gameplay is the same as classic UNO with players matching colors and numbers as well as throwing down wild cards and penalty cards to trip up their opponents. When they're down to one card, they have to shout like they just got a bonus, 'UNO!'

name: UNO: The Peanuts Movie Card Game
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Another UNO Variation. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: MAN’S BEST FRIENDS card: When this card is played, the player may choose discard three cards with Charlie Brown and/or Snoopy on them and picks another player to be their Best Friend and also discard one card with Charlie Brown or Snoopy on it. Additionally, this card acts as a Wild Card and the player that played the card can call another color to continue play.

name: UNO: The Simpsons
description: The UNO game players love features graphics inspired by characters from the series The Simpsons. Game play mirrors the classic card game where players match colors and numbers to get rid of all their cards. Unique patterns on each card help identify the color(s) on that card, allowing players with any form of color blindness to play. The special "Woo-hoo D'OH" rule adds a fun twist, where a player may be safe (Woo-hoo) or may have to add cards (D'OH): With the special "Woo-hoo! D'OH!" card, you may be safe (Woo-hoo!) or may have to add cards (D'OH!). And when you're down to one card, don't yell "Ay Caramba!", yell "UNO!" —description from the publisher

name: UNO: The Simpsons Springfield Edition
description: Players race to empty their hands and catch opposing players with cards left in theirs, which score points. In turns, players attempt to play a card by matching its color, number, or word to the topmost card on the discard pile. If unable to play, players draw a card from the draw pile, and if still unable to play, they pass their turn. Wild and special cards spice things up a bit. Apu, Barney, Moe, the Sea Captain and many more are featured on 112 Custom Cards and packaged in a collectible tin. Groundskeeper Willie even makes a special appearance in the exclusive "Great Scott" card and rule. So grab your own dysfunctional family and friends and be the first to reach 500 points to win this wacky game!

This completely customized Simpsons edition of Uno features 15 character cards representing your favorite Simpsons characters. This game is a must for any Simpsons fan. Be the first to reach 500 points and you win the game! This Special Edition includes Exclusive Draw 3 Cards.

name: UNO: The Simpsons – Treehouse of Horror

If unable to play, players draw cards from the draw pile until they are able to place a card. Wild and special cards spice things up a bit. Additionally, when playing their penultimate card from their hand, players must shout 'UNO' or face a forfeit of drawing two further cards. Based on the TV show The Simpson's Halloween Specials Treehouse of Horror. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: 'Witchcraft Card - Can be played to counter a Draw 2 or Draw 4 card. Can also be used as a wild card.

description: An UNO variant themed around the 1939 Wizard of Oz movie. Plays like UNO except... WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: The Rainbow Rule/ Card which allows you to peak at your opponents hand. [From the back of the box] Follow the Yellow Brick Road to countless good time with the Wizard of Oz Edition of UNO. 112 Custom Cards feature Dorothy, Toto, the Scarecrow, the Tinman, the Lion and many more of your favorite characters from the classic 1939 movie. Same great UNO play PLUS the exclusive Rainbow rule which allows you to peak "somwehre over" your oppoentn's shoulder and look at their cards. It's going to take brains, heart and courage to be the first player to yell "UNO" and win the game!

name: UNO: Tom Brady NFL Greatest Players
description: An Uno variation themed on Tom Brady, star quarterback for the National Football League New England Patriots Team. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Exclusive "Passer" card and rule which does not correlate to any card/rule in regular Uno.

name: UNO: Toy Story
description: Play UNO to infinity and beyond with Woody, Buzz, and the toys from Andy's room. Become the master of the aliens with the special Claw card and rule! And be sure to yell "UNO!" when you're about to reach for the sky and win!

name: UNO: Toy Story 3
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: All your favorite toy box friends are back and ready to play everyone's favorite family game. UNO is even more exciting with colorful graphics and fun characters inspired by the film, Toy Story 3. Includes customized Toy Story 3 UNO cards plus the exclusive Dump Truck card. Publisher's Website

name: UNO: Toy Story 4
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: It's the classic card game you know, now with an exciting Disney Pixar Toy Story 4 theme! Based on the highly anticipated family film, this UNO deck features cards with images of your favorite Toy Story 4 characters, plus the Duke Caboom Wild Card! When played, Duke will “crash” into two other players of your choice. Pick two players, mix their cards together and deal them back out equally to each player. Like classic UNO, players take turns matching a card in their hand with the current card shown on top of the deck either by color or number. Score points by being the first to get rid of all the cards in your hand. First player or team to 500 wins. When you're down to one card, don't forget to yell "UNO!" —from the publisher's website

name: UNO: Trolls World Tour
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number

name: UNO: UNOcorns
description: These UNOcorns have just the right blend of SWAGATUDE! Guess the color of the card stuck to your forehead with the Narwhal Rule Card! And before you play your last card, don't forget to whinny "UNO"!

name: UNO: Vacation
description: WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: Check Two Card. When this Check Two Card played by a player, he/she can: - immediately play another card of the same suit color, OR - play either Wild or Wild Draw 4 Card, the wild color called must match the color of the Check Two Card played. However, this Check Two Card cannot be played: - on its own (without a card of the same suit color), OR - as the last card in your hand. If the Check Two Card is the last card in a player hand, he/she must take another card from the draw pile. If the card just drawn matches the suit color of the Check Two Card, he/she may directly play the Check Two Card, say UNO, and play the matching suit color card to complete the game.

name: UNO: Vintage Peanuts
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Comic Book / Strip;Movies / TV / Radio theme
description: Another UNO Variation. The Newest Peanuts Edition. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: THE RED BARON CARD: When this card is played, the player may look at any other player's hand.

name: UNO: WellieWishers
description: The goal is to be the first to get rid of all your cards, and when there's one card to go, don't forget to yell "UNO!" UNO WellieWishers comes with a special Kindness card, and when you play it, all your fellow players get to discard one card in the color that you choose!

name: UNO: Wicked
categories: Card Game;Children's Game;Movies / TV / Radio theme;Number
description: Fans of the movie Wicked will love playing this themed UNO card game! With a deck featuring graphics inspired by favorite characters and scenes, players try to match colors and numbers — there’s even a special “Defy Gravity” rule that will have players flying (well, skipping) by opponents like Elphaba herself! And when down to a last card, you’ll be do popular if you sing out “UNO!” • The UNO game players love features graphics inspired by characters from the beloved movie Wicked! • Game play matches the classic card game where players match colors and numbers to get rid of all their cards. • The special “Defy Gravity” rule lets a player skip other players based on how many green cards they have in their hand. • Special graphic symbols added to each card help identify the color(s) on that card, allowing players with any form of color blindness to play! • When down to one card, don’t forget to yell, “UNO!” - description from publisher

name: UNO: With Customizable Wild Cards
description: From back of box: Easy to pick up... impossible to put down! Race to get rid of all your cards. Match colors or numbers. Use the action cards or house rule cards against your opponents. When you're down to one card, don't forget to yell "UNO!" These 4 extra cards are game changers! Play the "Swap Hands" card to change hands with any opponent! 3 Customizable cards let you write any house rule you want! Customizable cards erase to make new rules.

name: UNO: WWE Card Game
description: It's the fun, fast-paced card game you love now featuring iconic characters from the thrilling WWE! Players race to get rid of all their cards by matching a card in their hand with the current card shown on top of the deck. When you throw down the powerful Locked Up card, you choose another player with whom you'll lock into battle. Only one will survive! Other action cards include Skips, Reverses, Draw Twos, and Wild Cards-including a customizable Wild Card. The first player or team to 500 wins, and when you're down to one card, don't forget to yell "UNO!" —description from the publisher

name: UNO: WWE Card Game

If 1 player plays this card like the color choice card, but each other player tries to play one card of this color as fast as possible. The player who is the fasters puts his card on the discard pile. The next player is the one left to the "Card Royal Rumble" player.

name: UNO: WWE Legends of Wrestling
description: This is a themed version of Uno based on the WWE. The cards feature WWE wrestlers including the Junkyard Dog, the Iron Sheik, "Rowdy" Roddy Piper, Bobby "The Brain" Heenan, "The Mouth of The South" Jimmy Hart, and Sgt. Slaughter. This version of Uno has a special card/rule that does not correlate with any card in the regular version of Uno, the "1-2-3" card.

name: Unocitta
description: Unocitta is a 3HOUSE territory-based war game for 2-5 players using Icehouse pieces and a Uno deck. The ever-changing gameboard is made up of Uno cards and is created by the players during the game. Icehouse pyramids are used to indicate player card control. Players complete for control of city blocks in the Martian city of Unocitta. The goal is to completely control a connected trio of cards which are either Three-of-a-Kind or three consecutive numbers of the same suit, thereby gaining control of the city. It is inspired by Zark City.

name: Unoriginal
description: Player race against each other to match their cards and be the first to use them all. The game takes the basic mechanics of Crazy Eights, and adds a large amount of cruelty and strategy in the form of SCREW Cards. SCREW Cards make up about 20% of the deck and each card is unique in both its design and game mechanics. These cards are one time use only and are designed to backfire on the player using them if played carelessly. Each SCREW Card has multiple uses included so that players can fine tune the rules of the game to accommodate their preferred play style. —description from the designer

description: Fädelzoo (Threading Zoo) is a collection of four games all based on the concept of threading pieces onto or off of a string. The theme is animals in a zoo -- the animals have discovered a new favorite past time, which is to connect all of the zoo inhabitants in a line. They first group the animals together by type (all the penguins, then the elephants..), then link the groups together. Three of the games are interactive and one of these is cooperative. One is to match the threading to a picture (many pictures for this are included), another is a race to complete the threading first but pieces are only added when the right die roll is thrown, and the third is to cooperatively build a single thread as fast as possible. The fourth activity in the box is a solitaire exercise.

mechanics: Hand Management;Hot Potato;Player Elimination;Push Your Luck;Set Collection;Take That

The deck is made up of cards that let you avoid exploding by peeking at cards before you draw, forcing your opponent to draw multiple cards, or shuffling the deck. The game gets more and more intense with each card you draw because fewer cards left in the deck means a greater chance of drawing the kitten and exploding in a fiery ball of feline hyperbole.

name: Exploding Kittens: The Board Game
description: There's never been a board game like this before! Your goal is to make it to the end of the board without landing on the Exploding Kitten. To do that you'll play cards and plot strategies to sabotage your opponents. But don't get too cocky because one wrong move can cause the board to flip. This completely transforms the board to reveal a new path where every move could be your last. You have to think fast, form alliances, play smart, and avoid the Exploding Kittens at all costs. The stakes are high but the rules are simple… Just beware, danger, and betrayal, and pee your pants laughing moments lurk around every corner. What other game lets you play as a TacoCat, SushiCat, or GnomeCat? Who else would give you the power of Meatpants, a Litterbox Sandworm, or a Butterfly Punch? —description from the publisher

description: In a world-first for Scrabble, Mattel has today launched the first country-specific version of the game – Aussie Scrabble. The new edition celebrates Australia’s quirky deviations from the English language, adding homegrown flavour with an all-Aussie slang glossary featuring our localised lingo. Mattel took to social media with its mate Jetstar in 2016 to crowd source the best slang words from across the country for potential inclusion into the final glossary. More than 20,000 submissions via the Jetstar Facebook page were put forward, with words such as ‘arvo’, ‘crikey’, ‘biffo’, ‘shonky’ and ‘cozzie’ forming the official word glossary. A fair-dinkum twist on the classic word game, Aussie Scrabble seperates the legends from the drongos with new gameplay and a Lingo List, native to the land down under. Gather your mates together and give it a burl!

name: Disney Scrabble
description: Mattel's Disney themed variation of Scrabble. The tiles come in the shape of Mickey Mouse with the value in the right ear and the racks are slightly glittery. The rule book is specific to this edition and grants a triple word score if the word DISNEY (not allowed in conventional Scrabble) is played, and a double word score if the name of any Disney character is played. The rule book includes an explicit list of characters from ARIEL to ZURG.

name: Electronic Catch Phrase
description: This is a fully electronic re-implementation of the classic team word-guessing hot-potato game Catch Phrase!. Players divide into two teams. One team selects the category and presses the start button. An audible timer beeps a count-down while the person holding the device tries to get their team to say the word or phrase on the screen. If they are successful, they hand the device to the next person on the opposite team. The goal of the round is to not be holding the device when the timer goes off -- though those last furtive seconds can get dicey! When the timer goes off, the opposing team gets a point and (based on what version of the game you are playing) may also have a chance to steal the phrase for an extra point. The first team to reach seven points wins! The primary differences of this game from its progenitor is the implementation of the electronic device, timer, and substantial word lists. The electronic edition has also spawned several spin-offs and sequels. As of 2013, "Electronic" was dropped from the name, leaving it as simply Catch Phrase, effectively replacing the original. Re-implements: Catch Phrase!

name: Family Game Night Book and Game Set: Scrabble, Clue, Sorry, Yahtzee
mechanics: Dice Rolling;Roll / Spin and Move;Spelling;Tile Placement
designers: Alfred Mosher Butts;Paul T. Haskell, Jr.;Edwin S. Lowe;Anthony E. Pratt;William Henry Storey
description: In Scrabble, players use their seven drawn letter-tiles to form words on the gameboard. Each word laid out earns points based on the commonality of the letters used, with certain board spaces giving bonuses. But a word can only be played if it uses at least one already-played tile or adds to an already-played word. This leads to slightly tactical play, as potential words are rejected because they would give an opponent too much access to the better bonus spaces. In Clue, players move from room to room in a mansion to solve the mystery of: who done it, with what, and where? Players are dealt character, weapon, and location cards after the top card from each card type is secretly placed in the confidential file in the middle of the board. Players must move to a room and then make an accusation against a character saying they did it in that room with a specific weapon. The player to the left must show one of any cards accused to the accuser if in that player's hand. Through deductive reasoning each player must figure out which character, weapon, and location are in the secret file. To do this, each player must uncover what cards are in other players hands by making more and more accusations.
